notes.title: v.263 - Carcion Octo Fest Update Preview
notes.content:
[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/scpjhiim/wgc-2375-250826-v263-update-logo-and-key-art.gif"]

The Carcion Octo Fest is setting sail towards Maple World and it’s up to us to figure out what’s going on at the shores of Sunset Beach. While we got the octopuses roaming free, there's a new darkness within Tallahart, and his name is Baldrix! Need a little push for the battle? Activate the HEXA Stat III to increase your power! Before we get to that, let’s make sure you are accustomed to our new UI Improvements, since there are many new changes that make navigating through MapleStory even more efficient. But ARRRright mateys, enough yapping! Let's get straight to some of the treasures of the v.263 update.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/2a821f09a4af3dd7be51130fcc2d5efa7837d1ca.png"]


The apostle, Baldrix, makes his appearance in front of the Adversary to overthrow Tallahart! Are you ready to take him on and unleash your wrath?!

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/3jrhnfrj/skeleton-animation_274.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0c38d0c17118f32839dc8d2c772dad47a241d7b2.png"]



Shiver me timbers, Maplers! We have an urgent call from Captain Kyrin! The Carcion Octo Fest is setting sail straight to Sunset Beach in Carcion, and it looks like they brought a few octopus friends… Gather ‘round and pre-game at the Daily Fest Prep and Weekly Fest Prep for some extra loot before you hit up the Great Octopus Buffet for the real feast! Make sure to collect all your Fatty and Tender Octopuses so you can grub on the Tangyoon or the Ano Dishes! Arrr ya’ feelin’ quite full? Burn off those calories by participating in the Octo Hunt and earn additional rewards! Now let’s set sail! We don’t want you walkin’ the plank now, do we?

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ppjopaly/octo-fest-ui.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/414efd58ff92d52d19025b9bf13872d73ff03220.png"]

 

Along with all the fun in-game events for v.263, we're also revamping the UI in-game with tons of sleek new changes! Get ready to glide through menus and navigate with more ease and efficiency. We'll see UI changes ranging from Main Menus, Equipment Inventories, and Tooltip Revamps! Stay tuned for our upcoming Patch Notes as we will reveal more.

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/iqyebcto/maplestorya_nxl9dfgerk.gif"] 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/b2faa53c81740b8f215315f7d46cd92d22ee0767.png"] 

It’s time to bring out the big guns as the 3rd HEXA Stat can now be activated! If your HEXA Stat I and II are both enhanced to Lv. 20, then you can activate HEXA Stat III for even more massive gains. Better start saving up your Sol Erda and Sol Erda Frags!

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/dcxccn5k/maplestorya_4l7sgexzg1.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/1c667ff877b3f97b9cef6f0da623e9a0d9e871f6.png"]

Oooh~ Do you feel like something is watching you...? I don’t feel so good... If you have the guts, join us and help solve the mysteries of the Haunted Mansion to get to the bottom of this! Work your way through 9 floors of eerie distortions and you can earn some ghostly prizes.

 [img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/llbhqkip/maplestorya_xfmgqzujep.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/2e6ab644cd772d14c16617996f15a881240f48b8.png"]

 

3...2...1! HAPPY NEW - oh! Not that kind of countdown... We are heading to the cold season so let's bundle up and get cozy for the Winter Countdown! Check in during this event period and you can easily stock up on some heated rewards.

 [img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/zwfovurl/winter-countdown.png"] 

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/0qmpulbw/button_forums.png"]            [img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ssnnkg11/button_discord.png"]


[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/whllj3np/bottom.gif"]

notes.title: Inactive Character Clean-Up Notice
notes.content:
Hello Maplers,

Thank you for your continued support and passion for MapleStory. To ensure a smoother and more comfortable game experience for everyone, we will be conducting a character clean-up by flagging inactive characters for removal. This flagging process will begin on September 24, 2025 (after maintenance) and will continue until November 12, 2025 (before maintenance). Characters that remain flagged after this date will be permanently deleted after the maintenance on November 12, 2025. Please refer to the conditions below for more details on whether your characters may be affected.


Character Flagging Conditions

Lv. 61 or lower.

The character has not logged in since September 24, 2022.

The character is not a Guild Leader or Alliance Leader.

The character does not have unclaimed cash items in the Auction House.

To prevent your characters from being deleted, please log onto each world where your character(s) has been flagged at least once between September 24, 2025 (after maintenance) - November 12, 2025 (before maintenance). 


Thank you,
- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: v.262 - Midnight Carnival: Mu Lung Update Preview
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/97f2f50b17ec0e89a853de621e1aa42f180da760.jpg"]Spend a night in the town of Sages! The Night Troupe is bringing a festival of dreams and illusions to Mu Lung. Plus, get ready to dive into the new Legion Champion system, where teamwork makes the dream work, and join the Champion Raid to hunt in new territories on Draco Isle. Not only that, Champion Burning is back to help you get ahead of the game! We’ll also be merging NA Interactive Worlds to create a more vibrant and connected experience for you to enjoy.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/24ed4e8553eed5f628677cae33c478dcbd1e5eb7.png"]
The Night Troupe is making their way to Mu Lung, where you can be a full-fledged Festival Designer and turn this festival into a colorful and unforgettable experience! Decorate the festival grounds with Festival Decorating and Designer Rank to unlock special skills and progression perks. You can also earn rewards and progress faster with the Night Troupe Sage Ticket or receive buffs by lighting the Lanterns Bright with Wishes!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/27b2b32c189170fb077c170263fd411b288bd173.png"]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/5c15426d9c1eb7d3ba05f32376d041bad2d3ae61.png"]  The Imperial Knight, Sir Hamselot, is here to support you and your journey to be a Legion Champion! You can assign up to 3 Champions to your Legion Champion team and work your way up the Champion Ranks to give your Champion Insignia extra buffs!  



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/07c4e1499bf156c8b290b2dc16d1982e0746b874.png"]

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/qc3lfu0t/header-champraid.png"]Gather your Legion Champion team because a new territory has arrived, Draco Isle! Join the Champion Raid and complete missions to get through 6 stages of battles against the local dragons. During your battles, your Bond Meter with your Legion Champion team will fill as you fight for a Final Damage increase, making that last blow super effective! 

 [img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/pffdmeus/champion-raid-1.gif"][img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/fz4fyqpn/header-champburning.png"]We’re back with another round of Champion Burning where you can earn EXP across 3 characters within the same world. The Champion Double Up will run in both the main worlds and Challenger Worlds at the SAME time! Keep grinding and you can earn Double Up Coins and rack up various items within the Double Up Coin Shop. 

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/dh4btdgo/champion-burning.png"]

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/sz5fcba1/header-nainteract.png"]Our NA Interactive Worlds are about to get even more lively with the Interactive World Merge taking place August 27th! Prepare to meet new friends as Aurora and Elysium are merging into Scania. You can also take advantage of all the special benefits with our World Merge Event! For more details about the World Merge, click HERE.

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/c0mdtyoe/world-merge-event.png"]

notes.title: Maple Memo: Addressing v.260 and v.261 Issues
notes.content:
[img src="http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5580/181107mm1100ip.jpg"]Hello Maplers, 

First and foremost, we'd like to extend our deepest apologies for the various problems and major gameplay disruptions caused by live server maintenance recently.

While we've made extensive efforts to provide a large amount of content to enjoy throughout the summer, the overall stability fell short of expectations. Internally, we have been reflecting on this matter and are preparing systematic measures to prevent similar issues in the future. 

We also acknowledge that our communication has not been sufficient.

We had intended to share a message sooner, but ongoing issues required our immediate attention. We prioritized resolving the issues and planned to provide a comprehensive update once stability had been restored, rather than causing confusion with frequent partial updates. Unfortunately, this led to a long silence, and we apologize for the delay.

This memo will address the various issues that have taken place and our responses to them.

We are aware that a single message may not be enough to address every concern. Nevertheless, though delayed, we believe it is important to speak openly and provide context regarding the decisions we made and the responses we took at the time. We hope this will alleviate some of the inconvenience you have experienced. 

To begin, we would like to address the following issues that arose after the V.260 and V.261 updates.   

Emergency Maintenance Following the V.260 Update 

Shortly after the V.260 Stargazer update went live, we found a serious error that allowed certain items to be duplicated in select situations. We quickly took the servers offline to conduct emergency maintenance and successfully resolved the root of the issue. However, due to the duplicated items and mesos already in circulation, we determined that the issue could significantly impact game balance and required a full-scale response. When the servers went offline, we conducted a thorough analysis, identified the source of the problem, resolved it, and implemented additional quality assurance for safety. All these steps were all done in real time and ended up taking longer than expected. 

The V.260 update introduced extensive changes to the game's system code, which unexpectedly conflicted with legacy Global MapleStory (GMS) code. This led to an obscure bug that only triggered under a unique condition and was not detected during our standard quality assurance processes. The issue was not identified until the update went live and the first instances began to appear on the live server. To explain, after the update, a specific condition appeared in the system code that caused an overflow error. When players unknowingly took certain actions while this condition was active, it created multiple copies of the same item.  

We conducted a thorough analysis to discover the source of the problem, before retrieving the duplicated items. The affected code was revised in full, and additional quality assurance tests were run to prevent this issue from occurring again. The depth of the investigation along with database-level processing required to retrieve all of the duplicated items took a significant amount of time, which inevitably led to the extended maintenance period.  

Sia Astelle: Hyper Burning MAX 

Another error occurred after the V.260 update where some players were able to designate Sia Astelle as a Hyper Burning MAX character. Although we quickly dealt with the issue, the community raised concerns about fairness. It was pointed out that a few players gained an unfair advantage, that they had not been punished for doing so, and that perhaps all players should be allowed to designate Sia Astelle as a Hyper Burning MAX character. 

We would like to explain what happened and how we came to our decision.  

After investigating, we discovered that a very small number of players were impacted by this error relative to the total player base. We believe being fair and equitable is important when addressing bugs, but we ultimately decided against expanding Hyper Burning MAX to all Sia Astelle characters because doing so would have gone against the intent of our original design. 

In regard to potential penalties, we treated this situation as a separate case from the previous item duplication error due to two factors:
The nature of the error meant it could be triggered accidentally, with no ill intent from players. The overall impact to the game was negligible. Considering this, we decided that it would not be appropriate to punish the players in this instance.We know there were various suggestions regarding this decision, and there was considerable deliberation internally at the time.  We apologize for causing this issue and for the frustration it created due to a lack of sufficient explanation.

Challenger World   

Challenger World was one of the key features of this update. To allow more players to participate, we introduced the Challenger World system to Heroic Worlds for the first time. However, even though we prepared thoroughly, this was our first time implementing Challenger-Heroic Worlds and there were shortcomings in processing the unique specifications of Challenger and Heroic Worlds.  Several issues arose, including Link Skills being unintentionally active, errors in Coin Shop item setups, and the inability to trade Droplet Stones. These problems and others, both big and small, inconvenienced our players.

We have since fixed these issues through maintenance and updates. To make sure future Heroic World updates don’t repeat the same issues, we carefully reviewed potential oversights during version changes and had internal discussions on how we can improve things moving forward. This experience helped us identify additional key areas of consideration when managing complex world-level systems and applying new content. With these learnings, we will strive to provide more stable service in the future.  

Compensation Boxes 

As the development workload grew due to the extended maintenances before and after the V.260 update, fatigue set in, leading to human error during the compensation box distribution process. Regardless of these circumstances, this mistake should not have occurred. We are reviewing and improving our live fix procedures to prevent similar issues from being repeated in the future.  

Over a short period of time, the unplanned compensation box went out to a small number of players. At the time, we considered various responses, including if we should distribute the same rewards to everyone. While we understood the potential value of expanding the rewards, we also had to carefully consider the long-term implications for game balance and operational stability, which is why we ultimately decided not to proceed with that approach. 

We have thoroughly discussed this issue internally and take the community's concerns around fairness seriously. Moving forward, we will give greater care and oversight to our compensation plans and distribution processes to ensure that similar incidents do not happen again. 

Pottable Badges  

In last year's Ride or Die event, we introduced the Chains of Resentment as a limited-time item to help reduce the power gap caused by legacy content. Although it wasn’t a perfect solution, we believe the attempt to reduce the power gap through this approach was generally seen as a step in the right direction by many players. When bringing back Ride or Die, we attempted to apply a similar philosophy by offering a limited-time pottable badge from existing legacy content. However, we overlooked the fact that this item plays a different role than the Frenzy Totem, causing it to be far from what our players expected.

While both were introduced with the goal of reducing the power gap from legacy items, the way we implemented the Shackles of Resentment did not align with your expectations. We should have ensured that we had a deep understanding of player and community sentiments before approaching legacy items. However, our process of prior communications, feedback collection, and understanding overall sentiment was inadequate.  

We deeply apologize for the confusion and disappointment this has caused. 

Recent Preemptive Bans

To quickly stem the spread of fraudulent activity, we took action by preemptively restricting accounts with even slightly suspicious log data and then investigating further. This approach caused some legitimate players to be affected, and we apologize for that. Moving forward, we will make improvements to ensure bans are done more carefully, based on thorough investigation and according to clearly defined criteria. 

Repeated Emergency Maintenances and Maintenance Schedule Changes 

The increased frequency of emergency maintenances, announcements of said maintenances being posted too soon, and last minute schedule changes have caused our players great inconvenience.

Shortly before maintenance began, our internal testing revealed unforeseen errors and risks. In order to prevent further issues, we ended up needing to adjust the schedule and extend the maintenance period. We apologize for the inconvenience and confusion that these oversights caused.

We will strive to improve our internal processes to minimize the need for emergency maintenances and maintenance extensions.

Management of GMS-Exclusive Content  

GMS includes many pieces of original content, and we plan to continue adding exclusive content for our Maplers to enjoy.

Recently, we have seen numerous unverified claims and rumors in the community suggesting that content produced by TEAM GMS will lack future support or maintenance.

However, we promise that the content produced by TEAM GMS, such as Sia Astelle, will continue to be actively serviced alongside our ongoing development efforts.  

Closing Message 

The GMS team has been working hard, through nights and weekends, to address the issues that have arisen and stabilize the game service. 

As GMS has continued down its independent path, we've encountered new kinds of issues stemming from incompatibilities with the code base. This has certainly caused instability, but it has also allowed us to clearly see our shortcomings and determine necessary improvements through discussion. 

As GMS continues to grow, we are actively building out our team to establish long-term stability. Upon reflection, we’ve had to wonder if simultaneously developing GMS-exclusive content alongside our other various efforts was overly ambitious.  However, we want to once again reassure the community that we won't back down from this challenge. We understand that meaningful progress takes time, and we remain committed to making steady improvements, step by step. While it may take time, we are focused on providing a better, more consistent, and enjoyable experience for all players. Your ongoing interest, support, and feedback through various channels are always a great encouragement to us. 

We've prepared a gift to express our sincere apologies.

Please understand that the purpose of this memo is to summarize the recent key issues and address them transparently. We’ll be back to share more about our vision and and what you can look forward to in the future.

We once again sincerely apologize to all our Maplers who experienced inconvenience during this process. We truly appreciate your continued passion and support. 

All the members of TEAM GMS are devoted to providing a better service for our players. 

Thank you, 

- TEAM GMS

notes.title: NA Interactive World Merge Is Coming This August 27!
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/hrdn1yrd/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg

Hey Maplers,

We are excited to announce the NA Interactive World Merge that was mentioned in one of Inkwell’s previous notes. Our goal with this merge is to create a more vibrant and connected experience by encouraging more opportunities for player interaction.

We also want to thank everyone who participated in the world merge survey from March 19th to April 1st. While the majority of the players supported some form of a merge, opinions were split on the number of worlds. After careful review, we’ve decided to move forward with retaining the very first two original worlds, Scania and Bera. We believe this will help create a more balanced population, boost the in-game economy, and improve player interaction, all while keeping our servers stable.

For Maplers whose worlds are affected by this merge, please refer to the details below:
ScheduleAugust 27, 2025 (after maintenance)Target WorldsInteractive worlds, Aurora and Elysium, will be consolidated into Scania.Scania channels will be increased to a total of 30 channels.World Merge FAQ
To help you better prepare for the World Merge, please review the following FAQs during this process. Please note that we will be sharing additional updates and details at a later date.

Does this change how I log in?
Yes. If you were in Aurora or Elysium, you will now log into your new merged world, Scania, from the world selection screen.
What happens when I exceed the max number of 58 character slots?
All character slots from the merging worlds (Scania, Aurora, and Elysium) will be combined, including default slots. Your character display order will be reset.Up to 58 characters will be visible on the character selection screen.If you have more than 58 characters, a Character Selection UI will appear where you must select 58 characters to display. Non-selected characters are not permanently removed but will be temporarily inaccessible until you remove some other characters. This UI will be available until January 2026.If 58 characters are not selected before the UI is removed, the highest level characters will automatically be displayed.You will not be able to create new characters unless the excess characters have been deleted.
What happens to shared features like Storage, Cash Shop and Auction House?
Storage ItemsStorage slots will be merged up to a maximum of 152 slots. Items beyond the limit will be hidden and can be retrieved by removing existing items.Storage MesosMesos from all merging worlds will be combined up to 499 billion (499,999,999,999) mesos. Excess mesos will be sent as coins via the Gift Drop.Cash InventoryItems beyond the limit will be hidden and will appear as space is available.Auction HouseItems beyond the limit will be hidden until space is available. To buy or sell again, you must move items to your character's inventory.
Will my Guild be affected?
Guild names must be unique per world. If there are duplicates, names will be automatically renamed with random characters.Renamed guilds and alliances will receive a name change UI upon login, and only the Leader can change the name.If your leader is inactive, please contact Player Support.
Will the Maple Rewards Shop purchase limit reset?
No, the purchase limit will not reset with the merge.The next reset will occur with the start of the next calendar month.

We hope these changes allow players in the newly merged worlds to participate in more community activities. We’ll be updating this post as we receive more information. For live updates, join our official Discord server here!

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: [Update July 22] Ride or Die Returns!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/267bceb59cbddfc022d0584e6b42d5e10ef29928.png"]

\[Updated July 22] Note: The final score and participation count for Week 1 will be calculated from July 16 (after maintenance) - July 22 at 11:59 PM UTC.

Kazax has returned to MapleStory with new powers, and Inspector Libae is enlisting your help in battling against this even greater threat! Call upon Althea in battle, harness the power of the Mapae, and earn prizes with each week's boss battle! Take on Kazan himself as the battlefield heats up. Don't forget the new Rank X challenge to test your prowess!

Event Duration:

PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, July 16, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, August 26, 2025 4:59 PM

CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, July 16, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 27, 2025 1:59 AM

AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, July 16, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 27, 2025 9:59 AM
Ride or Die
Quick Overview

Take on up to 5 bosses each week by choosing your difficulty level and setting challenges.

Requirement: Lv. 200 and above (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).

The higher the difficulty and number of challenges, the greater the rewards will be and a higher final score you'll receive!

Earn rewards like Inspector Coins, Kazax’s Energy Fragments, and weekly Inspector Supply Boxes based on your final score.

How to Participate

Select ‘Ride or Die’ from the Event List and click ‘Participate’ to start the Ride or Die event.

Upon accepting the quest, you’ll be teleported to the event map, where you’ll meet Libae, a new inspector who urgently needs your help to save Maple World!

Setting Boss Difficulty and Challenges

Face off against up to 5 bosses per week by choosing your difficulty and how many challenges you want to take on. The 5 bosses you can challenge are:

Papulatus

Vellum

Horntail

Darknell

Magnus

There are four difficulties to choose from:

Code B: Easy

Code A: Normal

Code S: Hard

Code X: Extreme

Code X Requirements: Only your weapon, secondary weapon, and emblem can be equipped for this challenge. Swapping equipment will be disabled during battle.

Test your strength and limits in Code X to earn the highest reward box and a large number of Kazax fragments! With different bosses and fewer challenges this time, Code X is the perfect chance to push for a high score.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/05ca96d5ad560acb318a1f67835903343a30b342.png"]

Ready for a challenge? You can set up to 15 challenges and one will be randomly assigned to you during each run. The following challenges are available:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/b52a8f4396824dcafd92b9476e4bc11112b44a30.png"]

The score multiplier for challenges have been increased, so the more challenges you take on, the higher your weekly score will be!

You have a total of 20 lives shared across all 5 bosses per week. If you lose them all, you’re done for the week!

Use Practice Mode to familiarize yourself with the bosses! Speak with Libae to adjust the difficulty level and challenges as needed.

Practice Mode is unavailable for Code X difficulty.

An Investigation Result summary will appear when you successfully defeat a boss, showing your current Investigation Score and Weekly Score. Scores are calculated based on:

Chosen difficulty

Number of challenges set

Death count

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/6ce2f6ef14693e8e7388777f05a26395e13b6f41.png"]

Althea's Support

Althea is here to support you during fights! Once inside the boss map, you’ll receive Althea’s Support, a special skill that charges support up to Lv. 3 as you fight.

Charge the skill by collecting support! The more support you receive, the more powerful Althea’s Support skill effect will be!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/be38044964187919cfccaf82c41c892ef1123388.png"]

The amount of support required to charge each level is 150.

For every 15 support gained, one skill gauge slot fills.

Receive a small amount of support at regular intervals.

Receive a great amount of support when your character touches a summoned object.

The object spawns at a random location every 30 seconds and disappears after a certain amount of time.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/5098ad28dab86395dcab90d2c039b64552289182.png"]

Once the gauge is full, press the Interact key to activate one of Althea’s support skills at random. These help clear summoned enemies and disrupt Kazax’s interference.

Right-click the skill icon to toggle between automatic or manual activation.

Kazax's Interference

Kaxaz isn’t going to fight fair, so stay sharp! He’ll appear alongside bosses and randomly uses skills that interfere with your fight.

Weekly Total Score Rewards

Defeat bosses to also earn usable items and Silver, Bronze, or Gold Inspector Coins which can be spent at the Coin Shop for exclusive rewards!

Each week after the event reset, you'll receive a Weekly Total Score which will determine:

Which Inspector's Supply Box you receive

How many Kazax's Energy Fragments you earn

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/957c1d5fb88a3a3b308c3a3774e40eaaa1b5431c.png"]

There are six levels of Inspector’s Supply Boxes that can be obtained. Score higher to receive higher-level boxes.

You can only claim 1 box a week per account. Rewards can only be claimed after the event weekly reset.

Rewards for Week 6 can be claimed immediately after completing that week's challenge.

notes.title: Violet and Unicube Potential Stat Error and Compensation
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/hrdn1yrd/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg

Hello Maplers,

We have identified an error where the Legendary 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat was obtainable using Violet Cubes and Unicubes.

In the v.237 update, we implemented a change where the Legendary Potential stat ‘Boss Damage +30%’ would no longer be obtainable when using Red Cube, Black Cube, Meister’s Cube, Unicube, Violet Cube, and Cube of Equality. However, we have identified an error starting in v.239 where the Potential stat was still obtainable when using only Violet Cubes and Unicubes. We sincerely apologize for this oversight.

We plan to resolve this in the v.261 update and provide compensation for affected players, as outlined below.

Converting Potential Stats for Affected Legendary Equipment
The Legendary 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat will no longer be obtainable using Violet Cubes and Unicubes, and will be removed.For players who obtained the Legendary 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat using Violet Cubes and Unicubes and still have the affected equipment, the stat will be replaced with the 'Boss Damage +35%' Potential stat.Equipment that obtained the Legendary 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat before the v.237 update will remain as is.The Unique 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat will remain as is.
Violet Cube and Unicube Compensation Details
Violet Cube and Unicube will be issued as compensation for affected players on July 16, 2025 (after maintenance) through the Gift Drop.Players who obtained the Legendary 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat for the first time using Violet Cubes and Unicubes will be compensated with the number of cubes used from that point onward, up to the last cube used.The number of compensated cubes will be calculated based on the quantity used during each promotional sale period and within the valid usage window for those cubes.The total quantity includes cubes used when the Legendary 'Boss Damage +30%' Potential stat was first obtained.For Violet Cubes, the quantity will be based on when the stat appeared, not when the player selected it.For Unicubes, only cubes used to obtain the stat will be considered, excluding those used just for changing the line.
We apologize for the inconvenience, and thank you for your continued support and patience as we work to make things right.

-The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Notice Regarding Emergency Maintenance and Account Sanctions
notes.content:
[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/hrdn1yrd/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg"]Hello Maplers,

We know many of you have been looking forward to the v.260 update, and we sincerely apologize for the unexpected downtime and delays. After the update, we discovered serious issues involving meso and item duplication, which required an emergency maintenance so we could thoroughly investigate. We want to assure you that we are taking this matter very seriously.

We have already taken action against accounts that deliberately exploited these issues which negatively affected the game.

Here’s how we are addressing the exploits:


Meso and Item Duplication
We have identified exploits involving the duplication of mesos and items that undermine the integrity of the game. 228 accounts have been permanently banned, and any duplicated items and mesos are to be removed.


Content Repetition
We also identified players who intentionally exploited boss content and Demon Slayer-related content, which is against our Terms of Service. 233 accounts have been temporarily banned, and the length of each ban depends on severity. Items that were intentionally claimed multiple times are to be removed.


This investigation is ongoing and will require some time to fully complete. During this process, we will remove exploited items and issue player bans as needed.

notes.title: [Updated 6/10] Prepare for the Hyperion World Leap Event coming June 11
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2098/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg

Hi Maplers,

The high population in Kronos has recently brought about technical challenges and difficulties in maintaining a stable and comfortable gaming environment. In an effort to provide this, we have prepared a special event allowing players to leap from Kronos to Hyperion. By offering this option, we aim to address the inconveniences caused by the excessive population density in Kronos and revitalize Hyperion, thereby fostering better overall server balance and a more enjoyable gaming experience.

The Hyperion World Leap Event will be available during the upcoming Stargazer updates, and we have prepared additional perks for those choosing to leap so that they can quickly adjust to their new world.  

Event Period: June 11, 2025 (after the maintenance) - August 26, 2025 11:59 PM UTC

Requirements: Characters on Kronos Lv. 101 and above (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2) created prior to June 11, 12:00 AM UTC. 

Perk 1: Legion Leap Box
The Legion Leap Box allows players to carry over progress for Legion Coins, Artifact Points, and Artifact EXP to the new world![Updated 6/10] Talk to Mover in Henesys and select "Create Legion Leap Box" to create the item. Only one Legion Leap Box can be created per account, and is tradable within account. It can be used until September 2, 2025 at 11:59 PM.Once created, the Legion Leap Box stores the following from your current world:The amount of Legion Coins you had when the Legion Leap Box was created.Up to 20,000 Legion Artifact Points.The Artifact Points will be distributed after the artifact points has been reset.100% of your Legion Artifact EXP. The Legion Artifact EXP will be distributed after the artifact level has been reset.Legion Artifact stats and grade status will not carry over.If you use the Legion Leap Box without leaping to Hyperion, any stored Legion Coins, Artifact Points, and Artifact EXP will be returned to their original state from the time of creation.After you've leaped to Hyperion and used the box, click the 'Sync Artifact Special Mission' button to unlock special missions related to your Legion Artifact.
Perk 2: Players who World Leap from the new Challenger World to Hyperion will receive additional rewards for reaching Emerald and Diamond tiers:
Ultimate Legion Growth Potion x15 (instead of 10)
Perk 3: Hyperion World Perks
June 11, 2025 after the maintenance - June 14, 2025 at 11:59 PM UTC +100% Rune EXP buff effect (3x normal EXP)+300% Combo Kill EXP2x EXP for Pollo, Fritto, and Especia Bounty Hunting2x Inferno Wolf Exit EXP2x chance for new Monster Collection monsters1.5x Item Drop Rate
[Updated 6/10] Before you leap from Kronos to Hyperion, here are a few important things to keep in mind to make sure your transfer goes smoothly.
Guilds and AlliancesGuild leaders must disband or leave their guild first.You must leave your guild or alliance before transferring.This includes pending guild applications.Storage RestrictionsDelivery Package StorageHired MerchantNPC FredrickRetrieve and collect any items before transferring from the following:You won’t be able to retrieve these items after transferring!Cash ItemsCash items in your character inventory will transfer. However, items in your Cash Shop Inventory will NOT, so don’t for get to move them over!You can transfer even if the world you’re moving to has no empty character slots—unless you already have 58 characters there. If you do, you’ll need to delete a character to make space before transferring.Zero characters can’t be transferred if they were created before June 11, 2025 at 12:00 AM UTC, or if they haven’t completed Story Quest Chapter 2.In-game rankings or regularly updated game progression records such as Mu Lung ranking, Donation King, or Tower of Oz will not transfer.

We will be implementing changes to certain in-game features and would like to provide some information for what you can expect from these changes:

The refund amount will be based on the Easter Basket the item was obtained from:Large Mysterious Easter Basket: 3,000 Maple PointsSmall Mysterious Easter Basket: 1,000 Maple PointsRefunds will be processed in 2 waves:Wave 1: During the maintenance on June 11, 2025.Wave 2: During a future maintenance in August 2025.More details to follow in the future.Please note the following:Custom Titles will not function after the v.260 game update and we ask to refrain from using the Custom Title Coupon after the update.If you used a Custom Title Coupon to receive a Custom Title, you are eligible for refund in August.If you have a Medal Fusion Anvil Coupon or Medal Fusion Anvil, they will retain their functionality and still can be used.Removal of Teleport Rocks from the Cash ShopAs part of a revamp to the way players navigate around the game, will be ending the sale of Teleport Rocks, Hyper Teleport Rocks, and VIP Teleport Rocks through the Cash Shop starting after the maintenance on June 11, 2025. Players who currently have Teleport Rocks of any kind, including permanent ones, will still be able to use them alongside the revamp after the maintenance. Their functionality will remain unchanged from before the v.260 game update.New Style Box Stamp ShopWe will be introducing a new type of Style Box Stamp, along with its very own Style Box Stamp Shop that you can look forward to in the Stargazer update.Without spoiling any surprises, this upcoming change will affect the way Surprise Style Box items can be exchanged for stamps. So please carefully observe the details below:Items obtained from Surprise Style Boxes AFTER June 25, 2025 at 8:00 AM UTC can ONLY be exchanged for stamps that will be used in the new Style Box Stamp Shop.Items obtained from Surprise Style Boxes BEFORE June 25, 2025 at 8:00 AM UTC can ONLY be exchanged for stamps in the current Style Box Stamp Shop.The existing Style Box Stamp Shop through NPC Shiro will remain accessible for any players who own existing Style Box Stamps.The items that can be purchased from the existing Style Box Stamp Shop will be updated after June 25, 2025 8:00 AM UTC.DirectX 11 SupportWe will be introducing DirectX 11 support to provide a more enjoyable gaming experience. As such, DirectX 9 support will be discontinued from this point onward. We ask that you update to DirectX 11.0 or higher to ensure your game runs smoothly as support for DirectX 9 will end after the game update.Troubleshooting - If the game doesn’t launch or you see a DirectX-related error after the update, we recommend checking your system’s DirectX version and updating if needed.To download and update DirectX to the latest version, click HERE.
We hope that everyone will be able to enjoy these changes along with the many others coming in the next Stargazer update. We thank you for your understanding and continued support!

~The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Addressing the Recent Kronos Server Downtime
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/2167/maintenance-1100x225-maplestory.png

Greetings Maplers,

On May 3rd, at 5:19 AM PDT, Kronos servers experienced significant stability issues. To swiftly resolve this issue, the Kronos server was temporarily shut down and restarted for Kronos users to quickly return to the game. 

We understand this issue had a significant impact on some players. We are currently reviewing the cause and will be performing the following in an upcoming Server Maintenance:
Resolve the Steam Market issue leading to the server crash.Enable Steam Market for all users.Provide compensation to impacted Kronos players.
We will have more details to share soon. Please keep an eye on this post for more information on when the maintenance will occur.

Players who experienced a rollback during the time of the server issue, please report it to our Player Support team and we will do our best to respond sincerely to each case.  Please be advised that response times may be affected due to a high volume of support requests. We’ll carefully review each case and appreciate your patience as we work to assist those impacted by the issue.

Thank you everyone for your understanding.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: MapleStory's 20th Anniversary Update is Live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/c6df0c3b6c48d7556e2efc9e27575e80c84bbfb6.png

On May 11, 2005, MapleStory made its debut in North America, and in the 20 years that has come since, it's been our pleasure to watch you enjoy every moment of fun that has come in Maple World. We're celebrating these two decades with a special new update, featuring a new job to play, an exciting sports day event, and a special look at things to come!

Now Available: Mo Xuan!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/4235849a31ffeffc0f4a54a1555b2148c3c6e09b.png

A mighty new warrior has come to MapleStory, a talented martial artist with a power that's been passed down throughout the ages. Play as Mo Xuan, the Divine Fist, MapleStory's newest character and claim your rewards in the Xiao Xiao's Level-Up Support Event!

You can learn more about Mo Xuan, and find out what you can earn by leveling him up, on the official MapleStory website!

Victoria Cup Event
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/10352a63bbe99f431c76a72af544eae3ece2f82e.png

The biggest Sports Day that Victoria Island has ever seen is here! Take on challenging sporting events such as Victoria Soccer, Boat Racing, Balloon Pop Challenge and much more to bring home trophies, unique outfits, and other amazing rewards!

20th Anniversary Patch Notes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/85e287c430194d5f892849afbcdcf1ffc50f6652.jpg

Learn everything about MapleStory's 20th Anniversary update, including the full details on the Victoria Cup, the newly added Grandis Familiars, a more convenient way to jump between characters on the same world, and more in the patch notes on the official MapleStory website!

Read the latest Inkwell's Note!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0bf64ab1e82074b60ef490e5162dad056b986da4.png

Inkwell, MapleStory's Chief Product Officer, also recently penned a note to the MapleStory community, talking about the 20th anniversary, the last few months of updates, as well as a preview of all the changes and improvements we're looking to add to MapleStory soon. You can read it in full on the official MapleStory website!

notes.title: Additional Information on Issues Related to Cash Shop
notes.content:
Greetings Maplers,

Thank you very much for your enthusiastic interest in the v258 Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Collaboration patch with Steam Market, Auto-Harvesting, and other new features which came on March 19th.

In addition, we sincerely apologize for not providing a smooth playing environment due to errors and unscheduled maintenances.

Following our announcement about the Philosopher’s Book issue yesterday, we conducted an additional review internally and newly confirmed the two problems below.

We will explain the resolution and how we plan to address the following issues.

1. April Fool's SSB Rewards Pre-Applied to 2025 Version

It has been confirmed that the rewards for the upcoming April Fool's SSB, scheduled to be sold on March 26 were pre-applied with the patch on March 19. While the box has not been officially sold yet, players in Heroic Worlds were able to obtain an April Fool’s SSB through the Philosopher’s Book. As a result, any April Fool’s SSB used after March 19 gave the 2025 April Fool’s rewards and the probability rates can be found through the following link. This does mean some players have gotten new April Fool’s items early.

If you have used an April Fool's Day SSB from March 19 to before this notice and you are not satisfied with the items you received, please contact Player Support and we will process the refunds according to our policy.

2. An issue related to Pet Equipment in Heroic World

Among the Pet Equipment is Lil Nezuko's Ribbon equipment, an item that does not change her appearance. While this is noted in the item tooltip, we understand that this has caused confusion for our players, particularly in Heroic Worlds. Since the item does not have any effect, we have decided to stop selling the Nezuko Pet Equipment in Heroic World.

If you purchased Lil Nezuko’s Ribbon in Heroic World and would like a refund, please contact Player Support and we will process your request after retrieving the item.

Once again, we apologize for the inconvenience.

Our MapleStory Team is always listening and closely monitoring feedback from all players through various communities. We are committed to identifying and resolving issues as quickly as possible, and we continue to strive for a better MapleStory.

Thank you.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Introducing Steam Community Market (Beta)
notes.content:
Hi Maplers, 

We are excited to announce that the v.258 update will include a beta feature enabling the trading of various cosmetic items through the Steam Community Market. Access to this functionality will be available in-game and will include the ability to manage or add items into your respective Steam Inventory!

What is the Steam Community Market?
A dedicated marketplace within the Steam platform, where players can trade items using the Steam Wallet.The value of Steam marketplace items is determined by player transactions and prices may fluctuate according to supply and demand.Items that can be traded have no impact on in-game balance, and players neither lose nor gain anything even if they do not purchase any items. 

Trading Guidelines:
Eligible Accounts
Nexon accounts linked with a Steam account can access the in-game Steam Inventory UI.The linked Steam account must meet Steam's eligibility requirements for using the Steam Community Market.Once your Steam account is linked, you can still access your Steam Inventory UI in the game even if you launch MapleStory through the Nexon Launcher.
Target Worlds & Regions
Trades can be made in both Interactive and Heroic Worlds, and can even be made between Interactive and Heroic Worlds.Trades can be made in both North America and Europe regions, and can even be made between the two regions. 
Target Items

In order to trade items from Global MapleStory, Oswell’s Scissors of Karma must be used to move an item from your inventory to your Steam Inventory.Only items that have been moved to your Steam Inventory can be viewed in the Steam Community Market storage.

notes.title: Addressing the Recent Unicube Issues
notes.content:
http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2098/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg

Hello Maplers,

We apologize for the delayed response regarding the Unicube issue that occurred on February 22nd in Interactive Worlds. We have been reviewing the Unicube usage logs, examining the list of fraudulent users, and examining the list of items that were abnormally enhanced. We ask for your understanding as this analysis takes time to ensure an accurate response and resolution.

Below is our planned course of action:
[olist]In order to prevent the further spread of problematic items on the server, we will be temporarily withdrawing abnormally enhanced items during today’s emergency maintenance.After thorough investigation, additional measures will be taken against users who have misused the Unicube.Once we’ve completed the investigation, compensation for the emergency maintenance will be provided.Retrieved items will be restored. If needed, there may be additional measures taken such as rolling items back to their state prior to Unicube usage and returning Unicubes where appropriate. [/olist]
We are committed to strengthening our internal development processes to prevent such incidents from occurring again and to minimize any inconvenience for our MapleStory players. Once again, we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: MapleStory Worlds Europe and Mobile Soft Launch!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/5688c4017aae43a5c5cfa8958db4718e32f39303.jpg

The MapleStory Worlds Soft Launch rolls on and is now available in Europe and on mobile devices! Introducing an exciting new way to play and create - MapleStory Worlds is here with powerful tools to design your own adventures and enjoy the creations of your fellow Maplers, and Maplers in Europe and on mobile devices can now join the fun!

Learn more at the MapleStory Worlds website!

[previewyoutube=qT_cgEgHObw;full][/previewyoutube]

What is MapleStory Worlds?
Immerse yourself in a whole new way to experience MapleStory! MapleStory Worlds is a dynamic platform where Players and Creators unite to explore custom-crafted Worlds and avatars. With robust worldbuilding tools and access to over 30 million MapleStory Assets, Creators can design immersive experiences that captivate players globally - and earn rewards for their unique creations.

Unleash Your Creativity

Discover the stories of our Creators who have transformed their passions into playgrounds! Join this thriving community using the MapleStory Worlds platform to bring diverse visions to life. Learn more in the Creator Center!

Dive into a Vibrant Community

Experience the nostalgia of old-school MapleStory or dive into vibrant worlds crafted by our very own Creators. Each World available on the platform offers unique adventures and endless excitement! Learn more in the Play Worlds page!

Join the Creator Circle

Apply for our exclusive Creator Circle! We developed this ongoing monthly program to amplify the work of promising Creators like yourself. Take your world to the next level with promotional and technical support, mentorship from the MapleStory Worlds team, and a $3,500 USD monthly stipend. Learn more in the Creator Circle post!

Available Regions and Platforms

MapleStory Worlds is now soft-launching in Europe in addition to North and South America. Players in the available regions can also play and create on Windows PC, Mac (Beta), and Mobile platforms! We plan on expanding MapleStory Worlds to additional regions later this year.

notes.title: New Name Auction
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/499bb49a887d2b2d442202ab8b36e8b59594dcda.jpg

Ready to trade names? Sell off your characters' old names or find a new one with this special opportunity! Names will be available to buy or sell with Maple Points over the next four weeks. Check out the full details below!
New Name Auction
Event Duration:
PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, February 11, 2025 3:59 PMCET (UTC +1): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 12, 2025 12:59 AMAEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 12, 2025 10:59 AM
Event Details:
You can enter the New Name Auction by selecting 'New Name Auction' from the Event List and clicking ‘Participate’ or you can speak with Mr. Newname, located in major towns like Henesys.Requirement: Lv. 10 and above characters (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).You will be able to make transactions from Interactive and Heroic worlds!Completed trade history is stored until June 10 at 11:59 PM UTC. Names and Maple Points from sales that aren't claimed during the storage period will disappear so make sure you claim them before then!You can have up to 5 character name transactions (selling or bidding).Now, let’s start off by reviewing some major auction terms that you’ll need know before you begin![table][tr][td]Auction Terms[/td][td]Description[/td][/tr][tr][td]Bid[/td][td]The act of writing and entering the desired amount by one who wishes to purchase a character name for sale.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Minimum Bid[/td][td]The desired price that the seller wrote when registering the character name.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Current Bid[/td][td]The desired price the buyer enters by raising the bid by at least the minimum bid amount.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Successful Bid[/td][td]The trade is completed if the bid submitted by the buyer is the highest amount at the end of the sale.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Failed Bid, Unsuccessful Bid[/td][td]Your bid gets canceled because someone else made a successful bid with an amount higher than the 'Current Bid' that you entered.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Registration Deposit[/td][td]The amount automatically deducted when you start selling character names, which is 5% of the minimum bid.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Name Change Fee[/td][td]Amount paid to Mr. Newname when changing character names.[/td][/tr][/table]Now that you know the terminology, we can go over how to sell and bid on character names.
How to Sell Character Names:
Enter the New Name Auction and start by entering your desired bid, duration, and a new character name.Please note that character names that have started selling cannot be canceled or changed midway.The minimum bid starts at 50,000 Maple Points, and the registration deposit and name change fee are deducted at the time of registration.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/d32fed79a396cebc9547139c924ad2d8b9a5dd6e.png
You can keep tabs on your current sale of character names by clicking the [Selling] button in the ‘Your Trades’ tab.When the character name sale is finished, you can check the results by clicking the [End Trade] button in the 'Your Trades' tab.Transaction fees of 30% are deducted at the time of payment collection.Registration deposits are refunded if the sale is successful.If the registered character name was not sold, you can pay an additional registration deposit and re-list the name for sale or you can either return or claim your name back.Name change fees are non-refundable regardless of whether the sale was successful or not.You can claim your payment for the sold character name by clicking the [Collect] button in the ‘End Trade’ tab.Character names that were won while the New Name Auction was open, cannot be re-sold during the event period. 
How to Purchase Character Names:
Need to get a hold of that name? Head to the ‘New Name Auction’ UI and search for the character name you want in the search bar at the top left, or you can look through other name options from the ‘Character Names for Sale’ from the search tab.Enter your desired bid amount and submit.The bidding price must be increased by at least the minimum bid amount.If your bid is unsuccessful, both the bid deposit and the name change fee will be refunded to you. Although, you will not be able to cancel after placing your bid.You can keep tabs on your current character bids by clicking the [Bidding] button in the ‘Your Trades’ tab.In the ‘Bidding’ tab, you can see the current highest bid for each available character name. If your bid is the highest, it will be labeled 'Highest Bid.' If another player bids higher, you can either increase your bid or back out.If you have won the Highest Bid, you can claim the name in the ‘End Trade’ tab.Upon claiming the character name, your currently logged-in character's name will be immediately updated. The previous name will be permanently removed.After your name change, you'll have to wait a week before you can change your new name with Mr. Newname.Please note that once the change is complete, you cannot restore your previous name.
Please note:
The New Name Auction is unavailable in Burning World. Character names that break the naming policy will have their transaction forcefully canceled or changed.The name change fees and deposits will not be refunded. You can find other 'New Name Auction' related notes in the 'Please check all cautions' tab.

notes.title: Champion Burning Event
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/56a92caabf0cf95920d232e4d13fc1416217e305.png

Double it and give it to the next person? Let’s take it further - double the rewards for not just one but two characters at once! Set one character as your Leader and benefit two other characters at the same time, tripling the EXP you're earning overall and earning special rewards from the Champion Burning Coin Shop as well, featuring a selection of items to help your boosted characters keep their gear in top shape!
Champion Burning Double UpPST/PDT (UTC -8/-7): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, March 18, 2025 4:59 PMCET (UTC +1): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, March 19, 2025 12:59 AMAEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, March 19, 2025 10:59 AM
Event Details:
Requirements: Lv. 101 and above characters who have completed the ‘[Champion Burning] Your Champion and Mine’ quest (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).Select ‘Champion Burning’ from the Event List and click ‘Participate’ to start the Champion Burning Double Up event.Alternatively, accept the ‘[Champion Burning] Your Champion and Mine’ quest by talking to Dame Appropriation.Participation is limited to one world per account, so choose wisely!
Designating Characters:
Open the Champion Burning UI and press the ‘Designate’ button.The first Champion designated becomes the Leader, and 2 other characters can be designated as Champions.The Leader can be changed once a week from your designated Champions.When switching Leaders, any unused Double Up EXP Points from the current Leader will be lost.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/8da27f1aa0c008298a6c8f7b5263f0261560c30b.png
Once designated, there will be a visual effect where Champions are following the Leader. The effect activates automatically when changing maps or logging back in.This effect can be toggled on/off through the Skills UI in the Beginner’s tab.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/b124868f507195978171db2b40fd9bad227a60ff.gif

Note: If the Leader has World Leaped, a different character can be designated as the Leader in Burning World to participate in the event again.

Double Up EXP Points:
When the Leader defeats monsters near their level (20 levels below and 20 levels above), the other Champions receive 1 Double Up EXP Point for every monster defeated.Monster defeats only count when in a solo party or not in a party at all.Monster defeats will count when summoning monsters with VIP Booster.Double Up EXP Points are evenly distributed among the Champions, with a weekly cap of 100,000 points.Log in as each Champion to claim and use the earned EXP points.Double Up EXP Points can be used on Mega Burning, Tera Burning, and Hyper Burning characters.
Note: If the Leader has World Leaped and the remaining Champions in Burning World are not transferred, those Champions cannot use Double Up EXP Points or access the Double Up Coin Shop.

Double Up Coins:
The Leader can complete Double Up check-ins to earn Double Up Coins by defeating 2,000 monsters near their level (20 levels above or 20 levels below).Check-in 3 times a week, up to a total of 24 times.Only the Leader can click the ‘Claim’ check-in button.Monster defeats only count when in a solo party or not in a party at all.For each check-in, all Champions receive 2,500 Double Up Coins.Coins and purchases in the Double Up Coin Shop are saved for existing Champions but are not shared among characters.Spend 3,000 Maple Points to use a Double Up Pass for missed check-in days.All Champions will receive 2,500 Double Up Coins, for each Double Up Pass used.
Note: Double Up EXP Points and Double Up Check-in weekly records reset every Thursday at 12:00 AM UTC.
Champion Burning Double Up Coin ShopPST/PDT (UTC -8/-7): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, March 18, 2025 4:59 PMCET (UTC +1): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, March 19, 2025 12:59 AMAEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, January 15, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, March 19, 2025 10:59 AM
Event Details:
Open the Champion Burning UI and press the ‘Open Shop’ button to open the shop.Requirements: Lv. 101 and above characters designated as Champion (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).Double Up Coins are specific to each Champion character and the quantity limit for items are limited to individual purchases per character. The quantity limit isn’t shared with all Champions together; it is instead applied for each individual Champion character.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/3d0eb9dffd5f511cf13d5d82df663009f0c707ff.png

notes.title: Notice Regarding Ghastly the Snowman Reward Issue
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

An issue where the Steadfast Child Gift Box rewarded from the Ghastly the Snowman event could be claimed repeatedly has been fixed. Upon further investigation of the issue, we discovered there were many instances of players that took advantage of the bug and abused it to receive rewards in excess of the intended amounts. Therefore, the following actions have been taken against these players in accordance with our policies: 

[olist]
Any accounts with more Steadfast Child Gift Boxes than what can normally be obtained per day have had their remaining boxes removed.
Accounts that exploited this issue will be reviewed and actions will be taken according to our policies.
[/olist]
The Steadfast Child Gift Boxes will be re-enabled on December 20 after maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience to gameplay caused during this investigation, and will provide 30 Steadfast Child Gift Boxes to all players. These boxes can be claimed through the Gift Drop until December 22 at 23:59 UTC.

We would like to take this opportunity to remind players that exploiting in-game bugs for personal gain is strictly against our Terms of Service. We ask players to take care and avoid being penalized by refraining from such activities.

Thank you for your understanding and patience as we work to resolve this issue.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: v.256 Known Issues
notes.content:
Hi Maplers,

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you'll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.256 - The Dark Ride: Limbo update:

Known Issues:
CommonUsing the 'Skip' feature during a boss battle may sometimes increase the boss's attack frequency significantly. To prevent this while we investigate the issue, we recommend not using the 'Skip' option during boss fights.
Resolved Issues:

Added the ability for pets to add the “Ferocious Eternal Armor Box” and the “Divine Eternal Armor Box” to the pet pick-up item exception list.

Fixed the issue where some characters were unable to leave the "Dark Maplemas Eve" map through the exit portal.
Fixed the issue where the "[Luna Crystal] Fairy Tale Tea Time" quest was not appearing after equipping a pet from the Petite Luna pet series.
Fixed the issue where Neville was not selling Gold Emblems for Kanna, Hayato and Lynn characters.
Fixed the issue preventing some players from entering the Ghastly the Snowman portal.
Fixed the issue where Ornaments were dropping after 100 were collected for the “Do You Fear What I Fear?” event.
Fixed the issue causing the “Ghastly the Snowman” portal to appear after the 3 time limit per day has been reached.
Fixed the issue where the ‘?’ button in the “Do You Fear What I Fear?” event UI was displaying incorrect text.
Fixed the issue where Kanna characters were unable to complete the "[Silent Crusade] Strange Letter" quest.
Fixed the issue causing the Explorer Title's frame to display incorrectly when used with a Custom Title.
Fixed the issue where players could continue fighting Limbo after reaching 1,000 Erosion while Dawn Shield or Altered Fate was active.December 17, 2024Fixed the issue where the Wicked Wonderland event reward text was incorrect.Fixed the issue where Hyper Burning characters were unable to use Magnificent Growth Potions and Typhoon Growth Potions obtained from the Dark Maplemas box.Fixed the issue where the 'Do You Fear What I Fear?' ornament count would reset upon logging in again.Fixed the issue where the entry count for Ghastly the Snowman would reset upon logging in again.

notes.title: Dark Maplemas Events!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/aa7d8538363c768f7410093bdb76e771a68a4780.png

'Tis the season for Maplemas, and two visitors from across the dimensional rift have brought their own special flavor of the holiday for all Maplers to enjoy! This Maplemas might be a touch darker than you're used to, but Holly and Jolly have brought plenty of presents, games, and more to enjoy during the darkest time of the year (for those in the northern hemisphere)!
Dark Maplemas Event DurationPST (UTC -8): Tuesday, December 17, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, January 14, 2025 3:59 PMCET (UTC +1): Tuesday, December 17, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, January 15, 2025 12:59 AMAEDT (UTC +11): Tuesday, December 17, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, January 15, 2025 10:59 AMSlay Ride
Take Holly and Jolly's special sleigh on a race through the snow, dodging seasonal tombstones and blowing past festive coffins, as you deliver presents at top speed!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/6153fb7c6b9ec1e9bf1149d1a418871027e02cbf.png

Use the Left and Right keys to switch between lanes to avoid the tombstones, the Use/Interact key to knock down the caskets in your way, and collect the "RIDE" letters for a brief period of invulnerability! You'll earn special prizes the longer you travel, including the Sleigh Chair and Jolly Totem (90-day duration). Check out the full details below!

Event Details:
Complete the quest '[Dark Maplemas] Slay Ride' through the Event List.Requirement: Lv. 101 and above characters (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).After completing the quest, head over to Jolly and accept the ‘[Dark Maplemas] Slay Ride’ quest to begin.There are 3 lanes to maneuver from but be careful of oncoming tombstones and coffins! Use your arrow keys and spacebar to avoid the obstacles.Collect letters to spell out “RIDE” to get a boost increase and become invincible.If you reach 10k meters, you will receive:Mighty Child Present Box (x2): Click here to view the possible reward items.EXP Voucher (x200)You can claim these rewards from Jolly in the Dark Maplemas Eve map.Up to 50k meters can be reached every week. (No entry count limit before reaching it).

O Holy Fright
Holly and Jolly's arrival in Maple World has brought along some unwelcome tag-alongs, and they need your help to chase them off and save Dark Maplemas!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/7aa5eda83f10419015c29c5179111b6a849ce00a.png

Use Shift to fire your laser at the invading enemies, while dodging their attacks from on high! Your other skills will be disabled for this fight, so make sure to move carefully, beware reinforcements, and catch falling presents for a 7-second attack power boost and invulnerability! Clear the mission and earn your way towards the Fright Totem (90-day duration) and Dark Maplemas Damage Skin, and see the full details below!

Event Details:

Requirement: Lv. 101 and above characters (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).

We must defend Maplemas from Fright, an invader from the outer spheres! Holly and Jolly are relying on us to help save Dark Maplemas from pesky present stealers.
Complete the quest '[Dark Maplemas] O Holy Fright' through the Event List.After completing the quest, head over to Jolly and accept the ‘[Dark Maplemas] O Holy Fright’ quest to begin.Stay on your toes! If you get hit with the barrage you will get damaged. Use your Shift and direction keys to fire at Fright.Keep in mind that your skills will not be available during this quest.There are 3 types of barrages that can cause damage:Basic Barrage: Inflict 10% damage to your health.Confusion: Causes your keyboard directions to invert.Instant Kill Barrage: Inflicts 100% damage to your health.When you defeat Fright you will receive:Mighty Child Present Box (x2): Click here to view the possible reward items.EXP Voucher (x200)You can claim these rewards from Jolly in the Dark Maplemas Eve map.Can be cleared up to 5 times a week. It wouldn't be Maplemas without a tree, even one as... hungry as this one looks. Still, a Maplemas Tree needs decorations, and Holly and Jolly want you to find them throughout your adventures!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/107118d5eabde87e9ddfd0baa825122a782d587c.png

Collect Ornament Boxes by hunting monsters around your level, and when you get 10 of them, you'll be able to place an ornament on the tree and collect a Dark Maplemas Gift Box, containing your choice of progression, EXP, profession, or enhancement rewards. You can collect up to 10 gift boxes every day. See the full details below!

Event Details:
You can join this event by accepting the '[Dark Maplemas] Do You Fear What I Fear?' quest from Holly.Requirement: Lv. 101 and above characters (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).When you defeat monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above), you can collect the dropped Ornament Boxes.You can exchange 10 Ornament Boxes for 1 Tree OrnamentWhen you get 1 Tree Ornament, you will receive a Steadfast Child Present Box!There are a total of 10 Tree Ornaments.Rewards can be claimed once a day per ornament, which means you can get a total of 10 Steadfast Child Present Boxes daily!You can check the Ornament Box quantity, decorations, and claim rewards using the Event UI.

Steadfast Child Present Box: Tradable within world, 30-day duration. Click here to view the possible reward items.
Ghastly The Snowman
♪ Ghastly the Snowman, is a very angry foe, made of snow and hate and magic too great because Holly's portal closed too slow! Ghastly the Snowman, can be fought in his own place, take the portal in and battle to win while you punch him in the face! ♪

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/fc8e2940d28813ff27eefbb0ed9675c864da327c.png

Once you hunt 1,000 monsters around your level, a portal to Ghastly the Snowman's domain will appear, allowing for a fight similar to the Inferno Wolf's Den (only a bit colder). You'll have a minute to take him down with special prizes on the line based on how much damage you do. notes.title: Concerning the Release of Update v.255
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/a6b70cd8537f64c26cd06e6c19665d2b6c35b809.jpg

Hello, Maplers.

First, we'd like to apologize for the unexpected issues and gameplay disruptions that occurred when the v.255 update went live. We understand the severity of this situation, and will learn from it to improve our processes. We remain committed to supporting a stable and high quality play experience.

Below, we will outline the primary issues that occurred with the v.255 update and summarize the current state of affairs.

1. Extended Maintenance

There were several issues pertaining to new content and system updates. The main issues were as follows:
Extended maintenance on the day of the v.255 update: Parts of the game that worked as intended during internal testing suddenly became unplayable when running on live servers. The maintenance was extended beyond what was initially estimated to investigate, fix, and retest these issues.Crashes and additional maintenance: There were several crashes after the v.255 update went live:Server crashes when generating certain rewards upon defeating an enemy. Due to the frequency of the crashes, a maintenance was required to implement a quick fix.Server crashes when the Guardian Angel Slime would finish a boss pattern and then vanish.Client crashes when Shade used Soul Splitter while fighting Ursus.Aside from crashes, there was also an issue where a long quest was being finished quickly due to Black Mage Remnants erroneously remaining on a drop table. Separately, many rare boss rewards that should not have been affected by the drop rate increase were affected. Given the effect these issues would have on game balance and fairness to our players, it was clear we needed to take urgent action.Aside from the issues noted above, there was also an additional maintenance done to address the unintended functionality of the Frenzy Totem, rewards not being generated when Zero characters defeated a boss, and other issues with the new Ride or Die content.
2. Content Issues
Removal of certain Page of Memories mini-games:During internal testing, we discovered that the Spirit's Memories and Spirit's Emotions mini-games were causing extreme lag in most Global MapleStory service regions. The lag was severe enough that normal gameplay was being adversely affected. In these mini-games, a new sync method called "Lockstep" was used. However, this method was not well-suited to some environments with the network ping conditions of regions where Global MapleStory is serviced. Considering the limited time the live service team had to address the issue, the decision was eventually made to remove the affected mini-games for the sake of stability. To compensate, the EXP Vouchers that would have been granted by these mini-games were instead added to the Ride or Die Inspector Boxes. However, we overlooked the fact that the Ride or Die reward is given a week after the patch, and that players weren't made aware of that fact. We apologize for the confusion this has caused, and will strive to be more clear in the future.Please be aware that EXP Vouchers will also be obtainable from the Burning Express event and Dark Maplemas mini-game in the v.256 update.Changes to the Intense Power Crystal:A change was made to the number of Intense Power Crystals that can be sold each week. However, the proper price adjustments were not made, causing a dip in some players' meso earnings.We are actively considering additional changes that will be applied during maintenance on Dec. 5, 2024. We apologize for the delay in confirming these changes.Other Issues:We are aware that there are other issues not listed here. We will do our best to fix as many as we can in the upcoming maintenance on Dec. 5, 2024.
To apologize for any inconvenience you may have experienced, we've prepared the following compensation package for you.

Server Maintenance Compensation
Claim Period: Wednesday, November 27, 2024 1:25 AM UTC- Tuesday, December 10, 2024 11:59 PM UTCHow to Claim: Talk to the Maple Administrator NPC in the Event Hall map, and select Server Maintenance Compensation to claim. (Limit once per account.)Package Contents:[table][tr][th]Item[/th][th]Count[/th][th]Duration (Days)[/th][th]Tradability[/th][/tr][tr][td]3x EXP Coupon (15 min)[/td][td]x15[/td][td]7[/td][td]Untradable[/td][/tr][tr][td]Special Medal of Honor[/td][td]x10[/td][td]7[/td][td]Untradable[/td][/tr][tr][td]Symbol Selector Coupons. Select one of the below:Arcane Symbol Selector Coupon (100)Sacred Symbol Selector Coupon (25)[/td][td]x1[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][tr][td]Trait Boost Potion[/td][td]x3[/td][td]7[/td][td]Untradable[/td][/tr][tr][td]Extreme Growth Potion[/td][td]x5[/td][td]7[/td][td]Untradable[/td][/tr][tr][td]Growth Potion Selector Coupon. Select one of the below:Growth Potion (200 - 209) (8)Growth Potion (200 - 219) (4)Growth Potion (200 - 229) (2)Typhoon Growth Potion (1)[/td][td]x1[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][tr][td]Karma Black Rebirth Flame[/td][td]x5[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][tr][td]Experience Nodestone[/td][td]x2[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][tr][td]VIP Buff Selector Coupon[/td][td]x3[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][/table]
We know many of you were excited for this update, and we apologize once again for failing to meet your expectations. We will redouble our efforts to prepare and review our work so we can provide better service in the future. Thank you for your understanding.

Thank you,

The MapleStory Team
