notes.title: [Completed] Unscheduled Minor Patch - November 22, 2024
notes.content:
We will be performing an unscheduled minor patch today, November 22, 2024 at 11:00 AM PST (2:00 PM EST / 8:00 PM CET / 6:00 AM AEDT November 23). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 3 hours, concluding around 2:00 PM PST (5:00 PM EST / 11:00 PM CET / 9:00 AM AEDT November 23).

Times:

Friday, November 22, 2024
PST (UTC -8): 11:00 AM - 2:00 PM
EST (UTC -5): 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM 
CET (UTC +1): 8:00 PM - 11:00 PM 

AEDT (UTC +11): 6:00 AM (November 22) - 9:00 AM November 22)
What will be unavailable:All MapleStory game servers.Changes and updates:MapleStory will be updated to v.255.2.0.The following content regarding the Frenzy Totem has been changed:Resolved an issue where the Frenzy Totem and Chains of Resentment mob respawn speed was not applied as intended.Resolved an issue where Frenzy Totem was not able to be cast again in a a map where a Frenzy Totem was used.[Dev Comment] The new Chains of Resentment totem was designed based on the previous Frenzy Totem, but we have confirmed that stats related to mob regen speed wasn't applied as intended. This has caused the overall mob regen speed to drop compared to before, and we apologize for the inconvenience we have caused the players. As notified before, the dev team's intent was to keep the previous Frenzy Totem's mob regen speed and mob regen quantities, and this will apply in the same way to the new Chains of Resentment totems. The Chains of Resentment differs from the Frenzy Totems in whether the effect remains on the map when the caster moves maps, and the effects of the Chains of Resentment disappears when the caster moves maps. In order to prevent disrupting another player on a map where the Chains of Resentment have already been used due to this differentiation, the Chains of Resentment can't be used again on a map where the effect has already been applied. The Frenzy Totem being able to be used on the same map again was an intended mechanic, and any unintended changes after the v255 patch will be fixed with this maintenance, and please understand that the previous specs weren't intended.The Ride or Die Horntail HP has been adjusted.[Dev Comment] The intent behind Ride or Die is to allow characters to defeat bosses based on their strength and earn rewards, thus motivating players to become stronger. This event has 6 types of bosses, and for the Horntail, we have confirmed that its HP is much lower than we first intended. This has allowed players to defeat the Horntail much more easily in Code S difficulty, resulting in an experience different from what we intended. Thus the dev team has decided to increase the Horntail's HP to provide a difficulty level more appropriate to the intended strength of the character. We apologize for the inconvenience for the Ride or Die event.Resolved an issue where the Genesis Crux would drop multiple Black Mage Remnants.Resolved an issue where Absolute Zero Aura: Vortex would crash other players on the map when the skill ends.Resolved an issue where the achievenment '[From Memory] The One Who's Touched the Sky of the Grand Athenaeum' was not obtainable.Resolved an issue where Exceptional Hammers were not displayed as rewards for Extreme Kaling and Kalos.Resolved an issue where both old enhancement and exceptional hammer still drop from the extreme bosses (Kaling, Black Mage, Seren, Kalos).Resolved an issue where summoned familiars did not contribute towards total combat power.Resolved an issue where weekly participation for Ride or Die rewards did not have the correct duration listed.Resolved an issue where players would fall through platforms when fighting Guardian Angel Slime.Resolved an issue where certain characters were unable to join Item Burning.Resolved an issue where the text was cut off when speaking to Thales.Resolved an issue where the character deletion UI displayed incorrect text.Resolved an issue where Flushed Toothy Smirk Coupon and Blushing Toothy Smirk Coupon are unable to be claimed from The Dark Ride ticket.Resolved an issue where Damage Skin Slot Expansion Coupon's text had "C's" appearing in the description.Resolved an issue where the Papulatus Items were not dropping in Practice Mode for Ride or Die.Resolved an issue where players were unable to use buff skills and Atmospheric Effects in the 'In Front of the Temple' map. Resolved an issue where incorrect items would display in the Maple Planner.

notes.title: The Dark Ride Burning Events!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0958eedffad942e583aeb1565dcd7c14c64732eb.jpg

The Dark Ride is here with a new collection of Burning Events to get your new characters up to high level faster than ever! The Zero to One Hundred event is here to provide you a new way to race up to Lv. 100 in a single session of play, along with the returning Tera Blink. Select characters for Hyper Burning to get bonus levels each time you level-up, make your new characters on the temporary Burning World to collect EXP even faster, and use the Item Burning event to help your equipment keep up to your blazing-fast leveling!

Don't forget, the Blossoming by Moonshade Event is also running, letting you designate newly revamped Shade or Aran characters as bonus Hyper Burning characters too!

Hyper BurningPST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, February 11, 2025 3:59 PMCET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 12, 2025 12:59 AMAEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, November 20, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, February 12, 2025 10:59 AM
Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.

Create a brand-new character during the extra-long event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in all worlds, as well as Burning World, except for Zero characters.

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 260! You also have the option to designate one of your existing Lv. 200-258 characters as 'Hyper Burning' instead, allowing them to gain that benefit!

In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including Root Abyss and Fafnir gear! When you reach Lv. 200 on your ‘Burning’ character, don’t stop there but keep on training! notes.title: v.255 - The Dark Ride: Ride or Die Patch Notes
notes.content:
Get ready to Ride or Die in a brand-new Global MapleStory-exclusive experience where you'll test your skills and face off against familiar foes! notes.title: Maple Fashion Week!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/28a441e9dc32a265da603a70d53fa42b54da3945.jpg

Are y'all ready to strut your stuff?? Let’s get together and meet up with our biggest Maple Fashionistas, Hallowkitty and Camila, to earn some real quality accessories. But first, we are going to need to get past all these enemies in our way! Defeat enemies every day to earn Daily Rewards and Coupons. Use the Coupons to obtain your desired Accessory rewards from the Coupon Shop!

Hallowkitty’s Boutique:

PDT/PST (UTC -7/-8): Tuesday, October 22, 2024 5:00 PM PDT - Tuesday, November 5, 2024 3:59 PM PSTCEST/CET (UTC +2/+1): Wednesday, October 23, 2024 2:00 AM CEST - Wednesday, November 6, 2024 12:59 AM CETAEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, October 23, 2024 11:00 AM - Wednesday, November 6, 2024 10:59 AM
Camila’s Boutique:

PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 6, 2024 2:00 AM - Tuesday, November 19, 2024 3:59 PMCET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 6, 2024 11:00 AM - Wednesday, November 20, 2024 12:59 AMAEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, November 6, 2024 9:00 PM - Wednesday, November 20, 2024 10:59 AM
Event Details:
Complete '[Maple Fashion Week] Hallowkitty's Fashion Week!' and '[Maple Fashion Week] Camila's Fashion Week!' quests through Hallowkitty or Camila located in Henesys or through the event notifier.Requirement: Lv. 101 and above. (Zero characters must have completed Story Quest Act 2)You can open the Maple Fashion Week UI through the event notifier after completing the quest.After defeating 1,000 enemies near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above), click the [Claim Daily Reward] button to obtain 3 Coupons per week and EXP Coupon (x500).Obtain 6 Coupons and EXP Coupon (x1,000) on Sundays.Keep grinding and you can get a chance to pick up Hallowkitty or Camila Coupons when defeating these enemies!Hallowkitty Coupon: Tradable, usable until Hallowkitty week ends on November 5th at 11:59 PM UTC.Camila Coupon: Tradable, usable until Camila week ends on November 19th at 11:59 PM UTC.Use these Coupons to choose your next fit in the Coupon Shop.Thirsty for more Coupons? You can complete the hidden mission to receive 1 additional Coupon within Hallowkitty week and Camila week!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/7e21b1212a1d586975c943bc2448ede72605d709.png
You can get Cumulative Attendance Rewards based on the number of daily missions completed during each fashion week.Cumulative Attendance Rewards are the same for both Hallowkitty and Camila.All Cumulative rewards must be claimed before the end of event period.
Cumulative Attendance Rewards:

Open to receive:Magnificent Growth Potion: Tradable within world, 7-day duration.Sol Erda x1: Tradable within world, 7-day duration. Can use only when 6th Job Advancement has been completed. notes.title: MapleStory Worlds Americas Soft Launch!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/86365cca46e12f1d4de5ced699756728e8b748d5.jpg

MapleStory Worlds has now soft-launched in the Americas on Windows PC and Mac (Beta)! Introducing an exciting new way to play and create - MapleStory Worlds is here with powerful tools to design your own adventures and enjoy the creations of your fellow Maplers, and Maplers in North and South America can now join the fun!

Learn more at the MapleStory Worlds website!

[previewyoutube=qT_cgEgHObw;full][/previewyoutube]

What is MapleStory Worlds?
Immerse yourself in a new way to play and create! In MapleStory Worlds, players and creators come together to explore magical experiences. With powerful worldbuilding tools and 30 million MapleStory Assets, creators craft immersive adventures for players around the world and earn from their unique designs.

Unleash Your Creativity

Bring your imagination to life in a World you create! Select from over 30 million MapleStory game assets or import your own to design action-packed games, clever puzzles, or a place to hang out with friends. Learn more in the Creator Center!

Dive into a Vibrant Community

Explore thriving Worlds filled with diverse environments, each offering endless excitement! Your avatar is free to explore them all - with costumes and accessories designed to let you support your favorite creators. Learn more in the Play Worlds page!

Join the Creator Circle

Apply for the exclusive Creator Circle! As a member of this ongoing monthly program, you will improve your game, grow your player base, and earn income in MapleStory Worlds - all with the direct support of the Nexon team. Learn more in the Creator Circle post!

Available Regions and Platforms

While MapleStory Worlds is currently only soft launching in North and South America on Windows PC for now, and in public Beta on Mac, we’ll be coming to Mobile platforms soon, and opening up in Europe in January 2025. It will be available for other regions later in the year.

notes.title: v.254 - Midnight Carnival - Ludibrium Update Preview
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0235f86cb18a1f71d15439cb306468d361b6f812.png
        
BOO! Our Night Troupe is making its daring return just in time for the mischievous season of Halloween! We have lots in store to really get this season going! You can start with earning bonus stats by leveling up your Festival Designer Rank in Ludibrium or you can kick back and put together some solid fits through our Maple Fashion Week. Is dressing yourself up not enough?! That’s fine! You can put your interior design skills to the test by decorating your space through the [Home] Halloween event!
        
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/224663ab4dd2c4c831a58f2912dedf6e2917e4ef.png
        
We’ve been to Henesys, Rien, Nautilus... and now, it’s time to explore the castle of toys! The Night Troupe is back and this time, they’re taking us to Ludibrium!
        
Level up your Festival Designer Rank to unlock bonus stats, and power up even more with Festival Decorating perks that give your character (and boss mules) extra gains! Time doesn’t play by the rules here! Choose to fill either the Eos Hourglass or the Helios Hourglass and enjoy a boost in EXP - past, present, or future, the choice is yours.
        
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/1489bd5858420cf067ce997be007ccc7dc05c28b.png
        
Need a break after all that grinding? Grab your friends and enjoy the Ludibrium Fireworks Display, then jump right back in for a fun challenge - Knocking Down Blockulatus!
        
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/499f090039ae1f92031006d79d00230e23c62160.png
        
FashionStory IS the true endgame! Get ready, because Hallowkitty and Camila are back and thrilled to host Maple Fashion Week! Defeat enemies to unlock your next outfit of the day and show off your style down the runway.
        
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/c3fc587fdd38e995c2e2315104f93e65c3ff83cb.png
        
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/dd5741e15e0dc3e869a00ff28ab15cb484834593.png
        
Your Maple World neighbors have no idea what Halloween is really about, so it’s time to team up with Querencia and show them what it’s all about… and maybe give them a little scare! Get creative and decorate your own Halloween Manor to really set the mood for the perfect fright night!
        
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/bda962df85ebef8626eba64c3ba8f8a38f542045.png
        
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/6b7a58a3e43149718f077966ba58ca49041d6ef4.png
        
Race to the finish line in the Legion Relay! Earn daily quests and earn rewards to supercharge your Legion! There are three types of Relay Box Rewards to choose from, all offering the same rewards but in different quantities. The higher the quantity of the reward, the lower the chance of obtaining it. Choose wisely!

Reaching the upper echelons in MapleStory requires dedication and effort, so there's no time for slacking around! It's time to powerlevel like a champ, by sitting around in the park and floating around like a bee while you just soak up all the EXP! Get your EXP Pouch from Cassandra and gather up EXP over time, even if you're offline. Collect Star Candies as a honey bee to make your EXP Pouch fill up even faster!

I'm craving some serious downtime and relaxation! Rumor has it there's a method to gain experience without exerting much effort. Is this legendary tale true?Requirements: Lv. 101 and above. (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2).Talk to Cassandra and accept the ‘(I Haven’t Done Anything) Mysterious EXP Pouch’ quest to obtain the EXP Pouch. You can only accept the EXP Pouch once per account.The EXP Pouch automatically accumulates EXP that matches your character's level for every 10 seconds up to 24 hours.EXP continues to store even when you are not online, and will store the same amount as when you are online.You can earn EXP Acquisition Time Rewards based on the amount of time you accumulate.Once full, the EXP Pouch will not accumulate any more EXP until the stored EXP has been claimed.There’s also a way for you to accelerate the EXP collection time! You can enter the special Peaceful Park map by accepting the ‘(I Haven't Done Anything) Go to the Peaceful Park’ quest from the event notifier on the left of the screen.Talk to Busy Honey Bee to help transform you into a honey bee and collect Star Candies. This will accelerate the EXP collection time for the Mysterious EXP Pouch.You can obtain Cumulative Star Candy Collection Rewards based on your collection of Star Candy.Hidden mission alert! Complete the hidden mission to obtain the Diamond Honey Pot Coupon.

notes.title: v.252 Known Issues & Hotfixes - July 18, 2024
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/2198/maintenance-post-banner-in-post-banner-1100x225.jpg

Hi Maplers,

As part of our commitment to transparency, we are introducing a new section after each update to highlight the known issues our team is actively addressing. This section will focus on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.252 GO WEST! Update:

Known Issues:
Follow-up on Angelic Buster Skin Color Issue.
During the maintenance on June 28th, we made a change where the skin color of Angelic Buster's Dress-Up mode would start off the same as Normal mode for newly created Angelic Buster characters. The intention was to unify their skin colors at character creation. However, this change introduced a bug where it appeared that the Dress-Up mode skin color could no longer be changed when using any kind of skin color coupon. This bug has now been fixed after the v252 update. We understand that prior to the fix, some players may have used various skin color coupons on Angelic Buster's Dress-Up mode, including the Rosy or Flushed Skin Color Coupon from the recent Midnight Party event. Therefore, we are planning to redistribute any skin color coupons that were used on Angelic Buster characters after the 6/28 maintenance and before the 7/17 maintenance. These will be distributed in a future maintenance.Resolution for Durational Maple Boys Chair IssueWe will be distributing the permanent version of the Maple Boys Chair to players who claimed the durational version during the [GO WEST!] Star Queue event. The permanent chairs will be distributed in a future maintenance. Xenon characters unable to claim the Thief version of the 15-star Arcane Umbra Weapon Set Box (Time Restricted).The issue where Xenon characters could not claim the thief weapon from the 15-star Arcane Umbra Weapon in the v.252 patch. We will be redistributing the Arcane Umbra Weapon Box to Xenon players that claimed, but did not use the box in a future maintenance. Those who redeemed the Pirate weapon and would like the Thief Weapon instead can contact Player Support for an exchange.Kanna can equip a shield.An Issue where Kanna could equip shields in the weapon slot is being investigated
Resolved Issues:

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/8845b95960bd410dda48ca1996463eedfeac383b.jpg

[Update July 22] The Pharaoh's Treasure can be entered up to 10 times per account, not per character as initially reported. We apologize for the error.

Event Duration:
PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, July 17, 2024 (After Maintenance) - Tuesday, August 27, 2024 4:59 PMCEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, July 17, 2024 (After Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 28, 2024 1:59 AMAEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, July 17, 2024 (After Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 28, 2024 9:59 AM
The Maple Expedition is gearing up for another dungeon crawl, and the mysterious appearance of a pyramid in the middle of the Nihal Desert has sent them looking for the help of adventurers to uncover the secrets of the pyramid and claim the Pharaoh's Treasure!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/918bd481a61bebe15b5c5e2e3e14a0ecb6c8f521.png

The magic of the pyramid has a strange effect on those that delve within. Regardless of the equipment you bring, or the skills you have mastered, none of it will help you once you venture inside. Instead, you will need to claim powers from inside the pyramid, and find special relics to help you battle against the increasingly powerful foes you'll encounter within.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/ea2d2cdff95bb4720de90c833ae1a9beab1973d2.png

Battle your way through the roguelike dungeon and defeat the final boss of each chamber to claim EXP and a wealth of special rewards from your share of the Pharaoh's Treasure!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/00360982992cdc752e8b3b5b49dc47f064656a9d.png

Event Details:
A giant pyramid has appeared in Nihal Desert! Who is brave enough to explore it?Requirements: Lv. 101 and above (Zero characters must have completed Story Quest Act 2).Accept the ‘[Urgent] Maple Expedition Exploration Request’ quest through the new Pharaoh’s Treasure notifier on the left side of the screen.You can enter the Pharaoh’s Treasure event map through the notifier at any time.Play through the tutorial quest and story scenarios. After completing them, you can proceed by speaking with Pollion to select the entry chapter.Tutorial and story progress is shared by account.There are 5 chapters total and 20 stages per chapter. If you forfeit or die, you will automatically exit the dungeon.You can enter up to 10 times per day per account.There are 5 playable characters by class that are automatically selected based on the class you’re playing as: Warrior, Magician, Bowman, Thief, and Pirate.All classes start with a basic attack skill and have a max number of 4 skills total.Each basic skill has a max level of 3.You can enhance your character every time you clear a stage.The rewards you can obtain from each stage are random.You can select from skills, stats, Relics, or Pyramid Coins to use in the shop.Once you exit the dungeon, all obtained character enhancement rewards are reset and you will start over from stage 1.Equip Relics that can be obtained throughout the dungeon through completing stages. Relics provide stats increase or special effects that are activated upon equipping.Relics are graded as Low, Intermediate, and High. Low Relics appear regularly by defeating enemies or from Relic Altars (appears after clearing a stage).Intermediate Relics are obtained by combining Relics, a low chance from Relic Altars, or obtained from the shop.High Relics are only obtainable by combining Relics.You can combine 2 Relics to create a new Relic. You can get a special Relic by combining two specific Relics. The chance to receive a certain rank Relic are as follows: [table][tr][th]Type[/th][th]Advanced[/th][th]Intermediate[/th][th]Basic[/th][/tr][tr][th]Combine Basic + Basic[/th][td]0%[/td][td]70%[/td][td]30%[/td][/tr][tr][th]Combine Basic + Intermediate[/th][td]10%[/td][td]65%[/td][td]25%[/td][/tr][tr][th]Combine Basic + Advanced[/th][td]30%[/td][td]70%[/td][td]0%[/td][/tr][tr][th]Combine Intermediate + Intermediate[/th][td]50%[/td][td]50%[/td][td]0%[/td][/tr][tr][th]Combine Intermediate + Advanced[/th][td]60%[/td][td]40%[/td][td]0%[/td][/tr][tr][th]Combine Advanced + Advanced[/th][td]80%[/td][td]20%[/td][td]0%[/td][/tr][tr][th]Special Combination[/th][td]-[/td][td]-[/td][td]-[/td][/tr][/table]You can permanently enhance your character through Eternal Force and start the game in an even stronger state.Consume Eternal Stones that are obtained by playing the game and use them to enhance Trait Skills.Enhanced stats will be applied upon starting the dungeon.Eternal Stones obtained during the game are not reset.If you clear all chapters, you can attempt Challenge Mode. In Challenge Mode, you play through Chapters 1-5 consecutively. There are 40 stages total and each chapter boss appears every 8 stages.You can obtain rewards by completing quests and achievements.There are 7 types of stages:Normal StageNormal enemies appear consecutively.Clear by defeating all enemies.Elite StageElite Monster appears.When the Elite Monster is alive, normal enemies are summoned consecutively.Clear by defeating all enemies.Survival StageA large number of enemies would appear at a set time and are continuously summoned regardless of if they've been defeated.If you survive a certain amount of time, all enemies are removed and the stage is cleared.Bonus StageUse the exclusive portal to enter the Bonus Stage to enter.Summons a large number of Powerful Enemies compared to a normal stage.Clear by defeating all enemies and obtain double rewardsGoal Destruction StageA large number of enemies are continuously summoned. notes.title: Minimum System Requirements Update in Early October
notes.content:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/hrdn1yrd/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg

Attention Maplers,

In order to maintain the security and stability of MapleStory, we will be updating the Minimum System Requirements for MapleStory in an update scheduled for early October. Starting from that update, MapleStory will no longer be supporting operating systems below Windows 10. If you are using Windows 8.1 or below, you will be able to resume normal play after upgrading to Windows 10 or higher. For more information on upgrading Windows, please visit the Microsoft website.

Thank you for your cooperation,

The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Investigation of Night Fragments
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2098/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg

Hi Maplers,

Thank you for your patience as we discussed next steps for the issue of players obtaining Night Fragments abnormally. We've concluded the investigation and have moved forward with the following:
Night Fragments obtained abnormally by repeatedly claiming the weekly reward have been removed.Accounts that claimed and used an excess amount of Fragments have been issued a 7-day suspension.
We considered multiple factors in determining the threshold at which players would be affected by our decision. Most importantly, we didn't want players who may have claimed extra Night Fragments mistakenly to be affected by an issue on our end. After evaluating the situation, we determined some accounts gained Night Fragments in significant enough quantities to warrant a temporary suspension from the game.

Even if it’s for simple curiosity, the act of using a system error will be considered abnormal gameplay and we would advise Maplers to not use these when they occur. Please report it through our Player Support Center and wait until more information has been announced.

Thank you for your cooperation,
The MapleStory Team

notes.content:
https://g.nexonstatic.com/media/upjfch1u/1100x225-tera-blink-and-burning-world-maplestory.png

It's time to GO WEST with a new phase added to the classic Burning series of events! Tera Blink is joining in this time, giving you a quick race up the levels as Spiegelmann runs down the basics of MapleStory, and with the returning Hyper Burning you'll be hitting the Arcane River in no time. Burning World is also returning for the summer to make the levels climb even faster! Make a new character to race up to Lv. 260, gain new rewards with the Burning World Step Up Event, and keep advancing your characters through Burning World before heading to another world in August's Burning World Leap!
Hyper BurningPDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, June 12, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, August 27, 2024 4:59 PMCEST (UTC +2): Thursday, June 13, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 28, 2024 1:59 AMAEST (UTC +10): Thursday, June 13, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 28, 2024 9:59 AM
Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.

Create a brand-new character during the extra-long event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in all worlds, as well as Burning World, except for Zero characters.

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 260! You also have the option to designate one of your existing Lv. 200-258 characters as 'Hyper Burning' instead, allowing them to gain that benefit!

In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including Root Abyss and Fafnir gear! When you reach Lv. 200 on your ‘Burning’ character, don’t stop there but keep on training! You will receive additional rewards on your ‘Hyper Burning’ character at Lv. 200, Lv. 210, and every 5 levels after Lv. 210, up to Lv. 260!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5786/newteraeffect.png

Event Details:
Reach level 260 fast on a new or existing character with the Hyper Burning event!Requirements: Either:A newly created character made during the event period (Zero characters cannot participate in this manner.)A Lv. 200 - 258 character (Zero characters must be both within that range and have completed Story Quest Act 2)After creating a new character, you will be given an option to give it a ‘Hyper Burning’ effect.You cannot go back to give it a ‘Burning’ effect after refusing to do so during character creation.You can only 'Hyper Burn' 1 character per account during the event.After your ‘Hyper Burning’ character reaches Lv. 10, they will start to earn two additional levels each time your character gains a level up to Lv. 260.You will receive special Hyper Burning Rewards when your ‘Burning’ character meets the listed level milestones.Alternatively, you may elect to set one of your existing Lv. 200 - 258 characters as 'Hyper Burning', by selecting it on character select screen and clicking on 'Set as Hyper Burning'.Doing so will prevent you from designating a newly-created character as 'Hyper Burning'.You will still be able to create 'Mega Burning' characters on Burning World.There’s more rewards waiting for you past Lv. 200! Once your ‘Burning’ character reaches Lv. 200 (or you designate an existing character as Burning), you can obtain Bonus Rewards up until Lv. 260. You'll also get even better rewards for playing on Burning World!

Completing these missions will reward you with stamps used to redeem items.The final completion reward for the Spiegelmann's Diary mission can be claimed once per account.The participation count of the missions for entering the Ursus fight 3 times and claiming the Daily Gift is shared per account.All missions, excluding entering the Ursus fight 3 times and claiming the Daily Gift, must be done by the Hyper Burning character doing the Spiegelmann's Diary event to get a stamp.You can get the stamp 3 times for the Complete Erda Spectrum mission regardless of the date.You need to participate 2 times a day for the Complete Monster Park 2 times mission to get a stamp.You can get a stamp only once a day for the Complete Monster Park 2 times mission.You can get the stamp mission reward if you get 35 or more stamps from Spiegelmann's Diary.Spiegelmann's Dazzling Hat Effect (Untradable, Permanent)Spiegelmann's Dazzling Hat Effect can be claimed only once per account.Spiegelmann's Ordinary Necklace and Spiegelmann's Sparkling Necklace are collected when you exit the .The collected skill and items are given again when you enter the  again.In Heroic Worlds, you cannot do the Stage 11 mission ‘Equipment Is the Source of Power!’ and Spiegelmann's Ordinary Necklace is given from the Stage 12 mission ‘Do You Know Equipment with Star Power?’You can do the World Inside the Hat missions even if you delete the Hyper Burning character and create a new one, but Spiegelmann's Hat Chair will not be given again.The Dazzling Hat pet and the Dazzling Hat's Aura cannot be moved to the Cash Inventory.

Burning World is a special world with special rules that will exist only for the duration of the Burning World event, filled with boosts to make it easier than ever to level up fast. While on Burning World, all characters will gain the special Burning skill, which grants the following bonuses:
1.5x EXPWeapon ATT/Magic ATT +50Damage against Normal Monsters +30%Damage against Bosses +30%Critical Rate +30%Critical Damage +30%Knockback Resistance +100%STR/DEX/INT/LUK +50MaxHP/MaxMP +2,500
You will also be able to create three Mega Burning characters, who operate in the same manner as in previous Mega Burning events: After reaching Lv. 10, every time that character levels up, they will also gain two bonus levels, all the way up to Lv. 150. Combined with the Burning EXP bonus and boosted damage, you'll be able to power your way through those levels faster than ever before!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q4/1584/burning-world-character-selection.png

Additionally, even after your Mega Burning characters have been created, you'll be able to create another two characters to level up and leap, which will still benefit from the Burning skill! Please note that, the default number of Character Slots on Burning World is six, and Character Slot Expansion Coupons cannot be used in Burning World. You can move up to 5 characters that meet the requirements. Additionally, Zero characters cannot be selected as a "Burning" character on character creation, but can be selected as your Hyper Burning character upon reaching Lv. 200 and completing Story Act Quest 2.

Burning World LeapWednesday, August 28, 2024 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, September 12, 2024 (Start of Maintenance)
http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/1134/world-leap-screen.png

As the saying goes, the light that burns twice as bright burns half as long, and the Burning World will burn very brightly indeed. However, while this new world will be consumed at the end of it all, a new life awaits your characters in the other worlds of MapleStory!

Lv. 150+ characters in Burning World will be allowed to leap to another world of your choosing during the World Leap period, taking their equipped items, inventory, and mesos with them to join their new communities. When this period begins, all Burning World characters will be moved to the Burning Leap Zone map, where they will be able to speak to the NPC Mover to complete their exodus.
Characters in Burning World must be at least Lv. 150 in order to World Leap, whether they were Mega Burning characters or not.Zero characters must be both Lv. 150+ and having completed Story Quest Act 2.It will not be possible to leave the Burning Leap Zone map during this period, making it impossible to gain any more EXP. Make sure you're Lv. 150 before the August 28 maintenance!You do not need an empty character slot on the destination world for your new character (you will be granted a free Character Slot if you are at your unlocked limit on that world), however if you have reached the maximum character limit on that world, you will need to delete a character in order to make room for them.Characters can be transferred to Interactive Worlds only.Characters in Guilds will not be able to World Leap until they have either left or disbanded their Guild.Your character's equipped items, inventory, and mesos will be transferred with your character, but items within your Storage, Cash Shop Inventory, mail, and auction house will not be. Make sure you clear everything out before taking the big leap!You may send your Burning World characters all to the same world, or to different worlds.Medals obtained from regularly-resetting rankings will not be transferred, and your rankings in those pieces of content will also not be transferred.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1471/cute-earrings-tail.jpg

Lynn Details
Growing up near the forest, Lynn felt watched over throughout her childhood. When she finally meets the friendly bear, Pan, Lynn learns of her destiny as the reincarnated Forest Child. Together Pan and Lynn begin a journey to awaken the master of the forest and ensure its protection. They are joined by two more critters: Penni the bird and Paeon the wolf.

Forest Child Lynn uses the power of the forest to help Maplers defeat their enemies! As a Magician, Lynn uses INT as her main stat. Her primary weapon is the Memorial Staff and her secondary weapon is a Leaf. Each of Lynn's animalistic Spirit Guides has their own skill set to aid her in battle. Lynn also possesses supporting skills to bolster her allies.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1316/lynn-spirit-guides.png

Check out a few of Lynn's powerful skills:
Peck: Penni flies about and automatically attacks enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. Available at 2nd Job Advancement. Max Level: 20.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1318/lynn-skill-peck.png
Sneak Attack: Paeon hides in the darkness, then pounces to follow up the skills of the other Spirit Guides. Unaffected by attack reflection. Available at 3rd Job Advancement. Max Level: 20.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1321/lynn-skill-sneak-attack.png
Roar: Pan lets out a mighty roar, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies. Available at 4th Job Advancement. Max Level: 20.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1322/lynn-skill-roar-1-complete.png
Mother Nature's Touch: Shares the lifeforce of Mother Nature with all allies to provide healing effects. Restores HP, removes harmful effects, and grants continuous healing for a set time. Available at 4th Job Advancement. Max Level: 10.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1317/lynn-skill-mother-natures-touch.png

See the full skill list for Lynn here!

notes.title: Maple Memo: GMS Roadmap Q2 2024
notes.content:
http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5580/181107mm1100ip.jpg

Hi Maplers,

We apologize for the delay in the Q2 2024 roadmap and appreciate your patience. We will do our best to make sure future notices are published at the expected time.

As always, please be mindful that it will list the notable updates but not everything that will be included in each patch. We recommend waiting for the respective update’s Patch Notes post for details.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1497/240325-wgc-859-ms-timeline-roadmap.png
v.250 Update (early May) Happy 19th Anniversary, MapleStory!New Job: Forest Child LynnMayple Islandv.251 Update (mid-June)Angelic Buster RemasterLegion ArtifactEpic Dungeon: High MountainDreaming LacheleinMidnight PartyHyper Burning & Tera BlinkQoL ImprovementsSpecial Event
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1498/240416-wgc-859-ms-timeline-roadmap-post-v4.png

v.250 - Happy 19th Anniversary, MapleStory!

The 19th anniversary of Global MapleStory is coming up on May 11th! It’s crazy to think that we’ve been on this adventure with you all for 19 years. To celebrate, we’ve prepared special events as a thank you for being part of this community so be on the lookout for some sneak peeks!

v.250 - New Job: Forest Child Lynn

The arrival of Forest Child Lynn is finally here! Lynn is a magician that uses a Memorial Staff weapon and the power of the forest to summon Spirit Guides to help her defeat her enemies. While she can do strong damage with her Spirit Guide skills, she also has a variety of healing skills and buffs to help her party, so she will be very helpful as a support. (Also since players have been asking, yes, she will be released on the day of the v.250 update!)

We know many of you are curious about the conversion details from Beast Tamer to Lynn. Please wait until the patch notes have been released as it states all the information related to this topic.

v.250 - Mayple Island

Welcome to Mayple Island! Yes, we named it Mayple because it’s occurring in May! Mayple Island is a place that was created from the sparkling memories of Maplers. Meet those from your memories and receive abundant gifts by filling the Wish Orb that contains the dreams and hopes of people. The more you fill the Wish Orb, the better the rewards you’ll receive! Plus, there will be fun mini-games, photo booths, popularity contests, and other unique experiences throughout the event, including a museum exhibit where you can win OG Maple items. Don’t miss out and experience them all!

v.251 - Angelic Buster Remaster

Our queen of music, Angelic Buster, has blessed us with her return! In addition to her new look that is cuter and lovelier than ever, check out the newly changed skills. She’s also releasing her first mini album for you loyal fans, so we better see Angelic Buster as one of your top listened to artists in your 2024 Wrapped!

v.251 - Legion Artifact

After Monster Life ends, a new growth system called ‘Legion Artifact' will be included. Through various gameplay, players can naturally complete the missions and get time-limited stats that can be applied to all characters, introducing a new integrated character growth system.

v.251 - Epic Dungeon: High Mountain

Introducing MapleStory's first epic dungeon for characters level 260 and above! Dive into the story of the awakened sun god Mitra who has returned to the High Mountain after a long slumber. Defeat numerous enemies and get plenty of EXP and rewards.

v.251 - Dreaming Lachelein

We invite you to Lucid’s happy dream! Aren’t you curious about Lucid’s dreamy festival that isn’t a nightmare but something everyone can enjoy? Not only can you get LOADS of EXP, but there is a special reward shop, and content and mini-games for rapid leveling waiting for you. Explore all the exciting and special events that Lucid has prepared!

v.251 - Midnight Party

Welcome to the Midnight Party! It’s not a real party without goodies, so participate in the daily and weekly parties by defeating monsters to earn unique rewards, such as custom Lachelein outfits and backgrounds. After you’re done partying, you can earn your very own Lucidroid to accompany you on all your future endeavors.

v.251 - Hyper Burning & Tera Blink

Spiegelmann prepared a special map this time for Hyper Burning called Tera Blink! If you’re designated as a Hyper Burning character, you’ll be 200 with a blink of an eye in Spiegelmann’s ‘World Inside the Hat.’ Helpful rewards will be given every time you complete missions to help you progress even faster. So if you haven’t leveled your Legion yet, take this chance!

v.251 - QoL Improvements
Character PresetsEquipment presets have been added.Ability presets have been added.The cost to change Hyper Stat presets has been removed.The default Legion Preset slots are now all permanent and will be increased to 5.Boss UIYou can now view Character Info in the Party Recruitment tab.An exclusive UI for accessing bosses has been added.You can now set Combat Power as a condition in the Party Recruitment tab.Monster Park Extreme has been added to the Boss UI.Boss Entry LimitsThe entry limit for all weekly and monthly bosses has been removed.The daily limit for Balrog has been removed.The quest requirements to unlock Lotus and Damien have been removed as long as you meet the level requirement.A Practice Mode exclusive buff has been added, allowing you to apply buffs without actually consuming them for skills or items and without any restrictions.V Matrix ImprovementsYou can now open multiple Nodestones at once.You can now easily enhance all of your equipped Nodes by clicking the new ‘Enhance All’ button.
v.251 - Special Event

Inkwell and Dr. Lim are preparing a special event for all of you. Please stay tuned for more details!

We hope you’re excited by this high-level view of the content and events arriving to GMS in v.250 - v.251 2024. 

As always, our goal with these roadmaps is to provide information that players may be curious about and assist players with advanced preparation. Please keep in mind that there is more content on the way in addition to those listed above, so we advise players to refer to the Update Preview post and Patch Notes post for the finalized details for every game update.

Thank you,

Mjollnir and the MapleStory Team

notes.title: v.250 - Mayple Island Update Preview
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1248/header.png

Happy 19th anniversary, MapleStory! Explore the numerous events, mini-games, and shops filled with one-of-a-kind goodies at Mayple Island. Experience the adorable new class, Forest Child Lynn, and her versatile kit that will be influential in any party environment. Play through the newly revamped [Hieizan] Theme Dungeon with quality of life and balance improvements. Organize your outfits and decorate all your characters with the return of the Cash Shop Transfer event. Create a Zero character at any time of the year now that Zero creation is no longer limited to specific seasons!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1250/mayple-island.png

The fairies of Mayple Island have prepared so many events for you in celebration of the 19th anniversary of Global MapleStory! Participating in challenges every day will fill up the Mayple Wish Orb with wishes which will reward you with items, such as Growth Potions and 3x EXP Coupons. There will be three currencies you can use to redeem for items, Mayple Leaves, Mayple Candies, and Mayple Stars that you can earn from participating in daily events and mini-games. Additionally, the Mayple Island event map has numerous interactive areas where you can take pictures with your friends, so try sitting on various parts of the island (our favorite is the Merry-Go-Round). We can’t wait for you to enjoy the beautiful Mayple Island!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1249/mayple-island-ss.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1246/child-of-the-forest-lynn.png

Forest Child Lynn is our newest class who uses the power of the forest to help Maplers defeat their enemies! Her Spirit Guides, Pan, Penni, and Paeon provide her with extra damage and each have special skills that can be helpful in any situation. Lynn has a few mobility skills including ‘Light Leap’ (flash jump) and ‘[Focus] Support Flight’ which instantly transports herself to a target and vice versa. Additionally, her kit is quite versatile containing multiple healing skills and even having a skill that increases item drop rate for herself! Lynn will always be available for creation but we will have special durational rewards at launch, so we highly recommend creating her upon release!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1247/forest-child-lynn-ss.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1240/hieizan-theme-dungeon-revamp.png

We’ve revamped the [Hieizan] Theme Dungeon so farming ‘Kanna’s Treasure’ every week will be more efficient! First and foremost, you will no longer teleport when attacking Mikagami, but rather only when you are attacked. In addition, the number of hits required to defeat Mikagami has been decreased. We’ve also made adjustments to the skills of Oura Shogun, Miroku, and Princess No to improve the overall balance of the dungeon.

notes.title: Maple Memo: Font Change Update
notes.content:
http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5580/181107mm1100ip.jpg

Hi Maplers,

After the v.249 update, you may have seen that the in-game font for multiple menus and titles was adjusted. We'd like to inform you that the font will be reverted back to the original style in the v.250 update and share with you why these changes were made.

While testing the new Character Info UI, we were finding that certain text and letters were not being properly aligned. To address the issue, the original font was modified to increase legibility which impacted all UI elements. We will be reverting this and only applying the legibility changes to the Character Info UI.
Additionally, specific letters such as "w", "v", "t" and "f" can be hard to distinguish when they are typed next to each other. Therefore, we applied a change that added more spacing between these characters. This change will also be reverted to the original spacing. 

Although we are reverting the font back to the original style, we will continue to focus on improving our players' day-to-day gameplay experience. As always, your feedback is immensely important to us and we appreciate your support.

Thank you,

Mjollnir

notes.title: v.249 - Minar Picnic Update Preview
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2418/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_01.png

Accept Chief Tatamo’s invitation to join a picnic with the Halflingers in Minar Forest. Brush up on your MapleStory lore with two new sections added to the Grand Athenaeum. Improve your Crafting, Smithing, and Alchemy skills with the Profession revamp. Evaluate your  progress and personalize your avatar area with the Character UI revamp. Upgrade your monster farm and show them more love with improvements to Monster Life. Last but certainly not least, check out the Better Maple improvements!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2414/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_02.png

Did you pack your picnic mat and snacks? Chief Tatamo is inviting you to the Minar Picnic where you can join the Halflingers for some wholesome fun! But you’ll need to fight off the monsters who are attempting to ruin your picnic and defend your new friends. To thank you for fighting them off, Chino will reward you with an abundance of gifts, such as a Minar Picnic Box and Magnificent Growth Potion!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2409/minar-picnic-sc-1.png

To thank you for defending them, the Halflingers would like to reward you with a treasure hunt!  Assemble special lunches for the Halflingers and send them out to various locations where they’ll bring back goodies to help you progress. These Halflingers have prepared so many events for you so be sure to treat them well!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2410/minar-picnic-1-sc2.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2401/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_04.png

Take a break from grinding and visit the Grand Athenaeum to read about the history of MapleStory! Learn about the riveting backstory of Carcion, the Cradle of Life which has been added to the Book of Grandis and experience the art that is Grand Athenaeum Episode 7: Sefirot’s Gardener.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2411/grand-athenaeum-sc.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2402/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_06.png

It’s harvesting season! The Profession revamp will allow you to craft and farm faster than ever before. The crafting cooldown time has been removed for all items! You can now learn Accessory Crafting, Smithing, and Alchemy at the same time in Interactive Worlds. Ardentmill’s harvesting maps are now instanced so you no longer need to be changing channels constantly to collect the items you need. We’ve also increased the maximum Fatigue which will allow players to harvest for double the amount of time than before. Additionally, Accessory Crafting, Equipment Crafting, and Alchemy’s mastery will no longer decrease! 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2388/alchemy-ui.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2403/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_09.png

Want to know how you’re progressing? The Character UI is reorganized to better display information so it’s easier to see your performance. We’re adding new information, such as Combat Power, Normal Enemy Damage, and Cooldown Reduction, so you have a better idea of how you’ll measure up in different areas. You’ll also be able to see more information about other players, such as their Arcane Symbols, applied Link Skills, and Hexa Matrix. Better get on those dailies… 

Also, we know how much you love customization so we are adding backgrounds to your character’s avatar area. Now you can show off your outfit with a little more pizazz. Another element added for your fashionstory!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2390/character-ui-sc.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2404/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_11.png

Monster Life will be improved so you can take better care of your farm! We’re increasing the chance of receiving a Special Category monster when combining monsters. The maximum storage capacity of buildings will be increased by 400% so you can store 4x as much Waru than before and auto-collect all the Waru from all the buildings at once! You can then use that Waru to extend the lifespan of certain ranked monsters. With these improvements, your monsters will be much happier than before!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2415/monster-life-sc-1.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2405/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_13.png

What better way to improve your daily gameplay than with quality of life updates? Since you’re always grinding for Sol Erda Energy and Sol Erda Fragments, you can now assign the Sol Erda UI to a shortcut so it can be more easily accessed. If you have the Sol Erda UI activated, it will be active even after logging off! Now the moment you’ve been waiting for…certain consumables, such as Power Elixirs and Mystical Cubes, are now stackable up to x9999 per inventory slot they occupy! Hurray to inventory management!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2413/better-maple-1.png

notes.title: Gold Richie's Safe
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2110/240301_goldrichiessafe_postheader_1100x225.jpg
PST (UTC -8): Tuesday, March 5th, 2024 4:00 PM - Tuesday, March 19th, 2024 4:59 AM (PDT)CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, March 6th, 2024 1:00 AM - Tuesday, March 19th, 2024 12:59 PMAEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, March 6th, 2024 11:00 AM - Tuesday, March 19th, 2024 10:59 PM
Event Details:
Who will be the Mapler to win Gold Richie’s riches?Requirement: Lv. 101 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2).You can start the event by accepting the ‘[Safe] Gold Richie's Safe’ quest in the star notifier on the left side of the screen or by talking to Gold Richie in Henesys, Cernium Square, or Nameless Town during the event.You can obtain up to 400 Safe Tickets a day per world by defeating monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above).
These Safe Tickets are shared between your characters within the world.
Ex: If Character A obtains 310 tickets and Character B obtains 90 tickets, you can no longer obtain any more for the day because you’ve reached a total of 400 Safe Tickets (max daily limit).You can obtain Safe Tickets (x100) and 2x EXP Coupon (15 min) (x2) by defeating 2,000 monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) to complete the ‘[Safe] Gold Richie’s Daily Quest’.
This daily quest can be completed once a day per world.The Safe Tickets obtained from this daily quest do not count towards the 400 Safe Ticket daily limit.Guess the Safe Code
You can spend 100 Safe Tickets to guess the Safe Code by clicking on the Safe in Henesys, Cernium Square, or Nameless Town during the event.Two rounds of guessing the Safe Code will be held every day. 
Round 1: 12:00 AM - 11:59 AM UTC dailyRound 2: 12:00 PM - 11:59 PM UTC dailyEach round, all the duplicate Safe Codes will be removed from the list. Only unique numbers that don’t have duplicates will be counted, and the smallest number out of that list will be selected as the winning Safe Code.If there isn’t a number that satisfies these conditions, there will be no winner for that round.
Ex: Registered Safe Code: 1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 22, 44, 152
In the above case, “1” is the smallest number but there is a duplicate. Out of the other numbers which were only registered once, “2” will be selected as the Safe Code as it is the smallest unique number in the list of entries.You can enter the Safe Code 15 times per round, and the same combination that has been registered in the same round before cannot be registered again.You can only participate in one world per round.
Ex: If you've already submitted Safe Codes in Scania world, you cannot participate again in Bera world until the next round.

notes.title: Maple Memo: GMS Roadmap Q1 2024
notes.content:
http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5580/181107mm1100ip.jpg

Hi Maplers,

We’re here to share our Roadmap for Q1 2024! As always, please be mindful that it will list the notable updates but not everything that will be included in each patch. We recommend waiting for the respective update’s Update Preview post or Patch Notes post for details.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1102/240105_banner_roadmaptimeline_wgc-492.jpg
v.248 Update (early February) World Selection ReorganizationBurning World LeapSpiegelette’s Strawberry FarmGold Richie’s SafeExciting New Collaboration!v.249 Update (mid-March)Minar PicnicGrand AthenaeumProfession RevampCharacter UI RevampMonster Life ImprovementsBetter Maple Improvements
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1114/240111-1_roadmaptimeline_wgc-492.jpg

v.248 - World Selection Reorganization

As we announced in Maple Memo: World Selection Reorganization and a New World in the November patch, we renamed worlds to give each world a unique identity. Additionally, we’ve created new names for the different groups of Worlds that are reflective of your playstyle and redesigned the server selection screen to display the World groups in a way that is more intuitive to new players.
Scania, Bera, Aurora, Elysium, and Luna are grouped together as Interactive Worlds. Kronos, Hyperion, and Solis are grouped together as Heroic Worlds. Special limited-time events, such as Burning World or Super Yeti X Pink Bean, are grouped together as Seasonal Worlds.
v.248 - Burning World Leap

Burning World Leap is back! If you leveled multiple characters in Burning World, this is the time to have them join your team in regular worlds! Leveling your Legion has never felt so good.

v.248 - Spiegelette’s Strawberry Farm

Spiegelette needs help with her Strawberry Farm! Assist her in farming strawberries and she’ll reward you with EXP and other wonderful Strawberry-themed goodies!

v.248 - Gold Richie’s Safe

Gold Richie is back and he is looking for certain lucky Maplers who can unlock his safe with the secret code! Hunt monsters to collect Safe Tickets for chances to unlock the safe and earn the delightful prizes that lie within.


v.248 - Exciting New Collaboration!

We’re very excited to announce that we have a new collaboration coming soon! Keep your eyes peeled for upcoming announcements - we can’t wait to show you what we have planned! 

v.249 - Minar Picnic

It’s picnic season! Chief Tatamo invites you to Leafre to join a lovely picnic with the Halflingers and enjoy the nice weather outdoors. Defeat monsters who are trying to ruin your good time, explore the Minar Forest, and go on a treasure hunt to earn abundant rewards and EXP! 

v.249 - Grand Athenaeum

Love learning about lore? For those of you who spend tons of time in Grand Athenaeum reading up on the compelling history of MapleStory, we’re adding two new sections, Grand Athenaeum: Book of Grandis and Grand Athenaeum Episode 7: Sephiroth’s Gardener.

v.249 - Profession Revamp
Learn Accessory Crafting, Smithing, and Alchemy at the same time in Interactive Worlds.The crafting system’s Fatigue has been improved.Accessory Crafting, Smithing, and Alchemy’s Mastery will no longer decrease. Ardentmill’s harvesting maps have been improved and changed to instanced maps.
v.249 - Character UI Revamp
The Character UI has been improved so you can now see ‘Character Info’ and ‘Stats’ together.We added new information such as ‘Combat Power’, ‘Normal Enemy Damage’, and ‘Cooldown’ to the Character UI.Use the Character UI to check other characters’ stat and equipment information too.Add a background to your character’s avatar area.
v.249 - Monster Life Improvements
Combine monsters with an increased rate of receiving a Special Category monster.Harvest Waru from all buildings simultaneously when you use Auto Harvest.Store more Waru with a 400% increase in the maximum storage capacity of buildings.Use Waru to extend the lifespan of some ranked monsters.Monster Life related items will no longer be sold in the Cash Shop, and some actions that required Gems will now require Waru. 
v.249 - Better Maple Improvements
Hexa Matrix PrequestIf you decide to skip the tutorial for the ‘[6th Job] Hexa Matrix’ quest, the quest will now be completed instantly.Sol Erda UIYou can assign the Sol Erda UI to a shortcut so it can be easily accessed.You can check your Sol Erda Energy and Sol Erda Fragments together in a combined UI.If you have the Sol Erda UI activated, it will be maintained even after logging off.Reporting FeatureWhen reporting a player for illegal program usage, the list of reportable players’ names has been improved to show up to 3 players who were located on the same map but since left the map.
We hope you’re excited by this high-level view of the content and events arriving to GMS in v.248 - v.249 2024. 

In addition to these, we’re planning to release the sale of Sol Erda Booster on January 17th to help players progress with their 6th Job Skill enhancements! You’ll be able to obtain Sol Erda Energy and Sol Erda Fragments by simply logging in and claiming daily. Stay tuned for more information!

And finally, we’d like to talk about our long-term plans for Q1 2024 and beyond.

Beast Tamer

In our last Roadmap memo, we announced that Beast Tamer’s 6th Job would not be included - we’re happy to provide an update now!
Beast Tamer is getting an overhaul and becoming a new class: Forest Child Lynn. As the successor to Beast Tamer, Lynn will be able to fight battles alongside her powerful guardians and support their party members with a variety of abilities that utilize the power of the forest, so please look forward to seeing them in action. We’ll see you in May with a new look!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/1107/lynn.png

What’s Next?

As you already know, MapleStory is operated as separate services in different regions. We understand that you are always wondering if the contents of other services will affect Global MapleStory (GMS). Similar to other regions, GMS is a unique and independent service with a distinct player base. During our planning process for the game and each update, we consider the existing unique specifications of GMS and the play patterns and preferences of our players.

Over the past few months, we have been working to create better distinctions between world types by providing the worlds Kronos and Solis unique names, opening the new Hyperion world, and introducing new world group names as mentioned above. These efforts are part of our localization plan to highlight Global MapleStory as a unique service, reduce misunderstandings with the previous terminology, along with providing more intuitive guidance for all new players. 

As for our future plans for GMS, along with the separate memo and notices we've provided in the past, we started posting these roadmaps as part of our effort to inform you of any large changes coming to GMS as early as we can. We are committed to continuing to do so and informing you of major changes to GMS through these notices. As mentioned above, we will make decisions that are best for GMS, and if we decide to make any major changes you can expect to learn more details about it from us in advance. Please note that outside of what we have already mentioned above, we have no other plans to share.

As always, our goal with these roadmaps is to provide information that players may be curious about and assist players with advanced preparation. Please keep in mind that there is more content on the way in addition to those listed above, so we advise players to refer to the Update Preview post and Patch Notes post for the finalized details for every game update.

Thank you,

Mjollnir and the MapleStory Team

notes.title: Join the Abyssal Expedition!
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2630/post-header_1100x225-abyssal-expedition-maplestory.jpg

Abyss, a huge crack and unknown territory, has been found throughout Maple World! Who is brave enough to venture into the deepest part of the Abyss to fight Abyss Manon? Only true adventurers dare go in but it is a dangerous place and you cannot go alone. You’ll need your strongest team to go in and fight to gain access to the power of the Abyss. Become the best expedition captain that will lead your team to victory!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2628/abyssal-expedition-combat-maplestory.png

Event Duration:
PST (UTC -8): Tuesday, December 19, 2023 4:00 PM - Tuesday, February 6, 2024 3:59 PMCET (UTC +1): Wednesday, December 20, 2023 1:00 AM - Wednesday, February 7, 2024 12:59 AMAEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, December 20, 2023 11:00 AM - Wednesday, February 7, 2024 10:59 AM
Event Details:
A large crack appeared in Minar Forest and mutated monsters are causing damage to the forest and nearby towns! Become Maple Expedition Captain to command a crew and explore the mysteries of the Abyss!Requirements: Lv. 101 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2).Accept the ‘[Abyssal Expedition] Request to Join the Maple Expedition’ quest from the Abyssal Expedition icon within the star event notifier on the left side of the screen.Upon accepting the quest, you will automatically be moved to the Maple Expedition Abyssal Entrance map.Afterwards, accept the ‘[Abyssal Expedition] Investigate the Crevasse in Minar Forest’ quest from the Abyssal Expedition icon within the star event notifier or by talking to Pascal. You will then be appointed as the Expedition Captain.As you explore the Abyss, you can obtain Reputation that can be used as a currency to level up Command Rank, hire mercenaries, and more!You can claim the acquired Reputation by talking to Pascal.Abyssal Expedition can be completed per character.

Mercenaries
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2629/abyssal-expedition-ui-maplestory.png
How to Recruit Mercenaries and Set Up Expedition Crew
Accept the ‘[Abyssal Expedition] Expedition Captain's First Mission: Recruit Mercenary’ quest by talking to Norman.Joss and Nami will be the first mercenaries you recruit.Your command rank determines which mercenaries you are available to recruit. 
There are a total of 5 Mercenary Ranks:
Basic: Hiring Cost: 400 ReputationIntermediate: Hiring Cost: 800 ReputationAdvanced: Hiring Cost: 1,200 ReputationSuperior: Hiring Cost: 1,600 ReputationSpecial: Hiring Cost: 2,000 ReputationYou can talk to Norman to recruit more mercenaries that match your command rank.In order to assign the recruited mercenaries, open the Expedition Management UI by clicking the ‘Expedition Management’ button on the bottom right of the screen.How to Level Up Mercenaries
Each mercenary can level up to max Lv. 10.
The level-up of each mercenary is based on the Abyss exploration time. Here is the amount of time the mercenary needs to explore the Abyss before they can level up:
Lv. 2: 30 minutesLv. 3: 60 minutesLv. 4: 120 minutesLv. 5: 200 minutesLv. 6: 300 minutesLv. 7: 400 minutesLv. 8: 500 minutesLv. 9: 650 minutesLv. 10: 800 minutesThe amount of time you can explore the Abyss depends on your Command Rank.You can see the EXP and level of the mercenaries via the Expedition UI while exploring the Abyss and Expedition Management UI.The slots to equip new skills are unlocked when mercenaries reach Lv. 5 and Lv. 10. 
Certain skills can only be equipped on mercenaries with specific jobs.Unique skills cannot be unequipped.The mercenaries can equip weapons, hats, and outfit items to increase their stats.
You can access the Abyss Expedition equipment inventory in the Abyss UI.You can obtain equipment items from the following sources:
Purchasing from Doddy or Vanessa at Expedition Headquarters using ReputationCompleting missions while exploring the AbyssDefeating Abyss boss on each floorClaiming Expedition Support Box from completing daily ExpeditionMercenaries have various relationships with each other and their relationship effect will provide additional stats:
Family: EXP +10% when entering the Abyss togetherAlly: Speed +5 when entering the Abyss togetherCouple: Attack Speed +1 when both are recruitedRival: Attack Power +30 when entering the Abyss togetherGrudge: Attack Power -15 when entering the Abyss togetherTeacher-Student: Attack Power +15 when both are recruited

Once you’ve set your Expedition crew, enter the portal by the lift on the left side of the Maple Expedition Abyssal Entrance map to explore the Abyss.When entering the portal, you can select from the floors you have access to based on your Command Rank and Expedition Level.Base Camp for each area has portals for hunting map and Abyss Boss Lair.
Hunting maps: White portal on the map where you can explore deeper within the Abyss.
When you enter the hunting map, your Expedition crew will automatically hunt the monsters. The automated hunting time is based on your Command Rank.
The mercenaries must have a weapon equipped to begin hunting.Your Expedition crew members cannot be changed while hunting. However, you can still change their equipment and skills.You can earn Reputation as you hunt and it can be claimed by talking to Pascal.Once the auto hunting time ends, you will be moved back to the Expedition Headquarters.
Auto hunting time resets every day at 12:00 AM UTC.Note: Mercenaries level up based on the time spent in the hunting mapsAbyss Boss Lair: Red portal on the map where you can challenge the Abyss Boss. 
You are given 10 minutes to defeat the boss and if you fail, you are exited from the map.If you leave midway or fail to defeat the boss, you can enter again after 5 minutes.The 4 hour cooldown will be applied upon leaving the boss battle after the given 10 minutes.When you defeat the boss, you can obtain Abyss Boss Rewards. For more reward details, please see the “Abyssal Expedition Rewards” section below.

Daily mission cannot be changed.Complete the daily missions and talk to Pascal to receive Daily Mission Rewards based on the mission you received.Expedition Mission
Once you have spent more than one hour in the Abyss hunting map, Pascal will give you Expedition Rewards proportional to the Expedition time once per day.Expedition time will reset every day at 12:00 AM UTC.Expedition Achievement Missions
Talk to Pascal to accept the achievement quests.You can complete the following quest requirements to receive special Abyss Expedition Achievement Rewards:

notes.title: v.247 New Age: Into the Abyss Update Preview
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2286/231201-wgc-537-v247-update-preview_header.png

Build and customize a team of Mercenaries to fight off monsters in the Abyssal Expedition. Defend Ereve from a High Flora invasion aboard the impressive battleship, Arteria. Protect the new area, Carcion, from Darmoor’s apostle who seeks the power of the ancient god, Keira. Gather your strongest team and prepare to battle new difficulties for Kaling & Kalos the Guardian. After these intense fights, relax and enjoy the holiday season with new Maplemas celebrations!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2276/231201-wgc-537-v247-update-preview_btn-abyssal.png?width=1100&height=119&mode=max

Abyss, a huge crack and unknown territory has been found throughout the Maple World! Who is brave enough to venture into the deepest part of the Abyss to fight Abyss Manon?

Only true adventurers dare go in but it is a dangerous place and you cannot go alone. You’ll need your strongest team to go in and fight to gain access to the power of the Abyss. Become the best expedition captain that will lead your team to victory! As a reward for your bravery, defeating Abyss Manon will grant an exclusive Legion Block that is not included in the number of member placement.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2302/untitled-4-v2.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2277/231201-wgc-537-v247-update-preview_btn-battleship.png

Aboard the new Lv. 280+ sinister warship Arteria, Reina prepares to invade Maple World with the High Flora army! As the new Apostle of Darmoor, she carries the power of a god within a special crystal. In this new region, you will fight armies of Flora soldiers and collect the new Sacred Symbol: Arteria. Are you strong enough to defeat them?

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2304/untitled-2-v2.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2278/231201-wgc-537-v247-update-preview_btn-carcion.png

Limbo, another one of Darmoor's Apostles, has set his sight on Carcion, the Cradle of Life. For those of you above Lv. 285, join forces with the local residents to push back the encroaching force. While you uncover the mystery behind a sinister plot, collect the new Sacred Symbol: Carcion to become even stronger. The fate of Carcion is in your hands.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2303/untitled-5-v2.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2283/231201-wgc-537-v247-update-preview_btn-kaling.png

MapleStory’s two newest bosses have new difficulties for you to challenge! Kaling’s Easy, Hard and Extreme difficulties have been added and Kalos the Guardian’s Easy, Chaos, and Extreme difficulties have been added. Only the brave dare challenge Kaling and Kalos the Guardian on Extreme difficulty and for those who succeed, they can earn the powerful new Helmet of Loyalty and Mark of Destruction items! Are you one of the brave?

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2295/untitled-1.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q4/2284/231201-wgc-537-v247-update-preview_btn-maplemas.png

Happy holidays, Maplers! It’s that time of the year again to celebrate the festive spirit during the winter season! Help Rudi gather his ornaments for his tree and he might give you a special gift as a thank you! Or enjoy decorating your Maple Home with new holiday-themed furnishings and blueprints during these limited time seasonal events. There are always rewards for good deeds, and who knows what kind of presents you might receive by helping those in need? Merry Mapling, everyone!
