notes.title: Thank you for 16 Years of MapleStory!
notes.content:
Happy Sweet 16, MapleStory!

MapleStory has come a long way since its launch in North America back on May 11, 2005. Many a Mapler started the journey as an Explorer in Maple World. Now comes the age where Maplers fight against a new threat as an Adversary after the Black Mage's demise. Many of you have grown up with MapleStory, making friends, having wild adventures, and exploring the vast towns of Maple World. MapleStory is like no other and it holds a special place in many Maplers' hearts and memories (including ours). We wouldn't be here without you, and all of us on the MapleStory Team would like to thank each and every one of our Maplers; from FashionStory Henehoes, the Quest Specialists, the 275 Before It Was Cool Maplers, to the Min/Maxers. We've been through so much together, and we're here to stay for all that's sure to come next! Cheers to 16 years of Global MapleStory!

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Lapsed Character Clean-Up
notes.content:
Attention Maplers,

With our most recent update on April 21, 2021, we flagged a number of low-level characters that have not been logged into for many years. Characters that meet all of the following criteria will be deactivated, in advance of being fully removed during our June update, tentatively scheduled for June 9, 2021:
Lv. 61 or lower.Have not logged into the account since December 15, 2016.Are not Guild Leaders, Alliance Leaders, or have unclaimed cash items within the Auction House.
If you have a character that falls under those restrictions, it will be in a Deactivated state. If you wish to preserve them, simply log into your account once prior to the June 2021 update, and they will be unaffected by this clean-up process.

Note: This process will result in the names of the deleted characters being available for use by others. 

Thank you,

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Pixel Picks Voting Is Back!

Ever wanted to have a say in which cosmetic items are available in the Cash Shop? Now with Pixel Picks, you can vote on your favorite items to get them back in the Cash Shop! You can vote for one item in each category; once the voting period has ended, the community’s top choices will be included in one of our upcoming sales rotations!

notes.title: Potion Pyramid and Wisp Wallop Events
notes.content:
The Full Moon Party hasn't stopped yet! Two new mini-games have arrived to challenge your reflexes and strategic planning, as you play a cunning game of potion stacking in Potion Pyramid, and dodge a simply obscene number of energy blasts in Wisp Wallop!

Potion PyramidPST (UTC -8): Tuesday, February 23, 2021 4:00 PM - Tuesday, March 9, 2021 3:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, February 24, 2021 1:00 AM - Wednesday, March 10, 2021 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, February 24, 2021 11:00 AM - Wednesday, March 10, 2021 10:59 AM
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/1525/potion-pyramid-maplestory-full-moon-events.png

Event Details:
Strategically stack potions in the shape of a pyramid against other players!Requirements: Lv. 101 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2). Your character must also have completed the introductory "[Full Moon Party] You Are Cordially Invited" quest.Talk to Ephony the Fairy located in the Full Moon Party Venue map to queue up for a Potion Pyramid match against two other players.There are a total of 36 potions given out in each turn, with 12 of them distributed randomly to each player: 7 potions of each of 5 types, and one special potion.Potions can be placed on the bottom row or on top of two other potions, if one of the potions is of the same type. Placing a potion earns you 10 points.The Special Potion can be placed on top of any potion, and potions cannot be placed upon it.Each player places a potion, one at a time. If a player cannot legally place a potion, their turn is skipped, and the next player may place one.You have only 10 seconds to place a potion. If you fail to do so, Ephony the Fairy will make a move for you and you will earn 0 points for the move.If you miss your turn 3 times, you will forfeit the match, receive no rewards, and will not be allowed to join a new match for 15 minutes.The round ends when a player has placed all of their potions into the pyramid, or when there are no remaining legal moves (due to no players being able to place any potions).Each match of Potion Pyramid consists of 3 rounds, with prizes awarded to players based on their ranking (which is determined by the number of points each player earned):1st Place: 40 Cotton Candy2nd Place: 20 Cotton Candy3rd Place: 10 Cotton CandyTiebreaker: If two players have the same number of points at the end of the match, the player who reached their final point total first will place higher.You can receive up to 100 Cotton Candy across all events each day. If you reach your Cotton Candy limit for the day, you can still participate in the game, but will not receive any Cotton Candy.Wisp WallopPST (UTC -8): Tuesday, February 23, 2021 4:00 PM - Tuesday, March 9, 2021 3:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, February 24, 2021 1:00 AM - Wednesday, March 10, 2021 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, February 24, 2021 11:00 AM - Wednesday, March 10, 2021 10:59 AM
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/1526/wisp-wallop-maplestory-full-moon-events.png
Fly around avoiding incoming missiles while collecting candies!Requirements: Lv. 101 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2). Your character must also have completed the introductory "[Full Moon Party] You Are Cordially Invited" quest.You can accept the invitation quest every hour on the 15-minute and the 45-minute mark from the invitation that appears on top of your character.There are a total of 3 stages. There must be a minimum of 10 participants for the game to start (up to 50 players may play per round).The goal of this game is to successfully avoid attacks and obtain as many candies as possible within the time limit to earn Cotton Candy.When you are hit by an attack, you will briefly become unable to move or catch any candy. Once you are able to move again, you will have a few seconds of invulnerability for you to get to safety (and maybe grab some candy along the way!).Not all candy is worth the same! The bigger the piece, the sweeter the reward, and once a piece of candy is caught by a player, no one else can grab it!When each stage ends, Cotton Candy will be distributed based on your ranking:1st Place: 50 Cotton Candy2nd - 10th Place: 30 Cotton Candy11th - 20th Place: 20 Cotton Candy21st - 30th Place: 15 Cotton Candy31st - 50th Place: 10 Cotton CandyYou can receive up to 100 Cotton Candy across all events each day. If you reach your Cotton Candy limit for the day, you can still participate in the game but no longer obtain Cotton Candy.You cannot earn the rewards if you leave during the game.Rankings reset after every stage, and the challenge of dodging the attacks gets harder as well!
Reward:
Cotton Candy
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/1528/maplestory-full-moon-events-rewards.png

notes.title: The Maplehood Watch Is Back for 2021!
notes.content:
Join the Maplehood Watch to protect the neighborhood and earn free Cash items! Hunt monsters that are hanging around nearby and you will be rewarded with a random Maplehood Watch Gachapon Box and Maplehood Watch Avatar Box, Maplehood Watch Hair and Face Coupons, or an Enhancement item depending on what day it is. Wednesday is Gachapon/Avatar Day, Saturday is Enhancement Day, and Monday is Beauty Day!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2017/2937/6sahdeg43t.jpg

To begin, accept the quest '[Maplehood Watch] Not in My Neighborhood' from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. This event is available to all characters Lv. 101 or higher, and to Zero characters who've completed Story Quest Chapter 2.

Log in during the event days (Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays) and hunt monsters within your level range to receive the day's reward!
Wednesday – Gachapon Day
January 27:

PST (UTC -8): Tuesday, January 26, 2021 4:00 PM - Wednesday, January 27, 2021 3:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, January 27, 2021 1:00 AM - Thursday, January 28, 2021 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, January 27, 2021 11:00 AM - Thursday, January 28, 2021 10:59 AM

February 3:

PST (UTC -8): Tuesday, February 2, 2021 4:00 PM - Wednesday, February 3, 2021 3:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, February 3, 2021 1:00 AM - Thursday, February 4, 2021 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, February 3, 2021 11:00 AM - Thursday, February 4, 2021 10:59 AM

Wednesdays are Gachapon Days! This can be completed 3 times per character per day. Log in and accept the quest '[Maplehood Watch] Gachapon Giveaway' from Cassandra located in the Star Notifier. Hunt 200 monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above, based on level) to receive rewards!

Maplehood Watch Gachapon Coupon

On Wednesday you can receive five Maplehood Watch Gachapon Coupons. Double-click each one to receive one random item including:
Items such as Dominator Pendant, Legendary Potential Scroll 50%, M-day Heart, X Weapon/Accessory/Pet Equipment Scrolls, and Gold and Silver Potential Stamps.

notes.title: [Update] Magic Wagon Temporarily Closed
notes.content:
[Update 3:30 PM Jan 13] We have temporarily closed the Magic Wagon sale event early while our team reviews certain aspects of its design. While its tab will still appear in the Cash Shop menu, the Magic Wagon UI itself will not appear, and items will not be purchasable with it.

We will let you know when we have more information on our steps forward, particularly as it relates to already purchased and used Restock Coupons. We apologize for the inconvenience, thank you for your patience.

- The MapleStory Team

----

The Magic Wagon is a special sales event that gives you a limited time to directly purchase new and rare items and take advantage of special discounts, including free items!
PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, January 13, 2021 12:00 AM - Tuesday, January 26, 2021 11:59 PMCET (UTC +1): Wednesday, January 13, 2021 9:00 AM - Wednesday, January 27, 2021 8:59 AMAEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, January 13, 2021 7:00 PM - Wednesday, January 27, 2021 6:59 PM

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/2479/magic-wagon-menu.png

In the Magic Wagon, you'll get a new set of six offers every six hours, featuring some returning items only available in the Magic Wagon, some currently available items with a steep discount, some brand new items never seen before in MapleStory, and even a variety of items available for free! With the Magic Wagon restocking every six hours, and a free Restock available each day and additional Restocks available for purchase, there's hundreds of deals available when the Magic Wagon arrives!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2021/q1/1042/magic-wagon-items-maplestory-january-2021-magic-wagon.png

notes.title: Awake Warm-Up Events
notes.content:
[Update 12:10 PM Nov 9] The Cash Shop Inventory Transfer Event's schedule has been updated. It will now begin at 11:30 AM PST on Wednesday, November 11. We apologize for the confusion.

[Update 4:20 PM Nov 2] The So Gong pet has a 90-day duration, not permanent as initially reported. We apologize for the error.

A new update is on the horizon, and it's time to warm-up with special events for the next two weeks and fun rewards!
Awake Warm-Up Event
PST (UTC -8): Tuesday, November 3, 2020 4:00 PM - Tuesday, November 17, 2020 3:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 4, 2020 1:00 AM - Wednesday, November 18, 2020 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, November 4, 2020 11:00 AM - Wednesday, November 18, 2020 10:59 AM
Event Details:
Open the Star Event Notifier on the left side of the screen, or speak to So Gong in Henesys, Leafre, or Nameless Town, and accept the "[Awake Warm-Up] Warm-Up In Order to Wake Up!" quest to begin!Requirement: Lv. 101 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2).Every day, use the Star Event Notifier, or speak to So Gong in Henesys, Leafre, or Nameless Town, and accept the "[Awake Warm-Up] Awakening Coin" quest to receive a Frozen Awakening Coin.After 30 uninterrupted minutes of being logged in on that character, the coin will be suitably warmed-up and defrost into an Awakening Coin, which you can use to complete the "[Awake Warm-Up] Awakening Coin" quest.When the Awake update arrives on November 18, you can receive the Awake Warm-up Box reward through the "[Awake Warm-up] Receive Awake Warm-up Box Reward" quest, which will award you additional prizes based on the number of Daily Quests you've completed (ex: if you complete 6 Daily Quests, you'll be able to claim rewards for 2x Daily Quests, 4x Daily Quests, and 6x Daily Quests)!
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q4/1432/awake-warm-up-event-rewards-maplestory.png

Event Rewards:
Daily Reward:2x EXP Coupon (2) (15 Min): 7-day duration, can be transferred to characters on the same account and world.2x Daily Quest Completions:Character Slot Expansion Coupon: 7-day duration, untradable.Can be claimed after the Awake update on November 18.4x Daily Quest Completions:So Gong Pet Package: Package has a 7-day duration, can be transferred to characters on the same account and world. Open the package to receive:So Gong Pet: 90-day duration, untradable. Can be transferred to Cash Inventory. Duration can be extended with Waters of Life items.So Gong's Wooden Stick: Pet Equipment for So Gong, permanent, untradable. Can be transferred to Cash Inventory.Can be claimed after the Awake update on November 18.6x Daily Quest Completions:Arcane Symbol Selection Coupon (30): 7-day duration, can be transferred to characters on the same account and world.Can be claimed after the Awake update on November 18.8x Daily Quest Completions:Nodestone (15): 7-day duration, can be transferred to characters on the same account and world.Can be claimed after the Awake update on November 18.10x Daily Quest Completions:All Star Hair Coupon Ticket: 7-day duration, can be transferred to characters on the same account and world.All Star Face Coupon Ticket: 7-day duration, can be transferred to characters on the same account and world.Can be claimed after the Awake update on November 18.
You can also take advantage of the Cash Inventory Transfer Event when it hits next week. This rare opportunity to move cash items between your characters goes away when the Awake update arrives on November 18!
Cash Inventory Transfer EventPST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 11, 2020 11:30 AM - Wednesday, November 18, 2020 (Start of Maintenance)
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 11, 2020 8:30 PM - Wednesday, November 18, 2020 (Start of Maintenance)
AEDT (UTC +11): Thursday, November 12, 2020 6:30 AM - Wednesday, November 18, 2020 (Start of Maintenance)
Event Details:
It's the time you have been waiting for! Transfer your cash items between your characters within the same world!Take this opportunity to move cash cover items between characters, move a beloved pet to a new character, and so much more!Follow these simple steps to transfer cash items between your characters:
Enter the Cash Shop.Pick an eligible item you would like to transfer to a different character, and move it into your Cash Inventory.Right-click the item.Click the "Transfer Within World" button from the menu.Select the recipient of the item from the drop-down menu and click the 'OK' button.The selected item will now appear in the other character’s Cash Inventory the next time you log in to that character.Rules and Restrictions
This event is available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds.You can only transfer cash items between characters in the same world.Cash items cannot be transferred using the "Transfer Within World" button between the classes that already share their Cash Inventory.Items that stack in one inventory slot cannot be split up and transferred.There are a few items that are not able to be transferred:
EXP CouponsPotion PotFriendship and Couple Items
Join the discussion on the Official MapleStory Discord or the Official MapleStory Forums!

notes.title: Burning World Event
notes.content:
Are you ready to race new characters to Lv. 150 with the biggest level-up event in MapleStory history? We're creating an entire new World with one purpose only: Powering through the early levels!
Burning World
Wednesday, July 22, 2020 (End of Maintenance) - Thursday, September 17, 2020 (Start of Maintenance)
Burning World is a special world with special rules that will exist only for the duration of the Burning World event, filled with boosts to make it easier than ever to level up fast. While on Burning World, all characters will gain the special Burning skill, which grants the following bonuses:
1.5x EXPWeapon ATT/Magic ATT +50Damage against Normal Monsters +30%Damage against Bosses +30%Critical Rate +30%Critical Damage +30%
You will also be able to create three Mega Burning characters, who operate in the same manner as in previous Mega Burning events: After reaching Lv. 10, every time that character levels up, they will also gain two bonus levels, all the way up to Lv. 150. Combined with the Burning EXP bonus and boosted damage, you'll be able to power your way through those levels faster than ever before!

http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/1140/burning-world-menu-v2.png

Additionally, even after your Mega Burning characters have been created, you'll be able to create another three characters to level up and leap, which will still benefit from the Burning skill! Please note that, while the default number of Character Slots on Burning World is eight, and can be expanded via Character Slot Coupons awarded from Daily Gifts and other avenues, only six characters will be able to World Leap when the Burning World event comes to a close, even if you have more than six Lv. 150 characters on the world.

As Burning World is a temporary world to be removed at the end of the World Leap stage, some MapleStory features will be unavailable there:
The Meso Market will not be available.Link Skills cannot be transferred between characters on Burning World (the Burning skill will have to be enough!).Maple Legion will be unavailable; the UI will be unavailable and you will be unable to progress on it past talking to Legion NPCs.Monster Collection will be unavailable, monsters will not be added to the collection and the UI will not open.Maple Tour will not be available.The following quests connected to the above features cannot be completed:Teaching Link SkillTeaching Zero's Link Skill[Legion] Whip the Whelps[Legion] Defeat the Golden Wyvern[Legion] We Are LegionTalk to Dame Appropriation[Legion] Legion Introduction[Monster Collection] Monster CollectorThe following Cash Shop items cannot be purchased on Burning World:Character Slot CouponAdd 4 Slots (Storage)Add 8 Slots (Storage)House Wedding TicketCommitment of Love TicketCustom Title PackagePromise RingCupid RingCloud Promise RingVenus FireworksCrossed HeartsIllumination Couples RingFriendship Ring: CloverFriendship Ring: Flower PetalFriendship Ring: StarSnow Dome Friendship RingBurning World Rewards
http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/1132/burning-world-items.png

http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q2/1117/pixel-burning-rewards-maplestory-mega-burning-at-the-pixel-party.png

http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q3/1134/world-leap-screen.png

As the saying goes, the light that burns twice as bright burns half as long, and the Burning World will burn very brightly indeed. However, while this new world will be consumed at the end of it all, a new life awaits your characters in the other Worlds of MapleStory!

Lv. 150+ characters on the Burning World will be allowed to Leap to another World of your choosing during the World Leap period, taking their equipped items, inventory, and mesos with them to join their new communities. When this period begins, all Burning World characters will be moved to the Burning Leap Zone map, where they will be able to speak to the NPC Mover to complete their exodus.
Characters on the Burning World must be at least Lv. 150 in order to World Leap, whether they were Mega Burning characters or not.Zero characters must be both Lv. 150+ and having completed Story Quest Act 2.It will not be possible to leave the Burning Leap Zone map during this period, making it impossible to gain any more EXP. Make sure you're Lv. 150 before the September 17 maintenance!Even if you have more than six Lv. 150 characters on Burning World, only six of them will be allowed to World Leap.You do not need an empty character slot on the destination world for your new character (you will be granted a free Character Slot if you are at your unlocked limit on that world), however if you have reached the maximum character limit on that world, you will need to delete a character in order to make room for them.Characters can be transferred to non-Reboot worlds only.Characters in Guilds will not be able to World Leap until they have either left or disbanded their Guild.Your character's equipped items, inventory, and mesos will be transferred with your character, but items within your Storage, Cash Shop Inventory, mail, and auction house will not be. Make sure you clear everything out before taking the big leap!You may send your Burning World characters all to the same world, or to different worlds.Medals obtained from regularly-resetting rankings will not be transferred, and your rankings in those pieces of content will also not be transferred.

notes.title: MapleStory's new update brings Burning World, rise events, and Yum Yum Island
notes.content:
Following the recent - and pretty hefty - MapleStory Rise: Promise of the Guardian update, the MMORPG is in for another chunky content drop with Rise: Surge of Power. The online RPG game's publisher Nexon America has announced the second portion of its big summer update will bring a "Burning World event", new Rise events, and discover secrets in a new island area.
The MapleStory Rise: Surge of Power event kicks off on July 22, and adds a brand-new Burning World event to the game, which means the chance - for a limited period of time - to create up to three Mega Burning characters. That is, get some characters levelled up in super quick time - running until September 17, the event will help you gain three levels every time you level up, until you hit 150.
In addition, new Rise events packed with Rise Coins include things like Eileen's support event, which gets you to eliminate monsters to hit some "training goals", and has a special skill on offer.
Read the rest of the story...

Adele Details

Adele is a powerful warrior who forms the mystical Aether into powerful blades that strike out against her foes. Armed with the mystical Bladecaster and Bladebinder weapons in lieu of mundane swords, her recovering memories will unlock greater and greater powers as she does battle in Maple World.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q2/2002/adele-combat-1.png

Adele can generate aether with her Aether Weaving skill, a resource that some skills use to empower attacks or create mystical blades that fly through fields, striking at any enemies they see. Various skills also gain special bonuses when Trigger Skills hit enemies, such as generating additional Aether or spawning blades that seek out and strike foes on their own.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q2/2005/adele-combat-2.png
Check out a few of Adele's amazing skills:Magic Dispatch: Creates a magical shard that hunts down an enemy. Unaffected by attack reflection. Level 20 required to learn Aetherial Arms. Max Level 20. Requires 1st Job Advancement.
http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q2/2006/magic-dispatch.gif
Skewering: [Trigger Skill] Creates multiple longswords that strike to the front. Max Level 20. Requires 2nd Job Advancement.
http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q2/2003/skewering.png
Hunting Decree: Issues a command to Aether Swords created with Aether Forge to pursue the enemy. Can only be used when there are aether swords present. The command only works on nearby swords, and if you are separated, the swords will return to attack. Unaffected by attack reflection. Pursues enemies only when Adele is in combat. Requires Lv. 10 Aether Forge. Level 20 required to learn Aether Bloom and Grave Proclamation. Max Level 20. Requires 3rd Job Advancement.
http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2020/q2/2004/hunting-decree.png

Adele is available for all players today, so create your own and power her up!

The Tera Burning Project is here to help you level a brand-new character up to Lv. 200!

Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds, except for Zero and Adele characters.

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 200 (once your character hits Lv. 199, they will only be leveled up to Lv. 200)!

In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including Root Abyss and Fafnir gear! When you reach Lv. 200 on your ‘Burning’ character, don’t stop there but keep on training! You will receive additional rewards every time you gain 5 levels on your ‘Burning’ character starting Lv. 200 until Lv. 210!

Here's How it Works

Create a brand-new character during the event period. From the character select screen, choose the new character on your account to have the "Burning" effect. Then, accept the quest "It's the Tera Burning Project gift giveaway!" from the star event notifier on the left-side of the game window in order to start receiving rewards! Only one character on your account can have the "Burning" effect.

http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5786/newteraeffect.png

Event Details:
Show off your mind with a special OX game with a twist!Requirement: Lv. 101 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2).You can accept the invitation quest at 15 minutes past the hour, every hour, from the invitation that appears on top of your character.There must be a minimum of 3 players for the game to start.This is an OX game where you will be given an image on the display screen and two options to choose from. You must move to the correct answer zone within the given time limit.Some questions will come with Surprise Difficulty settings, such as swapping the answer's sides, the question itself becoming obscured or revealed at odd times, and more, so keep on your toes!If you answer incorrectly, you will be moved to the bottom of the map. After a certain stage, a Survivor's List UI will be displayed only for those who lost the game. These players can select 1 survivor listed in the UI within the time limit. At the end of the stage, if the survivor you chose remains standing, you will also receive a part of the points for that round.The game will end when there are no more surviving characters, or when all 10 questions are answered.You can join as many times per day as you wish!If you listen to the game explanation from Gym Cat located at Extravagameza Event Hall, you'll receive a Divine Intelligence Badge.

Event Details:
It's high noon, so grab some big iron and take down your friends with this Gunslinger mini-game!Requirement: Lv. 101 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2).Talk to Game Master Jun located at Extravagameza Event Hall to queue for High Noon Gunslinger. Once 4 players have queued, you will be moved to the lobby map and the game will begin.The goal of this game is to drop your opponents by shooting the platforms they are on until you are the last one standing.During your turn, you will have 10 seconds to choose which direction to move (left, right, down, or stationary) and choose the platform to shoot.The quicker you input your directions and shot selection, the better your chances will be at going first. A sign will appear above your character's head indicating the order.If you shoot first and your opponent drops, they lose the chance to shoot on that turn.You can participate in the High Noon Gunslinger game 10 times per day per world. notes.title: Double Miracle Time Event
notes.content:
Saturday, December 21, 2019
PST (UTC -8): 12:30 AM – 1:30 AM & 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM & 9:00 PM – 10:00 PMEST (UTC -5): 3:30 AM – 4:30 AM & 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM & 12:00 AM (Dec 22) – 1:00 AM (Dec 22)CET (UTC +1): 9:30 AM – 10:30 AM & 11:00 PM – 12:00 AM (Dec 22) & 6:00 AM (Dec 22) – 7:00 AM (Dec 22)AEDT (UTC +11): 7:30 PM – 8:30 PM & 9:00 AM (Dec 22) – 10:00 AM (Dec 22) & 4:00 PM (Dec 22) – 5:00 PM (Dec 22)
Available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds.

If you've been searching for ways to boost your power, you're in luck! This Saturday is all about making you stronger through the mysterious power of Potential. Potential is a nifty system that allows you to add bonus effects to your equipment to make it truly heroic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/73436475a02abe1e041461a910c5dcd3a479923c.jpg

Cube away with Red Cubes, Black Cubes, and Bonus Potential Cubes during the Double Miracle Time event times with double the rates of a rank-up! If you've got White Cubes and Violet Cubes, you can use them for double the rates of a rank-up as well. There's a chance to raise your equipment's Potential rank TWICE with one cube! This means you could jump from Rare to Unique!

Make sure to earn those Reward Points and visit the Maple Rewards Shop, located in the Event > Maple Rewards Shop category of the Cash Shop. You can get Red Cubes and Black Cubes with your points!

We're also having the following special sales in non-Reboot worlds on December 21 only!
Radiant Red Cube Pack, Brilliant Black Cube Pack, and Dazzling Bonus Potential Cube Pack (which contain Red, Black or Bonus Potential Cubes, as well as a Unique Potential Scroll 30% Coupon)
We're having the following special sale in Reboot world on December 21 only!
30-packs of Red and Black Cubes
Note: We have lowered the minimum level required to purchase cubes with NX Credit or Maple Points. You need to have a character Lv. 60 or above in order to purchase cubes with NX Credit or Maple Points. There is no such restriction for purchasing cubes with NX Prepaid.

Please note that Double Miracle Time will be available on all worlds, including Reboot.
A scrolling message and a Cube icon will appear at the top of the screen during Double Miracle Time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0badcfb624c7793bb5ed9d60585d6793fb08f2f3.jpg
During the event, you'll have a 2x rate of increasing your potential's rank through Red Cubes, Black Cubes, Bonus Potential Cubes, White Cubes, and Violet Cubes!Cubes CAN be used on sealed equipment.Also, some of the luckiest players will be granted a Double Miracle Time Blessing after successfully increasing rank TWICE! This buff will allow everyone in the map to receive Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +30 for 15 minutes.

Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.

The Tera Burning Project is here to help you level a brand-new character up to Lv. 200!

Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds, except for Zero and Hoyoung characters.

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 200 (once your character hits Lv. 199, they will only be leveled up to Lv. 200)!

In addition to all this, you'll also earn amazing rewards along the way, including permanent Root Abyss and Fafnir gear! And if that wasn't enough, each time your character levels up between Lv. 201 and 220, you'll receive Arcane Symbols - all you have to do is accept the 'Tera Burning Project Arcane Symbols' quest!

Here's How it Works

Create a brand-new character during the event period. From the character select screen, choose the new character on your account to have the "Burning" effect. Then, accept the quest "It's the Tera Burning Project gift giveaway!" from the star event notifier on the left-side of the game window in order to start receiving rewards! Only one character on your account can have the "Burning" effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/9b58043e1c72d837d1b0efcabe93e4c853b86dd1.png

After completing the quest "It's the Tera Burning Project gift giveaway!," you will receive all of your gifts immediately; however, you will not be able to use all of them until you meet the required level for each reward.

notes.title: Hot Week Gifts!
notes.content:
PDT (UTC -7): Sunday, September 22, 2019 5:00 PM - Sunday, September 29, 2019 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Sunday, September 22, 2019 8:00 PM - Sunday, September 29, 2019 7:59 PM

AEST (UTC +10): Monday, September 23, 2019 10:00 AM - Monday, September 30, 2019 9:59 AM

MapleStory will be having a whole week of Hot Days! All you have to do is log in to start receiving great items!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/2e84a9105683ebb6b16bf0581975b3c8694ff396.png

Log in each day with a character Lv. 30 or above, and click the gift box icon on the left side of the screen to receive a Gift Box, and then double-click the box in your inventory to open it. The Gift Box can be obtained once in a 24-hour period every day, resetting at 5:00 PM PDT / 8:00 PM EDT / 2:00 AM CEST / 10:00 AM AEST.

Once you receive the gift box, you can open it anytime before 2:00 AM PDT / 5:00 AM EDT / 11:00 AM CEST / 7:00 PM AEST of the following day.

If you have more than 30 unclaimed gifts, you may not be able to see the Hot Week reward. Please clear any unclaimed gifts and login again to see the Hot Week reward.

All rewards are for both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds unless specifically noted below.

Monday, September 23
Pendant of the Spirit (7 Day): Unique equipped item. Untradeable, Time limit extension is not possible, 7-day duration.

Tuesday, September 24
Nodestone: Untradeable.

Wednesday, September 25
Character Slot Expansion Coupon: Untradeable, 7-day duration.

Thursday, September 26
2x EXP Coupon (30 Min) (x3): Use to receive 2x EXP for 30 minutes. Untradeable, 7-day duration.

Friday, September 27
Special Medal of Honor (x3): Untradeable.

Saturday, September 28
Selective 8-Slot Coupon: Untradeable, 7-day duration.

Sunday, September 29
Hyper Teleport Rock Coupon: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
Plus select one additional reward from the items given Monday through Saturday!


If you obtain and open each Gift Box every day from Monday to Saturday, then on Sunday—in addition to Sunday's reward—you can have another gift! You can select one from all of the items that were given out from Monday to Saturday. You are not required to have received each day's Gift Box on the same character in order to be eligible for the extra gift, but it does have to be with characters in the same world.

This event is available to players Lv. 30 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2). You can receive one gift box per account per day.

notes.title: Level Up With the Double Mega Burning Project!
notes.content:
PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, July 24, 2019 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, August 27, 2019 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Wednesday, July 24, 2019 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, August 27, 2019 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, July 24, 2019 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, August 28, 2019 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, July 24, 2019 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, August 28, 2019 9:59 AM

Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event.

The Double Mega Burning Project is here to help you level not one, but two brand-new characters up to Lv. 150!

Create two brand-new characters during the event period and select them to have the special "Burning" effect. After your characters reach Lv. 10, every time they level up they will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 150! This event is open to characters in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds, except for Pathfinder and Zero characters. (Please note that if you create an Illium character and select it as "Burning", you will need to complete your Illium questline first before teleporting out of the area. Otherwise you won't be able to get your 2nd job advancement properly).

Here’s How it Works

Create two brand-new characters during the event period. From the character select screen, choose the new character on your account to have the "Burning" effect.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/a3e346bd7c72059f8c503f0e9e6058a7450e43e7.png

Only two characters per world can have the "Burning" effect. Log in with your characters and select the quest '[Adventure] 1+2 Level Up Challenge!' from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. You will receive the following special gifts!

Rewards

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/19800f227c7f00c3444653254fbdb0e29a2f064e.png

Lv. 30 Equipment Box: Untradeable. Can only be opened at Lv. 30. Open to receive a weapon and armor set suitable for your class.
Mysterious Cryptic Gift Box: Untradeable. 7-day duration. Open to receive:
Snail: 5-hour Duration. Skills: Meso Magnet, Item Pouch. Cannot be moved to Cash Inventory. Cannot be revived with the Water of Life.

Legendary Cryptic Chest: Untradeable. Can only be opened at Lv. 100. Open to receive:
Frozen Hat: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +23 MaxHP/MaxMP +270, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, Defense +293. Upgrades available: 10.
Frozen Cape: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7, Defense +180, Speed +9, Jump +5. Upgrades available: 7.
Frozen Suit: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +27, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1, Defense +315. Upgrades available: 10.
Frozen Weapon Box: Untradeable. 7-day duration. Open to receive: 

Frozen Weapon: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. Stats will vary based upon your job.

Frozen Secondary Weapon Box: Untradeable. 7-day duration. Open to receive:

Frozen Secondary Weapon: Untradeable. Req. Lv: 100. Stats will vary based upon your job.

Mastery Box (x8): Untradeable.

Keep on Burning Title Coupon: Untradeable. Can only be used at Lv. 130. Use to receive:
Keep on Burning: Title. Untradeable. 14-day duration on stats. Req. Lv: 130. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +10, MaxHP/MaxMP +400, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10, Boss Damage +10%, Ignore DEF +10%.


Each time one of your characters levels up, they will receive two additional levels! Work your way up to Lv. 150, so you can wear those sweet equips!

notes.title: Double Miracle Time Event
notes.content:
Saturday, July 6 2019

PDT (UTC -7): 1:30 AM – 2:30 AM & 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM & 10:00 PM – 11:00 PM
EDT (UTC -4): 4:30 AM – 5:30 AM & 6:00 PM – 7:00 PM & 1:00 AM – 2:00 AM (July 7)
CEST (UTC +2): 10:30 AM – 11:30 AM & 12:00 AM – 1:00 AM (July 7) & 7:00 AM – 8:00 AM (July 7)
AEST (UTC +10): 6:30 PM – 7:30 PM & 8:00 AM – 9:00 AM (July 7) & 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM (July 7)

Available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds.

If you've been searching for ways to boost your power, you’re in luck! This Saturday is all about making you stronger through the mysterious power of Potential. Potential is a nifty system that allows you to add bonus effects to your equipment to make it truly heroic.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/97410666a9c42697aef63b5acef6b83db3271073.jpg

Cube away with Red Cubes, Black Cubes, and Bonus Potential Cubes during the Double Miracle Time event times with double the rates of a rank-up! If you’ve got White Cubes and Violet Cubes, you can use them for double the rates of a rank-up as well. There’s a chance to raise your equipment's Potential rank TWICE with one cube! This means you could jump from Rare to Unique!

Make sure to earn those Reward Points and visit the Maple Rewards Shop, located in the Special Promotions > Maple Rewards Shop category of the Cash Shop. You can get Red Cubes and Black Cubes with your points!

We’re also having the following special sales in non-Reboot worlds on July 6 only!

Cube Adventurers' Packs (which contain 60 Red, Black or Bonus Potential Cubes, as well as 5 Philosopher's Book items, Violet Cubes or White Cubes, and a Golden Hammer 100% Coupon)
Radiant Red Cube Pack, Brilliant Black Cube Pack, and Dazzling Bonus Potential Cube Pack (which contain Red, Black or Bonus Potential Cubes, as well as a Unique Potential Scroll 30% Coupon)
Red Cube and Black Cube Twelve Packs (which contain Red or Black Cubes and a Gold Awakening Stamp Coupon)
Gold and Silver Bonus Potential Packages (which contain Bonus Potential Cubes, Silver or Golden Bonus Potential Stamps, and a Special Bonus Potential Scroll)
Discounted 11-packs of Red and Black Cubes and 10-packs of Bonus Potential Cubes

We’re having the following special sale in Reboot world on July 6 only!

Discounted single Red and Black Cubes
Discounted 6-packs of Red and Black Cubes

Note: We have lowered the minimum level required to purchase cubes with NX Credit or Maple Points. You need to have a character Lv. 60 or above in order to purchase cubes with NX Credit or Maple Points. There is no such restriction for purchasing cubes with NX Prepaid.

Please note that Double Miracle Time will be available on all worlds, including Reboot.

A scrolling message and a Cube icon will appear at the top of the screen during Double Miracle Time.
During the event, you’ll have a 2x rate of increasing your potential’s rank through Red Cubes, Black Cubes, Bonus Potential Cubes, White Cubes, and Violet Cubes!
Cubes CAN be used on sealed equipment.
Also, some of the luckiest players will be granted a Double Miracle Time Blessing after successfully increasing rank TWICE! This buff will allow everyone in the map to receive Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +30 for 15 minutes.

Prepare for the adventure of your life as new class Pathfinder arrives in Maple World! This update brings tons of thrilling events including the return of Tera Burning Project and fun-filled Adventure Island. With the addition of system revamps and a new theme dungeon, you’ll find lots to explore!

notes.title: v.205 - Pathfinder Patch Notes
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4257ed272e05627354e60f1595aa1db9636a878d.jpg

Adventure awaits, dear Maplers! Our new Pathfinder class is almost here, so follow us to Adventure Island, where there’s a journey around every corner. Battle against monsters to prove yourself as a Maple World legend; use your code-breaking skills to earn prizes; win coins by wailing on test dummies in the training grounds; and join in other fun island events! We’re also making a number of job balance adjustments, increasing Star Force Enhancement success rates, and hosting a Tera Burning Project event where you can level up a new character quickly. If that wasn’t enough, you can also explore our brand new theme dungeon: the Secret Forest of Elodin! A new quest is on the horizon - join us with Pathfinder!

Read the Patch Notes here!

notes.title: 14th Anniversary Events Continue!
notes.content:
Nexon America’s celebration of 14 Years of MapleStory continues with these new 14th Anniversary Events! Head on down to 14th Street and join in on these fun events to rack up 14th Street Points. Every 100 14th Street Points will earn you one 14th Street Coin, which can be traded in at the Big Bang Store for exclusive new gifts (there is a limit of 20,000 14th Street points you can earn per day).

In addition to these new events starting now, there are plenty of other 14th Anniversary Events still ongoing which you can read all about here!

Becoming a Celeb!

PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, May 21, 2019 5:00 PM - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 4:59 PM

EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, May 21, 2019 8:00 PM - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 7:59 PM

CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, May 22, 2019 2:00 AM - Wednesday, June 12, 2019 1:59 AM

AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, May 22, 2019 10:00 AM - Wednesday, June 12, 2019 9:59 AM

Characters Lv. 61 and up can pay a visit to 14th Street by selecting the '[14th Street] Maple 14th Street Fair Festivites' quest from the 14th Street icon on the notifier on the left side of the screen. After accepting, you'll immediately receive the 14th Street Fairgoer title. As you complete 14th Street Events, your 14th Street Celebrity Status will increase and your 14th Street Fairgoer title stats will increase along with it!

14th Street Fairgoer: Title. Untradeable, stats duration lasts until June 12 at 12:00 AM UTC. Grants durational stats STR/DEX/INT/LUK + Celeb Status, MaxHP/MaxMP + (Celeb Status x 50), Weapon ATT/Magic ATT + Celeb Status, + Celeb Status% damage when attacking monsters, + Celeb Status% damage when attacking bosses, Ignore Defense + Celeb Status%.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/a5fd1b26254c3ff65e278284335286f502fe7726.png

Complete all the events on 14th Street to become a 14th Street Celebrity! Players Lv. 61 and up can participate by accepting the ‘[14th Street Celeb] Celeb Status’ quest through the 14th Street icon in the star event notifier. Once you've met all the requirements for each event, you'll earn the 14th Street Celeb medal!

14th Street Celeb: Medal. Untradeable. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK + 14, MaxHP/MaxMP +750, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/d4096efcc928ed98e7473b839e84a06334357a78.png

Though some 14th Street events have already ended, you can still become a 14th Street Celeb! Accept the ‘[14th Street Celeb] Becoming a 14th Street Celeb!’ quest within the star event notifier on the left side of the screen, then hunt monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) - the monsters will drop 14th Street Celeb Passes. These passes will help fulfill 14th Street Celeb requirements for the 14th Street events that have ended (you cannot fulfill requirements for events that are still in progress.). You can collect up to 100 14th Street Celeb Passes a day per character. 

Override Fashion

Obtain 100 Override Fashion Coupons: 100 14th Street Celeb Passes

Obtain 200 Override Fashion Coupons: 200 14th Street Celeb Passes


Restaurant RED Maplelin Star Grub

Hunt Hidden Monster 15 times: 75 14th Street Celeb Passes

Obtain Maplelin Star Grub! Reward 300 times: 200 14th Street Celeb Passes


FIREPOWER Mega Burning

Reach Lv. 130: 130 14th Street Celeb Passes

Reach Lv. 150: 150 14th Street Celeb Passes


Nova Planetarium Sub-Zero Hunt

Charge monsters consecutively for 3 days: 150 14th Street Celeb Passes

Charge 15,000 or more monsters: 200 14th Street Celeb Passes





14th Street Big Bang Attack

PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, May 21, 2019 5:00 PM - Tuesday, June 4, 2019 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, May 21, 2019 8:00 PM - Tuesday, June 4, 2019 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, May 22, 2019 2:00 AM - Wednesday, June 5, 2019 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, May 22, 2019 10:00 AM - Wednesday, June 5, 2019 9:59 AM

Collect 14th Street Coins by using a special new skill! Characters Lv. 61 and up can participate by accepting the ‘[14th Street] Big Bang Attack! Can you handle it?’ quest through NPC Toben Hair Hero next to Big Bang Store, located in Maple 14th Street Fair map.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/0d096ab73af349b5d607ff1e0be2739247e9dd17.png

When you accept the quest, you'll acquire the 'Big Bang Attack' skill. You can charge it by hunting monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above). When the skill is charged, you can unleash it to collect 14th Street Points (x300). You'll also earn an additional 15 points and a 50% EXP bonus for every monster hunted with 'Big Bang Attack' skill. If you've reached your coin capacity of the day, you can no longer use ‘Big Bang Attack’ to obtain 14th Street Coins.

Renegade Personal Fitness Training

PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, May 21, 2019 5:00 PM - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, May 21, 2019 8:00 PM - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, May 22, 2019 2:00 AM - Wednesday, June 12, 2019 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, May 22, 2019 10:00 AM - Wednesday, June 12, 2019 9:59 AM

Earn EXP by training at the Renegade Fitness gym! If you visit the gym, you'll earn EXP proportionate to your level every 10 seconds just by standing in the gym! You can do this for up to 8 hours a day.

Characters Lv. 105 and up can earn even more EXP by accepting the ‘[14th Street] Renegade Personal Training’ quest through NPC So Gong in front of Renegade Fitness. After talking to NPC So Gong, you can designate a coach character and a trainee character to provide support perks while out hunting monsters. The character you are currently logged in as will become the coach. Once per world, you can designate another character on your account as the trainee character (the trainee character must be above level 105 and below 190; your trainee character cannot have a higher level than that of your coach character, and cannot be Zero or Pink Bean characters. You cannot cancel or change your coach and trainee characters once chosen). When you hunt monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) with your coach character, a portion of the EXP gained will automatically be applied to the trainee character!

Once your trainee reaches Lv. 190, the event effect will disappear and you'll earn the Personal Training Completionist title!

Personal Training Completionist: Title. Untradeable, stat duration lasts for 30 days. Grants durational stats Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5, 15% additional EXP.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/2ef1e30cb0f806d462350d1082604db47748dfca.png



Round-We-Go Cafe Rising Heroes!

PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, May 21, 2019 5:00 PM - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, May 21, 2019 8:00 PM - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, May 22, 2019 2:00 AM - Wednesday, June 12, 2019 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, May 22, 2019 10:00 AM - Wednesday, June 12, 2019 9:59 AM

Earn EXP coupons by visiting Cafe Rising Heroes with your friends! Form a party with 3 or more guild members and be on the same map and channel, and enter Cafe Rising Heroes from 14th Street. After hanging out there for a minute, you'll have the option to leave and receive a 2x EXP Coupon! You can receive this reward once per day.

You can also earn 14th Street Points by juggling drink orders (literally!) in the Cafe Rising Heroes mini-game! Characters Lv. 61 and above can play by accepting the ‘[14th Street] Round-We-Go Cafe Rising Heroes!’ quest through NPC Eileen in front of Cafe Rising Heroes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/cd50a1930b10111924f74a0beeb4a0278d47a777.png

The goal of this game is to avoid the falling germs while keeping the tea cups balanced. Use your mouse to move the stick balancing the cup on the tray, and avoid all falling obstacles without spilling the drink. There are a total of 15 stages; you'll earn stacking 14th Street Points as you clear each stage. Even if you have reached the daily limit, you can keep playing the Cafe Rising Heroes game. 

14th Street Sky

PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, May 28, 2019 5:00 PM - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, May 28, 2019 8:00 PM - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, May 29, 2019 2:00 AM - Wednesday, June 12, 2019 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, May 29, 2019 10:00 AM - Wednesday, June 12, 2019 9:59 AM

Soar above the city to earn 14th Street Coins at Legends Tower 62! Characters Lv. 61 and up can play by accepting the ‘[14th Street] 14th Street Sky’ quest through NPC Grizzle in front of Legend Tower 62.

The goal of this game is to fly as far as you can to earn 14th Street Points. Dash and jump your way through as many items as you can—you'll earn 14th Street Coins depending on how far you flew! You'll also earn Sky Points as you fly, which will grant special level-up effects once you collect enough, allowing you to earn even more 14th Street Coins! If you've reached your daily coin capacity of the day, you will no longer obtain 14th Street Coins, but you can keep playing 14th Street Sky.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/15cc1af3f89b4ae8f559fb5ac229e90980c9e5b8.png

You can also visit the roof of Legends Tower 62 to obtain Legendary Maple Leaves! Every 5 minutes the maple trees will drop leaves which you can collect in order to earn Honor EXP! You need to leave and re-enter to spawn more leaves.

Finding Spiegelmann's Art

PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, May 28, 2019 5:00 PM - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, May 28, 2019 8:00 PM - Tuesday, June 11, 2019 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, May 29, 2019 2:00 AM - Wednesday, June 12, 2019 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, May 29, 2019 10:00 AM - Wednesday, June 12, 2019 9:59 AM

Pay a visit to the Ark Museum and earn Trait Points! Stand next to one of the designated status in the museum, and after appreciating it a bit, you'll earn +2 Trait Points! You can earn up to 500 points per trait daily.

You can also help Spiegelmann retrieve his art collection! Characters Lv. 61 and up can start by accepting the ‘[14th Street] Spiegelmann’s Art Retrieval’ quest through NPC Spiegelmann in front of Ark Museum. Hunt monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) to get monsters to drop Spiegelmann’s Artwork. Each Spiegelmann's Artwork will automatically grant you 14th Street Coins (x2), and you can collect up to 100 pieces of Spiegelmann’s Artwork a day per character.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/27af483d7bfdc10c1f386c6f61c14118698a7451.png

You can also receive a daily reward when you complete the quest once a day per world. For your daily reward, you can select 1 of the following:

3x EXP Coupon (15 min): Untradeable, 1-day duration.
Nodestone: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
Arcane Symbol Selector Coupon: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
14th Street Coin Coupon (x30): Untradeable, 1-day duration.
100 Maple Reward Points (x2): Untradeable, 1-day duration.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/0d177ec60c76e2944dcb13486a715b7277cd18c2.png

Big Bang Store

Pay a visit to the Big Bang Store and spend your hard-earned 14th Street Coins on amazing rewards! You can access the Big Bang Store by talking to NPC Yeti on the Maple 14th Street Fair Map. Weekly items will reset every Thursday at 12:00 AM UTC during the event period.

Players Lv. 61 and up can help Peplock Holmes and his trusty sidekick Yettson by accepting the ‘[Peplock Holmes] Peplock Holmes Detective Office’ quest through the star event notifier on the left side of the screen or through NPC Peplock Holmes, who can be found in Henesys, Leafre, or Nameless Town.

Once you accept the quest, hunt down monsters near your level (20 levels above or 20 levels below). The monsters will drop Detective Office Passes—once you have collected 200 Detective Office Passes, return to NPC Peplock Holmes and you can begin solving mysteries!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/3abf763f05037e2a270ec1e668406a1f6867018d.png

Think you've got a good eye for snooping out the little details? Put it to the test in our Spot the Difference mini-game! Players Lv. 61 and up can participate by accepting the ‘[Event] Spot the Difference with Everyone!’ quest through the magnifying glass icon within the star event notifier. You can accept the invitation quest every hour at the 15 minute and 45 minute mark from the invitation that appears on top of your character.

In this game, 3 players work together to find the most differences between two near-identical pictures. There are a total of 5 stages per game, and the goal is to find the most differences and clear all 5 stages within the time limit. You'll earn points by finding the correct answers individually and by clearing the stage as a group.

notes.title: MapleStory Fest Coming This May!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/6ea8e700b0225154587716aa2c7ff655fe6cf688.jpg

We at Nexon America are happy to announce that MapleStory Fest will be returning for its 2nd year in a row on May 11 in Los Angeles, CA! May 11, 2019 marks our 14th Anniversary, so come celebrate the legacy of MapleStory alongside Nexon's game developers and publishers as well as your fellow fans at MapleStory Fest!

Here's a sneak peek at some of the fun activities you'll be able to join in at this year's all-day event:

Celebrate MapleStory's 14th Anniversary!
Hear exclusive new announcements about what's coming this summer for MapleStory and MapleStory 2!
Participate in fun on-site activities and events alongside developers, community influencers, Nexon employees, and other Maplers!
Go shopping at our brand new merch store!
See MapleStory music performed live!
Enter raffle drawings for special, limited-edition prizes!
Receive EXCLUSIVE gifts with the purchase of your ticket!
Check out amazing fan art!
Become part of the show by signing up for our cosplay contest!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4b576d918a99b622c80a1881373a403d3863fa45.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/5d90cf8608000d6109a130676b2dd40ae53ff437.jpg

We're excited to see you all to celebrate another year of wonderful adventures in Maple World! Tickets for MapleStory Fest go on sale Monday, March 25 at 11:00 AM PDT. Only a limited supply of tickets will be available for sale, so be sure to act fast before they sell out. 

Visit our MapleStory Fest website to learn more!

notes.title: Retro World Events!
notes.content:
Blast back to the 8-bit era with these Retro World Events! Characters Lv. 61 and up can participate by opening the ‘[Event] Retro World Opens!’ quest through the 8-bit ‘R’ icon within the star notifier or though the Retro World Console, which can be found in Henesys, Leafre, or Nameless Town. Participate in these events to earn Retro Points. For every 100 Retro Points, you’ll automatically receive 1 Retro Coin, which can be used in the Retro World Coin Shop! (You can earn up to 20,000 Retro Points every day, and 40,000 Retro Points every Sunday).

Promote the Game!

PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, March 12, 2019 4:59 PM (PDT)

EST (UTC -5): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, March 12, 2019 7:59 PM (EDT)

CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, March 13, 2019 12:59 AM

AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, March 13, 2019 10:59 AM

Help Game Master Jun promote the opening of Retro World! Characters Lv. 61 and above can participate by accepting the quest ‘[Retro World] Promote the Game!’ through the 8-bit ‘R’ icon within the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. You can then hunt monsters near your level (20 levels below and 20 levels above) to earn Retro World Promo Coupons! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/3659f8a93182e6047c31d511b2e25a98d5bfb123.png

You can earn a max of 40 coupons daily. For every Retro World Promotion Coupon, you can earn 500 Retro Points.

Mercenary’s Jump Training

PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, April 9, 2019 4:59 PM (PDT)

EST (UTC -5): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, April 9, 2019 7:59 PM (EDT)

CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, April 10, 2019 1:59 AM (CEST)

AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, April 10, 2019 9:59 AM (AEST) 

Get your platforming on to train for the Demon King's Tower in Mercenary's Jump Training! Talk to NPC Gunnolf in Retro World map and accept the ‘[Retro World] Mercenary’s Jump Training’ quest to enter the Jump Training Area. Your goal is to jump your way from one side of the training ground to the other before the time runs out in 60 seconds. You can also earn Retro Coins by collecting them as as you hop across the map! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/7294b1835492255869c93c26c37502dd97043270.png

Once you have obtained 20,000 Retro Points from the Mercenary’s Jump Training Area, you'll earn the Retro World Champion Jumper title!

Retro World Champion Jumper: Title. Untradeable. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +5, Jump +15.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/1d70051ef7d6a1458fc9bcff368ea1cc6085a27d.png

Magician’s Dodge Training

PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, April 9, 2019 4:59 PM (PDT)

EST (UTC -5): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, April 9, 2019 7:59 PM (EDT)

CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, April 10, 2019 1:59 AM (CEST)

AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, April 10, 2019 9:59 AM (AEST) 

Leap around and dodge Magician's flames to train for the Demon King's Tower in Magician's Dodge Training! Complete the ‘[Retro World] Magician’s Dodge Training’ quest through NPC Photios in Retro World map to enter the Magician’s Dodge Training Area. The goal of this game is to successfully dodge all the fireballs for 2 minutes. You can also collect any Retro Coins that you find in the area. Once you've been hit by 5 fireballs, you'll be sent back to Retro World.  You can enter the Magician’s Flame Dodge Training Area twice a day per world.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/be095190dab6d09be99a4c23cfca4b3eee30b03d.png

If you earn 20,000 points from the Magician’s Dodge Training Area, you'll receive the Retro World Champion Dodger title!

Retro World Champion Dodger: Title. Untradeable. Grants ATT/Magic ATT +2, Movement Speed +15.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/f7feee4c8caa1e9d3303b4040ac80b546b1fae06.png

Demon King’s Tower

PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, April 9, 2019 4:59 PM (PDT)

EST (UTC -5): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, April 9, 2019 7:59 PM (EDT)

CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, April 10, 2019 1:59 AM (CEST)

AEDT (UTC +11): Wednesday, March 6, 2019 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, April 10, 2019 9:59 AM (AEST) 

Once you have completed your training in the ‘Retro World Champion Dodger’ and ‘Retro World Champion Jumper’ quests (by earning the Retro World Champion Dodger and Retro World Champion Jumper titles), you can finally enter the Demon King’s Tower. Accept ‘[Retro World] Eliminate the Demon King’ quest to enter the Demon King’s Tower.

In the tower, you will have to complete 4 stages that consist of 5 floors each in order to face the Demon King. You'll have to use your jumping and evading skills that you learned from Magician and Mercenary to reach the 21st floor where the Demon King awaits. If you fail the stage, you'll have to start over. You can earn Retro Coins by eliminating the monsters and opening the treasure chests in the Tower.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c69eb99f58701196fa3c080e960347df3179ae83.png

notes.title: Cash Inventory Transfer Event
notes.content:
Thursday, February 28 to Wednesday, March 6

This event will begin after the maintenance on February 28.
This event will end after the maintenance on March 6.
Do you have a cash item you’ve wanted to move to another character on your account? Now you can!

For a limited time, you will be able to transfer most cash items between your characters within the same world. Take this opportunity to share a Hyper Teleport Rock, move cash cover items between characters, move a beloved pet to a new character, and more!

This event is available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds. You can only transfer cash items between characters in the same world. This does not include different worlds in the same world alliance. For example, you can transfer items between two characters on Mardia, but you cannot transfer an item from a character on Mardia to a character on Kradia.

Trading cash items between your characters is easy! All you need to do is follow these simple steps:

1. Enter the Cash Shop.
2. Pick an eligible item you would like to transfer to a different character, and move it into your Cash Inventory.
3. Right-click the item.
4. Click the ‘TRANSFER’ button.
5. Select the recipient of the item from the drop down.
6. Click the ‘OK’ button.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/3c0b5a311ef300da61c0d3336329fecde77229a3.png

The selected item will now appear in the other character’s Cash Inventory the next time you login to that character. All jobs are able to transfer cash items between each other, except Explorers since they already share their Cash Inventory.

There are a few items that are not able to be transferred:

EXP Coupons
Potion Pot
Friendship and Couple items

Take part in these events to earn special rewards including Hong Bao currency, which can be traded in at the Hong Bao shop! Each event will be available during the time frame listed above. You can read more about these individual events here.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/a84216e542cbf2a2b9eb62c813ea815700eb21bc.png

notes.title: Level Cap Increase & More!
notes.content:
Now that the Black Mage is finally gone, there are many changes happening in Maple World! We're increasing the max level cap, unveiling new Genesis Weapons, making Tenebris available permanently, and more! Read all about it below:

Level Cap Increase

To celebrate the defeat of the Black Mage, we're increasing the max level cap to Lv. 275! Now you can make your character stronger than ever. If you can reach Lv. 275, as a reward you'll receive the Symbol of Brilliant Honor Chair!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/6966193f1be8610f034b9debf844119c22ea665a.png

Tenebris Content Available Pemanently!

Even though the war is over, we will opening the Tenebris region for players to explore permanently! You can enter Moonbridge, the Labyrinth of Suffering, and Limina if you meet the following conditions:


Moonbridge: Characters Lv. 245 and above that have completed the Esfera: Origin Sea story quest
Labyrinth of Suffering: Characters Lv. 250 and above that have completed the Moonbridge story quest
Limina: Characters Lv. 255 and above that have completed the Labyrinth of Suffering story quest


New quests will be added to Tenebris daily. You can play the daily quests by clearning the story quests in each region of Tenebris. You can play 1 quest in each region for a total of up to 3 daily quests each day.

You can still face the deadly bosses of Tenebris as well, including the Black Mage himself! Here's how to fight each boss:

Gloom

Complete the Moonbridge story quest to find Gloom in the Eye of the Void.
A party of 1-6 can fight Gloom.
Entry count limited to once daily. Clear count limited to once per week.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b98bdcbb6157711b31a9ca9991ad5e22b9c2597f.jpg

Verus Hilla


Complete the Labyrinth of Suffering story quest and clear the Labyrinth of Suffering Deep Core Dungeon to find Verus Hilla.
A party of 1-6 can fight Verus Hilla.
Entry count limited to once daily. Clear count limited to once per week.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/85b5c74adeb99f7d2479e85e36b499363693c4ad.png

Guard Captain Darknell


Complete the Limina story quest to find Darknell in the Final Horizon.
A party of 1-6 can fight Guard Captain Darknell.
Entry count limited to once daily. Clear count limited to once per week.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c7833c7a23a82c9a6396b71dd3738c921f194126.png

The Black Mage


Complete the Limina story quest to find the Black Mage in the Giant's Heart.
You need the Fragment of Destiny to find the Black Mage. to craft it, you will need the following materials:

Spark of Determination: Acquire by completing Tenebris daily quests and by defeating Gloom or Darknell.
Shadow of Annihilation: Acquire by eliminating Verus Hilla.

A part of 1-6 can fight the Black Mage.
Entry count limited to once daily. Clear count limited to once per week.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/8d6584a2908ff71e04d1a011287427c143fddfa0.png

New Genesis Weapons

Characters Lv. 225 and above that have made the 5th job advancement can track down the remnants of the Black Mage's power to unlock new Genesis Weapons! Once you complete the Limina story quest, you'll receive the Genesis weapon quest through the notifier on the left side of the screen. Accept the quest receive a Sealed Genesis Weapon Box from the quest to obtain a weapon based on your class!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/da93bfa18dab81f1c7eea57676acfa793f99183a.png

You can complete various missions afterwards to unleash the true power of your sealed Genesis weapon. These missions involve defeating each of the Black Mage's Commanders with special restrictions in place. Upon defeating each Commander (excluding Von Leon), you'll also need to defeat the Black Mage's Afterimage 8 times so you can claim a trace item. Upon completing all missions, Zero will acquire a Genesis Essence that can enhance Lapis/Lazuli to a Type 10.

Each character can have 1 Genesis weapon, and it cannot be traded. If you lose any of the Genesis weapon items (sealed Genesis weapon, Genesis weapon, Genesis Essence) during your quest, then you must start over from the first mission. When the final seal on the Genesis weapon is removed, your weapon will receive the following qualities:


Use all available upgrade count with 15% Spell Trace enhancements suitable to each job.
Star Force 22-Star Enhancement
Has Unique Potential
Has Epic Bonus Potential
Additional Star Force and scroll enhancements are not available.
Zero can choose whether to transfer Potential and Bonus Potential.


You can also use the two new skills listed below when you equip the Genesis weapon, depending on its unleashed state:


Aeonian Rise: Use the power of creation to become invincible for 12 sec. When the skill ends, activates the Genesis Force which attacks 12 enemies with 1,500% damage 7 times. Use the skill again to end immediately. Cooldown: 180 sec.
Tanadian Ruin: When the attack hits, the Power of Destruction activates and increases Final Damage by 15% for 30 sec. Cooldown: 90 sec.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b209d2a6252012a12fac156d02dc2102ad0de7cd.png

The Story Continues

Just because the Black Mage has finally been defeated doesn't mean the story's over yet...

Coming soon in a future update, prepare to return to Grandis to learn more about Magnus and his master, Gerand Darmoor. There's plenty more to be revealed, so stay tuned and get ready for a new, epic chapter of MapleStory to unfold!

notes.title: The Fight Against the Black Mage Begins!
notes.content:
The time is finally here! Maplers everywhere have fought to gather Determination for the Journey of Destiny, and now the battle against the Black Mage can finally begin. Read all about the battle below, as well as other events that we'll be running along with this massive showdown!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/7e881bad792388f9426b069a4d89339c844da456.png

The Battle Against the Black Mage

To begin the battle with the Black Mage, your character must be Lv. 200 or higher, have completed their 5th Job Advancement, and completed the scenario following the Journey of Destiny. Accept either the "[Alliance Mission] Special Mission - The Black Mage 1" or "[Alliance Mission] Special Mission - The Black Mage 2" quest from the quest notifier or from NPC Athena Pierce at the Outpost to enter the fight. You can enter the fight every 2 hours starting at 1:30 AM UTC each day. Once you've reached your daily limit for Determination, you won't be able to enter the fight again until the next day.

The Black Mage's HP is shared with all of Maple World, so your goal each time you enter the fight is to deal a certain amount of damage and survive as long as you can! You'll be able to die 12 times before being ejected from the battle, and you can monitor how many lives you have left via the circular Life Count meter at the top of the screen. There are multiple phases to the Black Mage fight that you'll have to push through in order to save Maple World. The first phase of the fight will have you facing his godlike henchmen, the Aeonian Rise and the Tanadian Ruin. These two evil beings will teleport around the arena dealing deadly blows as the battlefield around you slowly becomes smaller, so they'll require some strategic defense to overpower!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/7a5a58633863d75ffa7a95f00556a57a9a069e1f.png

From there, the Black Mage himself will emerge with his own powerful array of attacks. He can cast a variety of spells that will coat the entire map in Dark Magic, so protect yourself if you don't want to be immediately destroyed! Keep pushing forward through his attacks to progress the battle, but be warned; the Black Mage has some tricks up his sleeve that he won't reveal until later in the fight!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/8d6584a2908ff71e04d1a011287427c143fddfa0.png

The ultimate battle is finally upon us, so give everything you've got to save Maple World once and for all!

Determination Unleashed

This event will start after the Black Mage fight begins.

Even if you haven't signed up to join the Maple Alliance, you can support the battle against the Black Mage by collecting lots and lots of Determination! Normal citizens of Maple World Lv. 61 and up can participate in Determination Unleashed by accepting the "[Determination Unleashed] Collective Determination" quest. A number of quests will then become available; complete 5 town quests per day to complete the main "[Determination Unleashed] Collective Determination" quest (this quest can be completed once a day). Town quests include activating Runes, defeating Elite Monsters, earning Combo Kills, and more!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/9ba6c7d01d18a816b04d6a2d5893c312d39aeb72.png

You can earn a varying amount of Determination based on which area quests you complete:

Collective Determination: 1,500 Determination
Fairy Academy Determination: 450 Determination
Gold Beach Determination: 50 Determination
Riena Strait Determination: 225 Determination
Monstrous Determination: 900 Determination
Perion Warrior Determination: 600 Determination
Kerning City's Determination: 300 Determination
Momijigaokan Determination: 150 Determination
Get out there and complete quests to rack up Determination for the Maple Alliance!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e1ee827e989a35fa64f13c676ae6dbd4c06c2606.png
