notes.title: Maple Alliance Events Continue!
notes.content:
The final fight against the Black Mage is almost here, so jump into these Maple Alliance events to help complete the Journey of Destiny! If your character is Lv. 61 or higher, join the Maple Alliance and start completing Maple Alliance missions to accumulate Determination. As you and other players gain Determination, the World Gauge will gradually fill up and progress the story, and help to unlock the final battle against the Black Mage! Starting with the opening of the Limina region, the daily Determination cap for players has been raised to 50,000.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/59e090c5f9541defcc02b4e646ae51da40352827.png

In addition, every time one of the three goddess statues is completely filled with Determination, a 2x EXP event will activate for 24 hours in all Reboot and non-Reboot worlds! This event will start up to 1 hour after the goddess statue is completed. Go out and gather Determination to help the Maple Alliance!

Enter Limina: The Black Mage's Keep

After escaping the Labyrinth of Suffering and defeating Verus Hilla, the final Tenebris region of Limina will unlock! Players who are Lv. 200 or higher and have completed the 5th Job advancement can enter Limina by completing the "[Black Mage] Outpost Gathering" quest.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c71a2b22f50542ea2b54324a1e6f3af35cf92c37.jpg

Once you reach Limina, accept the "[Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Limina" quest to help the Tenebris Expedition on their journey through this perilous region! After you accept the mission, you'll be given three random Expedition Missions that will require you to face various deadly trials throughout the Limina region. Some of these trials involve facing an onslaught of monsters like the Seeds of Life, while others will require you to avoid destructive incoming attacks like the Light of Annihilation beam! You can play three of these quests per day, with the timer resetting at midnight UTC. If you can complete all three in a day, you'll receive 10,000 Determination, as well as the quest "[Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Limina" which you can complete to earn the following Alliance Drops!

6,000,000 Mesos
Nodestone (x2) (Untradeable)
Rare Treasure Chest. Each account has a daily limit of opening 30 chests per day. Contains one of the following:
Soul Shard: Untradeable.
Clean Slate Scroll 10%
Innocence Scroll 50%
Chaos Scroll 60%
Bonus Potential Scroll 50%
Master Craftsman's Cube: Tradeable within account.
Meister's Cube: Tradeable within account.
Chaos Scroll of Goodness 30%
Epic Potential Scroll 50%
Intermediate Bonus Potential Stamp
Be careful when you're wandering through Limina however; occasionally, an Erda Surge will overtake the map, forcing you to take shelter under protective barriers while monsters attempt to destroy your cover!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/aa18f2bf3e2d82afef9da7b44d66c1650f6e0374.png

Orchid will also attempt to halt your progress by casting an all-consuming Black Hole! You'll need to defeat 30 Ascendions in a limited amount of time before getting sucked into the void!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/96c68e00ed4309c1cd62e4c181dd269e988712dc.png

Once the Determination Gauge has been filled for this region, you'll be able to do battle with the region's boss, Guard Captain Darknell. You can access Guard Captain Darknell by entering "World's Sorrow" through the portal to the right of the Maple Alliance Outpost. While fighting Darknell, meteors will plummet all around you, dealing constant damage and potentially stunning you. At the same time, Darknell will summon powerful foes to distract you, including Elite Bosses, Corrupted Warriors, Rampant Cyborgs, and more, so come prepared for this fierce opponent! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c7833c7a23a82c9a6396b71dd3738c921f194126.png

Keep fighting your way through Limina...the Black Mage is near!

Cleansing Light

This mission will start alongside the Limina Expedition, and will last until the Black Mage is defeated.

Use the power of light to defeat your enemies! In Cleansing Light, characters Lv. 61 and above that have completed the "[Black Mage] Outpost Gathering!" quest and joined the Maple Alliance will gain access to a new mission called "[Alliance Mission] Defense Mission - Cleansing Light." Accepting this quest will grant you the "Cleansing Light" skill.

You can activate "Cleansing Light" by right-clicking in a map with monsters near your level range (20 levels above or 20 levels below). Eliminating monsters while this skill is activated has the potential to trigger a countdown timer. Once the timer reaches zero, a powerful light will shine above your character, delivering massive damage to monsters and granting you Determination! You can earn 10 Determination for each monster eliminated with the Cleansing Light, with a daily cap of 150 Determination.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/05f000ab474399769b414cc07ac04d931a80d534.png

Battle at Sea

This mission will start alongside the Limina Expedition, and will last until the Black Mage is defeated.

Take to the sea in the fight against the Black Mage! In the Battle at Sea mission, characters Lv. 61 and up that have completed the "[Black Mage] Outpost Gathering!'" quest and joined the Maple Alliance will have access to the quest "[Alliance Mission] Defense Mission - Battle at Sea" from the notifier or Athena Pierce at the Outpost.

Begin the quest by speaking to NPC Olaf in the Waiting Area. You'll be placed on a naval ship, where you and your crew will have a limited amount of time to defeat as many enemies as possible! The level of your ship and crew will be determined by your Captain Rank. By defeating waves of enemies, you'll earn Naval Battle Points and Gold Coins. Your Gold Coins can be used to enhance your ship or hire new crew mates (you can also gain crew members by saving captured prisoners that have been taken by the Black Mage's sea army). Your Naval Battle Points can used to increase your Captain Rank, which will increase the speed of your ship as well as your crew's baseline level.

At the end of the mission, you can trade your Naval Battle Points for Determination! 100 Naval Battle Points can be traded for 1 Determination. You can earn a daily cap of 1 million Naval Battle Points in this mission. Sail the high seas and earn Determination for the Maple Alliance!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/375d5af2b2ed00667c933d8c0d06544bc69699c3.png

Log in each day with a character Lv. 30 or above, and click the gift box icon on the left side of the screen to receive a Gift Box, and then double-click the box in your inventory to open it. The Gift Box can be obtained once in a 24-hour period every day, resetting at 4:00 PM PST / 7:00 PM EST / 1:00 AM CET / 11:00 AM AEDT.

Once you receive the gift box, you can open it anytime before 1:00 AM PST / 4:00 AM EST / 10:00 AM CET / 8:00 PM AEDT of the following day.

If you have more than 30 unclaimed gifts, you may not be able to see the Hot Week reward. Please clear any unclaimed gifts and login again to see the Hot Week reward.

All rewards are for both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds unless specifically noted below.

Monday, December 24
Pendant of the Spirit: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
Tuesday, December 25
Nodestone: Untradeable
Wednesday, December 26
Character Slot Expansion Coupon: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
Thursday, December 27

Friday, December 28
Alliance Medal (x50): Untradeable.
Saturday, December 29
Selective 8 Slot Coupon: Untradeable, 7-day duration.

1,000 Maple Reward Points: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
Plus select one additional reward from the items given Monday through Saturday!
Monday, December 31
2x Drop Coupon (1 hour) (x3): Untradeable, 7-day duration.
Tuesday, January 1
Hyper Teleport Rock Coupon: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
If you obtain and open each Gift Box every day from Monday to Saturday, then on Sunday—in addition to Sunday's reward—you can have another gift! You can select one from all of the items that were given out from Monday to Saturday. You are not required to have received each day’s Gift Box on the same character in order to be eligible for the extra gift, but it does have to be with characters in the same world (multiple worlds in World Alliances don't count).

This event is available to players Lv. 30 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2). You can receive one gift box per account per day.

notes.title: New Maple Alliance Events!
notes.content:
The war against the Black Mage has finally begun, so join Cygnus in her quest to bring peace to Maple World with these Maple Alliance events! Players Lv. 61 and up will be able to join the Maple Alliance, and start completing Maple Alliance missions to accumulate Determination. As you and other players gain Determination, the World Gauge will gradually fill up and progress the story, and help to unlock the final battle against the Black Mage!

In addition, every time one of the three goddess statues is completely filled with Determination, a 2x EXP event will activate for 24 hours in all Reboot and non-Reboot worlds! This event will start up to 1 hour after the goddess statue is completed. Go out and gather Determination to help the Maple Alliance!

Here's a taste of what's available this week as part of the Maple Alliance events:

Step Into the Labyrinth of Suffering

Players who are Lv. 200 or higher and have completed the 5th Job advancement can enter the second region of Tenebris: Labyrinth of Suffering. Once you step into the Labyrinth, you'll be separated from your party members and forced to find each other in the Labyrinth's ever-shifting hallways! You'll also be given 3 Spirit Stones upon entering the Labyrinth; you'll lose one Spirit Stone each time you die, and if you lose all 3, you'll be banished from the Labyrinth!

 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/ceca699fd736ff1affd0320748abecb65c02cb3c.png

While inside the Labyrinth, you can help the Maple Alliance by joining the Expedition Mission: Labyrinth of Suffering. Each day you'll be given a selection of 3 different missions, which you can complete for 10,000 Determination each! Missions including hunting down monsters like golems, the Blackheart Negative, and beings from the Dimensional Crack!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e509d070f865408d312318630323754fe6e38aba.png

Complete all three of these each day and you'll also receive the following:

6,000,000 Mesos
Nodestone (x2) (Untradeable)
Rare Treasure Chest. Each account has a daily limit of opening 30 chests per day. Contains one of the following:
Soul Shard: Untradeable.
Clean Slate Scroll 10%
Innocence Scroll 50%
Chaos Scroll 60%
Bonus Potential Scroll 50%
Master Craftsman's Cube: Tradeable within account.
Meister's Cube: Tradeable within account.
Chaos Scroll of Goodness 30%
Epic Potential Scroll 50%
In order to complete the Labyrinth, you must find the Labyrinth Core deep within the maze. You will find an altar there, which you can light with candles by using up your party's remaining Spirit Stones. Only then will you be able to destroy the Labyrinth Core.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4e1e8e21fcd9083c36539f51099ba34965f07b09.png

Once the Labyrinth has been cleared, you'll find Verus Hilla lying in wait at the end!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/85b5c74adeb99f7d2479e85e36b499363693c4ad.png

You can fight Hilla once per day, and defeat her once per week. She'll use her deadly scythe to cut your party down as well as summoning the dead souls of Necro Orchid and Necro Lotus to fight alongside her. But if you can prevail, you'll earn the following reward!

[Medal] One with the Labyrinth: Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +5, MaxHP/MaxMP +1,000. Untradeable.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/8ad5b0f4ff314d6a0b94d1d9af1b3b41f6aeb24c.png

Flame Bird Support

This mission will start alongside the Labyrinth of Suffering Expedition, and will last until the Alliance has made it past the Labyrinth of Suffering.

Summon a fiery foe to help you earn Determination in the Flame Bird Support event! The quest can be started by accepting it through the Alliance notifier on the left-side of the screen, or by speaking to NPC Athena Pierce at the Maple Alliance Outpost. You have to accept the quest "[Alliance Mission] Defense Mission - Flame Bird Support" to learn the skill "Summon the Flame Bird." Then, while out hunting monsters near your level (20 levels above or below), you'll see the option to summon the Flame Bird to help you defeat enemies!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/91d4216033175b0213fb3ccfa4b1d771e051699c.png

Any monsters that you defeat will drop Flame Bird's Determination, which will grant you 30 Determination and increase the Flame Bird's power! As the Flame Bird increases levels, you'll eventually be able to mount it and ride around the map hunting monsters, so power up your winged buddy and get hunting!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/a8a82577aa4709e60cd43f79c5f814068384e7c7.png

Once the daily limit for Determination (50,000) has been reached, Flame Bird can no longer be summoned that day. The daily recap resets every day at midnight (12:00 AM UTC).

Twilight Defense

This mission will start alongside the Labyrinth of Suffering Expedition, and will last until the Alliance has made it past the Labyrinth of Suffering.

Protect the castle walls with your fellow Maple Alliance soldiers in Twilight Defense! The quest can be started by accepting it through the Alliance notifier on the left-side of the screen, or by speaking to NPC Athena Pierce at the Maple Alliance Outpost. You have to accept the quest "[Alliance Mission] Defense Mission - Twilight Defense" to join the event. You can have a party of 2-4 players in this event.

In Twilight Defense, you'll join forces with other players to defeat waves of monsters with cannonballs. As you defeat monsters, you'll earn points and increase your cannon's rank so that it deals more damage to your foes. Once you defeat the final boss, Giant Omen, you'll be rewarded with Determination based on how many points you scored, so prepare your arsenal and hold back the enemy forces!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/69c75471493f45eeeec2e4197ed9971ec6981143.png

Once the daily limit for Determination (50,000) has been reached, you will no longer gain Determination this event; only siege defense points. The maximum number of siege defense points that can be earned in one day is 10,000. The daily recap resets every day at midnight (12:00 AM UTC).

These events are also part of Maple Missions! Join the Maple Alliance and complete Maple Missions to earn extra rewards! More information on Maple Missions here.

Want more gifts? Jump back in MapleStory and complete the "Fairy Bros Daily Gift" 15 times! Then return to the event page to claim your second special code! This code can be redeemed in MapleStory M for another pack of amazing items!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b50345784555a2927fa111b2c0a0ed2f6a1cdce4.png

Bronze Potential Stamp 15%: Grant Potential to an item! Success rate is 15%.
Auto-Battle Charge Ticket (x10): Set Auto-Battle for 30 minutes!
Orange EXP Increase Ticket (x5): Receive a 30% EXP increase for 15 minutes!
Mysterious Armor Whetstone (Epic) (x15): Use to level up a piece of equipment to Epic rank!
How to Redeem
To redeem your codes, download MapleStory M on your Android device. Log in to MapleStory M and go to the "Options" menu. Click "Enter Coupon" and type in your coupon code. The items will appear in your MapleStory M account.

Codes can only be redeemed in MapleStory M on Android devices, and expire on February 22, 2019, so be sure to act quickly! Once codes are redeemed in MapleStory M, items last 7 days in mailbox, and will expire after that time.

notes.title: More Maple Alliance Events!
notes.content:
The war against the Black Mage continues to draw nearer, which means there are more Maple Alliance events available to help Cygnus restore peace to Maple World! If your character is Lv. 61 or higher, join the Maple Alliance and start completing Maple Alliance missions to accumulate Determination. As you and other players gain Determination, the World Gauge will gradually fill up and progress the story, and help to unlock the final battle against the Black Mage!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c668d04bef84b3d1c533b1a95265f6507571e007.png

Increase Your Alliance Rank!

Help the Maple Alliance in their fight against the Black Mage and increase your Alliance Rank along the way! Every time a gem is completed in the Journey of Destiny, you'll unlock a new Alliance Rank, starting at Warrior and going all the way up to Legend (there are a total of 13 ranks). Once you've unlocked a rank, you can activate it by turning in your Alliance Medals to NPC Neinheart. You'll earn Alliance Medals by giving Determination; 100 Determination will grant you 1 Alliance Medal, as well as an extra 10 Alliance Medals each time you transfer 10,000 Determination. These rank-ups will grant you access to new Alliance Skills as well as new items in the Alliance Supply Depot, so get out there and fight to save Maple World! All of these bonuses will remain in place for a period of time after the Black Mage is defeated.

You'll also earn special Empress's Gift rewards with each increase in rank! Empress's Gifts can only be received once per world, can be traded within the world, and have a 10-day duration. The Empress's Gifts are as follows:

Rank: Guardian

Empress's Gift: Guardian I

Fight with Special Alliance Skills!

As you increase your Alliance Rank, you'll earn access to special Alliance Skills! There are three types of Alliance Skills: Content Skills, Stat Skills, and Goddess Statue Skills. Each of these skills are acquired through different means:

Content Skills: Content skills are learned by using skill points earned from Grendel the Really Old.
Stat Skills: Stat skills are automatically learned upon ranking up then speaking to Grendel the Really Old.
Goddess Statue Skills: Goddess Statue skills are automatically learned upon progressing the Goddess statute then talking to Grendel the Really Old.

Alliance Skills can be reset once daily per rank. You can see the whole list of available Alliance Skills here.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/f1de8047bafa73e78eb4835f267981f8eec767da.png

Messenger of Darkness & Living Chains

Defeat Elite Monsters and earn Determination as you face a Messenger of Darkness and Living Chains!

Every 5th, 10th, and 15th Elite Monster that is defeated on a map will spawn a special monster called the Messenger of Darkness! If you defeat the Messenger of Darkness, it will drop 400 Determination!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/da14e968c0782cae9025fd931e85f83713ec4b01.jpg

After the player defeats 11 Elite Monsters, the map will be wrapped up in the Black Mage’s Living Chains! The chains will remain for 10 minutes, and will span a number of different areas around the world map. If you can find and destroy these Living Chains, each one will drop 900 Determination, as well as apply a buff for everyone in the map that grants +50% EXP for 10 minutes. There is a cap of 4,500 Determination per day that can be gained from Living Chains.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/0c75a47dc59fd5897f6c70bafaa738ffb87b2be8.jpg

Moonbridge

At the farthest end of the Arcane River, at the entrance to the region of Tenebris, you will find Moonbridge, a nocturnal passageway shrouded in fog. To access Moonbridge, you must have reached your 5th Job Advancement (Lv. 200+) and have completed the quest "[Black Mage] Outpost Gathering." Once these requirements have been met, you can accept the quest "[Black Mage] Neinheart's Call" to venture into Moonbridge.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/3be8dd7a6a7c845370e2fee02ad2bb93763fa79d.png

The story of Moonbridge will advance as the Journey of Destiny progresses. All areas in Tenebris, including Moonbridge, have a 1-hour time limit, after which hunting does not grant any EXP. In that time, you'll need to complete as many missions and hunt down as many monsters as you can! Tread carefully through Moonbridge, as there are fearsome, tentacle-like monsters that will leap out of the sky to attack you, and occasionally the winds will sweep your party away to do battle with enemies in the air.

At the end of Moonbridge lies the Gloom, whose enormous eye will strike fear into your party, giving you only 5 minutes to defeat it before being banished from the battle! Bring all your courage and might to this battle, and fight on so that you can continue to explore the deepest ends of Tenebris!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b98bdcbb6157711b31a9ca9991ad5e22b9c2597f.jpg

Defense Mission: Captured Soldiers

Save Maple Alliance soldiers in the Captured Soldiers Defense Mission! This mission will start alongside the Tenebris Expedition, and will last until the Alliance has made it past Moonbridge. Characters who are Lv. 61 and up and have completed the quest "[Black Mage] Outpost Gathering!" can partake in this mission by accepting the "[Alliance Mission] Defense Mission - Save the Soldiers" mission from Athena Pierce or through the notifier.

When the Signal Flare item received from Athena Pierce is used, captured soldiers will appear for 10 minutes while you defeat monsters. The soldiers will disappear after this time, so save as many as you can! Rescuing Captured Soldiers will earn you Determination, and will recruit the soldiers to fight alongside you for a short period. Up to 20 soldiers can be saved in each rescue mission.

Protect your fellow soldiers in the fight against the Black Mage!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/998b5eba1b6f4be8745cb286d0d874ea6a031b8b.png

Defense Mission: Help from Above

Take to the sky in the Help from Above Defense Mission! This mission will start alongside the Tenebris Expedition, and will last until the Alliance has made it past Moonbridge. Characters who are Lv. 61 and up and have completed the quest "[Black Mage] Outpost Gathering!" can partake in this mission by accepting the "[Alliance Mission] Defense Mission - Help from Above" mission from Athena Pierce or through the notifier.

Help from Above is an aerial combat mission where 1-4 players can work together to deliver supplies for the Alliance from the ground to a battleship in the air. While in a party, the party leader can talk to the NPC Pilot Irvin to start the mission. Once the mission begins, each player boards a fighter plane according to their flight level, and carries out the operation for 5 minutes. You can carry supplies by colliding into the supply boxes on the ground. While you have supplies, if you make contact with soldier NPCs on the airship, you’ll deliver the supplies and obtain Flying Points. You can receive 1 Determination for every 10 Flying Points after completing the mission by speaking to NPC Pilot Irvin. When the accumulated Flying Points reach a certain amount, your flight level increases, allowing you to ride better fighter planes.

This mission can be entered a total of 5 times every day. You can obtain up to 30,000 Flight Points per one mission, and a maximum of 100,000 Flying Points in one day. Join the Maple Alliance air force to defeat the Black Mage's minions!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/bbf33d1e760619c95544ced649f90f03bd74dfa4.png

notes.title: Recruit Your Friends and Earn Rewards!
notes.content:
Invite your friends to join you in MapleStory, and you’ll both earn special rewards! To get started, visit the Recruit-a-Friend page.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4690667c5f8058ef9585d58e6d784036795bfc8f.jpg

Recruiters
Players Lv. 60 or above are eligible to recruit up to 50 friends! Visit the Recruit-a-Friend page to find your unique recruitment code. Share this special code with your friends by sending them an email, or by posting on Facebook and Twitter. Only new players, or players who haven’t logged in to MapleStory within the past 90 days, are eligible to be recruited. The code can only be used by 50 friends, and will no longer be valid after that.

When your friend uses the code, they will become one of your recruited friends. You can keep track of your friends via your Recruitment List on the Recruit-a-Friend page.

Help your friends level a new character to Lv. 33! The more recruited friends who reach Lv. 33, the more rewards you get! When a goal is met, your Recruiter Pack prize will be waiting for you within 6 hours. Click the gift-box notifier on the left-side of the game window to collect your items (you can choose when to retrieve each item from the pack).

Only one character per account may receive these items, and rewards must be claimed in-game. All Recruiter Packs can be traded within the account.

notes.content:

Please avoid altering your computer time when participating in this event. Any changes to your computer time clock can cause issues when creating or deleting Burning characters for this event

The Tera Burning Project is here to help you level a brand-new character up to Lv. 200!

Create a brand-new character during the event period and select it to have the special "Burning" effect. This event is open to characters in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds, except for Zero characters (Illium, Cadena, and Ark are all eligible for Burning now).

After your character reaches Lv. 10, every time that character levels up it will gain an additional two levels all the way up to Lv. 200 (once your character hits Lv. 199, they will only be leveled up to Lv. 200)! Characters who have been given the Tera Burning effect can also begin 5th Job quests without completing the 5th Job Advancement prerequisite quest! 

Here’s How it Works

Create a brand-new character during the event period. From the character select screen, choose the new character on your account to have the "Burning" effect. Then, accept the quest "It's the Tera Burning Project gift giveaway!" from the star event notifier on the left-side of the game window in order to start receiving rewards! Only one character on your account can have the "Burning" effect.

notes.title: Maple Alliance Events!
notes.content:
The war against the Black Mage has finally begun, so join Cygnus in her quest to bring peace to Maple World with these Maple Alliance events! Players Lv. 61 and up will be able to join the Maple Alliance, and start completing Maple Alliance missions to accumulate Determination. As you and other players gain Determination, the World Gauge will gradually fill up and progress the story, and help to unlock the final battle against the Black Mage!

Here's a taste of what's available this week as part of the Maple Alliance events:

Gathering of Heroes

PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Tuesday, November 27, 2018 3:59 PM
EST (UTC -5): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Tuesday, November 27, 2018 6:59 PM

To participate in the Gathering of Heroes event, accept the "[Black Mage] Destiny Awaits" quest from the Alliance notifier to take part in a special story. You'll then be recruited into the Maple Alliance, and after December 5, 2018 at 4:00 PM PST (7:00 PM EST / 1:00 AM CET December 6 / 11:00 AM AEDT December 6), you'll receive 4 Gathering of Heroes Boxes from the quest "[Black Mage] Gathering of Heroes - Receive Gift." (Players have until December 18, 2018 at 3:59 PM PST / 6:59 PM EST / 12:59 AM CET December 19 / 10:59 AEDT December 19 to claim these rewards). The gifts can only be claimed once per account, and can be traded between characters in the same world. Each box contains several guaranteed rewards and a bunch of other prizes you have a random chance to get. The boxes contain the following:

Determination Gauge

Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Until Black Mage is defeated.

Complete Maple Alliance missions to accrue Determination and help progress the story of the battle against Black Mage! Once you've gathered some Determination, visit the Spark of Determination in the Maple Alliance Outpost, and offer your Determination to the Goddess Statues. By doing so, you'll increase your Alliance Rank and add to the World Gauge, which is shared across all worlds in MapleStory. You'll also receive Alliance Medals after giving Determination! (100 Determination will grant you 1 Alliance Medal). 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/f863017a752ce5079a3e85a78e379ce28492f9c6.png

Defense Mission: Scattered Determination

PST (UTC -8): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Tuesday, November 27, 2018 3:59 PM
EST (UTC -5): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Tuesday, November 27, 2018 6:59 PM
CET (UTC +1): Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Wednesday, November 28, 2018 12:59 AM
AEDT (UTC +11): Thursday, November 15, 2018 (after maintenance) - Wednesday, November 28, 2018 10:59 AM

Earn special rewards in the Scattered Determination mission! To participate, accept the "[Alliance Mission] Defense Mission-Scattered Determination" mission via the Alliance notifier or NPC Athena Pierce in the Maple Alliance Outpost. You'll be granted a Determination Ember, which you can then use to spawn monsters near your level (20 levels below or above your current level) while out in the field. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/d7535991acacbfe6e3cb4cfbb8383b39eb4b06b4.png

Once you've placed the Determination Ember, you'll be able to collect and transfer Determination a total of 10 times within the given time limit. Defeat monsters to obtain Determination Fragments, including Brave Determination Fragments, Peaceful Determination Fragments, and Hopeful Determination Fragments! You'll need a certain number of fragments for each level, at which point they can be converted into whole Determination when you return to the Spark of Determination. Collect as many fragments as you can and give them to the Spark of Determination to help in the battle against the Battle Mage!

Alliance Support

Wednesday, November 14, 2018 (after maintenance) - Until Black Mage is defeated.

Once you have a character who's joined the Maple Alliance, they'll have the chance to call in backup support while out hunting monsters! Once this character defeats an Elite Monster, they can randomly receive Alliance Support in the form of allied troops, cannons, and airships that will rush into battle to assist you! This effect will last for 30 seconds, and will only apply to normal monsters (Alliance Support cannot be used on either Elite or Boss monsters). You can receive support from the following allies:

Troops: Maple Alliance soldiers that will fight alongside you in battle!
Bombardment: An air attack that will drop explosions on your enemies!
Airship: A Maple Alliance soldier piloting a deadly airship!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/1a06e323046d466138d6f758cc95063e16ac9d77.png

Defeating Elite Monsters will also grant your character 100 Determination, so go out and fight for glory with the Maple Alliance by your side!

notes.content:
PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, October 23, 2018 5:00 PM - Tuesday, November 6, 2018 3:59 PM (PST)

Become a social media celebrity on MapleStory in our brand new #Maple Hashtag event! Starting October 24 (UTC), players Lv. 33 and above can participate by accepting the "[Hashtag] Maple Hashtag!" quest from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen, then visiting NPC Cassandra to receive a Hashtag Chair and a Hashtag Phone!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e9b3625a3391221b0dc985cd99bf3379cb062480.png

Once you have your Hashtag Chair, you can upgrade it and change its look by collecting Hashtag Points.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e80529f0c58f8d0dcecf2461b4811d50bdd9e281.png

You can gain Hashtag Points by hunting monsters within your level range (20 levels above or below your current level). As you gain Hashtag Points, you'll automatically upgrade your Hashtag Chair's expression, pose, background, and Hashtag. You can earn up to 100 Hashtag Points per day, upon which you'll complete the daily quest "[Hashtag] Daily Hashtag Point," and receive a reward of Spell Trace (x100)!

There are a variety of options for how to customize your Hashtag Chair, including different expressions, poses, backgrounds, and emoticons. You can decorate your Hashtag Chair with up to 14 total items, including up to 7 of the many available hashtags (each hashtag can only be used once) as well as any combination of emoticons. If you visit certain map locations, you can gain additional backgrounds for your Hashtag Chair by snapping a picture using the Hashtag Phone. You can view the full list of customization options here.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c78b79a3f9cdc138f6cabbeefd38348445f8aba5.png

You'll have a number of different Hashtags to choose from based on several different factors including your medal achievements, your job class, what world you're in, and more. See below for the factors that will affect which Hashtags are available to you:

World hashtags vary based on the world your character is in.
Job hashtags vary based on your character's job (such as Wind Archer, Blaster, Evan, etc).
Job category hashtags vary based on your character's main job category (such as Warrior, Magician, Bowman, Thief, Pirate).
Faction category hashtags vary based on your character's job faction (such as Explorer, Resistance, Hero, etc).
Lv. 200 hashtags vary based on certain 5th job skills. You can only receive one of these hashtags.
Legion hashtags vary based on your Legion level.
Achievement hashtags vary based on the Maple Achievements you complete.
Title and medal achievements vary based on which of these items you receive.
Hard Boss achievements vary based on which bosses you defeat on Hard Mode.
There are also special hidden hashtags for you to discover based on actions you do in-game!
In addition, you'll also gain the following rewards as you level up your chair:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/5bcf666e7557b995e91c6de653a6b185e2559e69.png

Chair Level 1 Reward - 2x Drop Coupon (60 min) (x2): 7-day duration, Untradeable.
Chair Level 2 Reward - 2x EXP Coupon (30 min) (x2): 7-day duration, Untradeable.
Chair Level 3 Reward - Master Craftsman's Cube: 7-day duration, tradeable within account.
Chair Level 4 Reward - Meister's Cube: 7-day duration, tradeable within account.
If you reach Chair Level 4, you'll receive a quest called "[Hashtag] Gift for a Hashtag Master" that will remove the daily limit on Hashtag Points, and grant you a permanent Hashtag Master Chair! (If you don't upgrade your chair to level 4 by the end of the event, your Hashtag Chair will disappear).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/5342510058179629980beda4a2b6e31da1ed5cf6.png

The possibilities for customizing your Hashtag Chair are endless, so get out there and start spreading the #MapleStory love!

This event is also part of Maple Missions! Participate in #Maple Hashtag and complete Maple Missions to earn extra rewards! More information on Maple Missions here.

The door between the world of the living and the dead has opened, unleashing a horde of ghosts and ghouls upon Maple World! Hunt them down to restore peace to Maple World (and earn spooky rewards along the way) in our Ghoulbusters event!

To start hunting ghouls, players over Lv. 33 must first accept the "[Halloween] Ghoulbusters" quest from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. Then, you'll start to encounter ghouls while you're out hunting monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above)!

There are three different types of ghouls, each of which gives out a different reward once you defeat 10 of them: 

Frankenbalrogs give out EXP based on your level. The 10th and 20th gifts grant extra EXP!
Pumpkin Zombies give out mesos in amounts of 100 million, 500 million, and 1 billion mesos!
Halloween Pumpkins give out 3 Ghost Coins! The 10th gift gives out 15 Ghost Coins, and the 20th gift gives out 30 Ghost Coins!

notes.title: Get Tickets for ZICO Concerts!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/a1d8713100154d6c2dedf0e09a455487c46fde22.jpg

MapleStory is heading toward its biggest update ever, as Maple World prepares for battle against the sinister Black Mage!

The excitement starts now as MapleStory partners with ZICO’s “King of the Zungle” tour in the USA. The K-pop superstar is currently on his first solo world tour and MapleStory has tickets!

For a chance to join ZICO in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Chicago, or New York, play MapleStory and complete a survey. We have up to 50 free tickets to give away to each location, including VVIP tickets that include a HiTouch event where you can meet and high-five ZICO before the concert! 

In order to be selected, you need to start a new character in MapleStory, reach level 60, and fill out the entry form!
You must reach Lv. 60 or above on a new character created after October 11 at 11:00 AM (PDT) but before October 16 at 11:59 PM (PDT) to be eligible for free tickets.
You must fill out the entry form by October 16 at 11:59 PM (PDT) to be eligible to receive tickets for each city. We will review the applications and select each winner based on his or her in-game level and responses.
Winners will be contacted via email and announced on the website on October 17. Make sure that you have not “opted out” of MapleStory emails. You can check your email settings by logging in to your account on the website and clicking “Your Account” > “Account Settings”. Leveling up in MapleStory is quick and fun. You can reach Lv. 60 within a few hours, so get started today!

Click here to learn more and enter to win!


*Offer valid for domestic US MapleStory players whose accounts are in good standing. The Nexon email account address entered to register and win must, in addition to other rules as set forth in the links below, create a new character after October 11, 2018 at 11:00 AM PDT and the new character must reach the designated minimum level (60) in MapleStory by the end of the event period to be eligible. The account must have been active and logged in at least once during the entire period of the contest to be eligible. Accounts may register for the promotion at any time. The contest closes on October 16, 2018 at 11:59 PM PDT. Nexon America Inc.’s computers will be the official time-keeping devices. All dates and times are in Pacific Time. Winners will be contacted via email directly after the promotion closes and will need to confirm receipt of the email awarding their prize tickets within 48 hours of receipt by the winner’s email account. Winners are responsible for transportation to and from the event venue. Click here for Los Angeles Contest Rules. Click here San Francisco Contest Rules. Click here for Chicago Contest Rules. Exploring Maple World is a blast when you have an adorable puppy pal by your side! In the Infinite Pawsibilities event, you can complete special missions to receive decorations for your Custom Puppy, and earn rewards along the way! Players Lv. 33 and above can begin by selecting the Infinite Pawsibilities notifier from the left side of the screen and accepting the quest ‘[Event] Explore the Infinite Pawsibilities’.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/d88633dfdc130d056e65113a20a3a5a67837d755.png

Custom Puppy

Everyone will receive a Summon Custom Puppy item which can be used to summon your Custom Puppy to appear by your side. Originally, your puppy has a very basic look. As you complete missions, you’ll be able to use the UI to build up the Courage, Curiosity, and Stamina of your Custom Puppy. This unlocks new options to decorate your Custom Puppy, allowing you to change the face style, fur pattern, and accessories to create a puppy that’s unique.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4b820a167b3f19e58cdec9fdedef89d9defd58ea.png

Daily Missions

Complete daily missions that focus on one element of your gameplay. Build up your Courage by hunting down specific bosses including Zakum, Horntail, Magnus, and more. Work on your Curiosity by completing areas such as Monster Park or Nett’s Pyramid. Steel up your Stamina by hunting monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above).

When you complete a mission, you receive a reward box!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/fd9f1ba402a80ab5797dd4e76fd44059f3bd62f1.png

Courageous Balance Box: Untradeable. Must be opened by 11:59 PM UTC on the day it’s received. Open the box to receive:
100 Reward Points: Untradeable, 1-day duration
Mysterious Meso Pouch: Untradeable, 1-day duration
Curious Balance Box: Untradeable. Must be opened by 11:59 PM UTC on the day it’s received. Open the box to receive:
Pollo and Fritto Entry Ticket: Untradeable, 1-day duration
Monster Park REBORN Coupon: Tradeable within account on same world, 1-day duration
Enduring Balance Box: Untradeable. Must be opened by 11:59 PM UTC on the day it’s received. Open the box to receive:
2x EXP Coupon (x2) (15 minutes): Untradeable, 1-day duration
2x Drop Coupon (x2) (15 minutes): Untradeable, 1-day duration
When you complete a mission, in addition to the rewards above, you also gain a new decoration for your Custom Puppy. Open the UI by accepting the quest ‘[Event] Caring for Your Custom Puppy’ from the Infinite Pawsibilities event notifier on the left side of the screen.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b6caaef1517bd3cc907e44dc1d6a3d6f88e27746.png

Rewards

Complete 15 days of daily missions, and your balance boxes will contain special rewards!

Custom Puppy Medal: Untradeable. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5, MaxHP/MaxMP +500.
Custom Puppy Damage Skin: Untradeable, 7-day duration.

Groovy Smoothie

While you’re working on your abilities, you may as well enjoy a healthy smoothie too. Accept the quest ‘[Event] Drink Groovy Smoothie’ and hold onto the Groovy Smoothie item for 30 minutes. When you complete the quest, you can receive another balance box. This can be completed one per day per world.

notes.title: This Winter, the Black Mage Approaches
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/42d1c188abf6d2f4e34f46617b8dec6416cae086.jpg

Get ready for MapleStory’s biggest update ever as Maple World prepares for battle against the sinister Black Mage! The excitement starts with pre-events in the upcoming October update. The Black Mage updates begin in earnest in November, with the ultimate battle coming by the end of the year!

Here’s the release schedule:
November - Black Mage: Gathering of Heroes
November - Black Mage: Prelude to War
December - Black Mage: Labyrinth
December - Black Mage: Final Battle
Click here to visit the website and join the fight. The Maple Alliance needs you!

EARN REWARDS WITH PRE-EVENTS

Over the coming months, we’ll feature several events on the website to help you prepare, so make sure to check back regularly!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/13555bab2b7bd67130772c4ee92fd587ba662b20.png

JOIN THE MAPLE ALLIANCE

Starting in November, you can help the Maple Alliance prepare for war with all-new missions! Rise through the ranks and earn rewards and special skills.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/5591f029e0db51641710819a268faaa5cd2ce4ce.png

LEVEL UP FASTER

Make sure you’re ready for the end-game! The Tera Burning event starting in November will let your character reach Lv. 200 three times faster. Content for players Lv. 200 and under will become easier and faster to complete, and the EXP curve will be lowered between Lv. 200 and 220.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/b3c7bde56dec7539f3f7d3bc70979e5cc58ac284.png

NEW 5TH JOB SKILLS

Up your skill game in December with the addition of new 5th job skills for all character job categories (Warrior, Magician, Bowman, Thief, Pirate)! In addition, you will now receive all 5th Job skills as soon as you complete the job advancement.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/f7a92d5adf555981bffe09b38387d41a386eb327.png

ARCANE RIVER EXPANDS

Starting in November, you can explore the final region of Arcane River, Tenebris. This region is broken into different areas including foggy Moonbridge, the endless Labyrinth of Suffering, and the end of the river, Limina.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/d162fa5b66661732595db83cea5efec8f89e836f.png

FIGHT AGAINST VERUS HILLA

Deep within the Labyrinth of Suffering, you will confront Verus Hilla, reborn with the powers of the Black Mage! Available in December, you must face the fury of Hilla like never before.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/8282de13ad6d9d6d97a9d7f7d42ffc41877d1789.png

WAR AGAINST THE BLACK MAGE

Finally, in December, the time will come to go to war against the Black Mage! Prepare for Maple World’s ultimate battle!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/f1aaadde2c716380dabdbdd0dd443dff900ba030.png

Learn more here: http://maplestory.nexon.net/micro-site/blackmage

notes.title: Join the Bug Brawl!
notes.content:
PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, September 18, 2018 5:00 PM – Wednesday, October 3, 2018 4:59 PM

CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, September 19, 2018 2:00 AM - Thursday, October 4, 2018 at 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, September 19, 2018 10:00 AM - Thursday, October 4, 2018 at 9:59 AM

Do you have what it takes to raise the biggest and baddest bug around? Prepare for Bug Brawl, where insects prove their worth in a bug-eat-bug world!

Players Lv. 33 and up can participate by accepting the quest '[Bug Brawl] Here's Your Bug' from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen, or speaking to NPC Doctor Ong to receive a starter companion bug. Once you've received the bug, you can click on its Photo Album to view its feeding and care requirements, base power, current level, and what it can evolve into. During the event, monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above) have a chance to drop different bugs. Some of these smaller insects make for great bug feed, and if you collect them, your companion bug will grow stronger and grant you bonus EXP! But be warned - monsters may also drop bigger bugs that are natural enemies to your companion, and if you or a pet picks up an insect that is the same evolution or higher than your bug, it will lose EXP. Double-check to make sure you don't have a pet automatically picking up dangerous loot!

You can also summon your companion bug by double-clicking it to receive a small stat boost. Look out for the Praying Mantis, as only the strongest bugs will be able to defeat it!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/0e39f321f2399e4401506cdd241d4d134272f096.jpg

Once your companion bug reaches a certain level, you can evolve it into a more powerful bug! To evolve your companion bug, first open the Photo Album that you obtained when you received your bug. Inside the Photo Album, you’ll be able to select which bug you’d like to evolve your companion bug into. There are multiple evolutionary paths you can take, each granting their own rewards. If you’d like to reset your bug to an Ant, accept the quest '[Bug Brawl] Debugging' and Doctor Ong will then replace your current bug with an Ant.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/9a4edba63ca9f137cb05deecb2089f699cb6542b.png

Each bug gives the following stat boosts:

Ladybug: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +1
Ant: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +2

Dragonfly: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +4

Stag Beetle: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +8
Fire Ant: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +4
Army Ant: Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +5
Bullet Ant: Grant Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +6

If you level up your bug all the way to the powerful Titan Beetle or Hercules Beetle level, you'll earn exclusive rewards!

Bug Master: Title. Obtained when completing '[Bug Brawl] King of the Bugs'. Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +30, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +60, MaxHP/MaxMP +3000, Boss Damage +30%, Ignore Defense +30%. Stats have 14-day duration.
Baddest Bug: Medal. Obtained when completing '[Bug Brawl] Baddest Bug'. Grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10, STR/DEX/INT/LUK +10, MaxHP/MaxMP +450, Boss Damage +10%, Ignore Defense +10%. Stats have 14-day duration. Note: Does not register in Medal Collection.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c9ed2413d0523c20310ab867cd697886ec924aa2.png

Turn your little insect pal into a vicious predator, and earn great rewards and stat boosts along the way! The Bug Brawl has begun!

Oda Nobunaga has taken over Sengoku High. Test your wits and skills as you battle against Oda Nobunaga’s elite students and prove yourself worthy. Step into this premium mini-dungeon and complete quests to earn Oda Coins. With Oda Coins, you can purchase totems and pocket items—equipable stat items that boost a variety of stats. There are also other items available, including restorative items, outfits, medals, and more! Sharpen those pencils! The classroom just got dangerous.

How to Play

Requirement: Your character must be Lv. 33 or above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2). The dungeon is solo only.
NPC Boss Kumi will be in the Event Hall. Talk to her to enter the school.
You can venture deeper into the school for free once per day by completing the daily quest "Red Leaf High: The Sengoku'ing." More entries require a special pass available in the Cash Shop or Maple Rewards Shop. Each pass will be consumed after one use.

notes.title: Divine Intelligence Event
notes.content:
PDT (UTC -7): Tuesday, September 11, 2018 5:00 PM – Wednesday, October 3, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Tuesday, September 11, 2018 8:00 PM – Wednesday, October 3, 2018 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, September 12, 2018 2:00 AM – Thursday, October 4, 2018 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, September 12, 2018 10:00 AM – Thursday, October 4, 2018 9:59 AM

Show off your mind with the Divine Intelligence event! Players Lv. 33 and above can begin by accepting the quest 'Divine Intelligence Research Lab Open' from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen. An invitation will appear above your character’s head at the 15 and 45-minute mark of every hour. You will be moved to the event map along with up to 49 other players.

This mini-game tests you on identifying Maple monsters and rewards you with points depending on how many you answer correctly. We've added new monsters and questions to the quiz, so you'll have to sharpen your knowledge to get all 10 questions right! To answer, you must quickly move to the area of the map displaying either “A” or “B”. You earn points when you answer questions correctly.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4387191174f04ed3071b660a08a80b24871d33db.jpg

Each game consists of 10 stages and 1 random question is displayed for each stage. Throughout the quiz, the conditions for answering the question will change based on the NPC asking the question. The conditions are as follows:

Gym Cat: No special conditions.
Ursie: The answers will flip which side they're on.
Flicker: You'll have less time to choose an answer.
Iron Rabbit: The image is obscured, making it harder to tell which monster it is.
If you are disqualified, you can still participate by voting for your favorite player remaining in the game. If your favorite player is still standing when the stage ends, you will receive a percentage of the points. The favorite player also receives extra points based on how many players vote for them. You can participate in the event up to 5 times per day.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/395aae2eb02441dd044d8395ad07c73feebb51fd.jpg

Collect those points and then exchange them for nice rewards! Check out some of the awesome new rewards we have available for this event:

Smarty Pants Assessment Capsule
Data Collection Goggles Coupon (Grants permanent item)
Gym Cat Mask Coupon (Grants permanent item)
Ursie Mask Coupon (Grants permanent item)
Iron Rabbit Mask Coupon (Grants permanent item)


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/75643a79c4f4700eac4a8da1f5c3014e4f4fc7f5.png

There are plenty of other items you can win as well! Rewards include:

Smarty Pants Assessment Chair
Ramblings of a Genius Coupon: Gives Ramblings of a Genius effect that can be toggled on/off via a hotkey.
Gym Cat's Gift Buff Coupon: Gives a buff that grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +30 for 30 minutes. Can be purchased once per day.
Ursie's Gift Buff Coupon: Gives a buff that grants EXP +50% for 30 minutes. Can be purchased once per day.
Iron Rabbit's Gift Buff Coupon: Gives a buff that grants Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +50 for 30 minutes. Can be purchased once per day.
Flicker's Gift Buff Coupon: Gives a buff that grants EXP +100% for 30 minutes. Can be purchased once per day.
Epic Potential Scroll 50% Coupon: Gives Epic Potential Scroll 50% (x5). 7-day duration. Coupon is usable until October 9 at 11:59 PM (UTC).
Master Craftsman's Cube: Tradeable within account, 7-day duration. Can be purchased once per day.
Meister's Cube: Tradeable within account, 7-day duration. Can be purchased once per day.
Spell Trace (x5,000)
Divine Intelligence Researcher: Medal. 30-day duration stats. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +3, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +3. Participate in the event 6 times to receive the title.
Divine Intelligence Lead Researcher: Medal. 30-day duration stats. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +7. Participate in the event 15 times to receive the title.
Divine Intelligence Chief Researcher: Medal. 30-day duration stats. STR/DEX/INT/LUK +10, Weapon ATT/Magic ATT +10. Participate in the event 18 times to receive the title.

In addition to items, you can also trade your points for mesos at a 1:100 ratio for a maximum of 5,000,000 mesos per day.

This event is also part of Maple Missions! Participate in Divine Intelligence and complete Maple Missions to earn extra rewards! More information on Maple Missions here.

notes.content:
PDT (UTC -7): Sunday, September 2, 2018 5:00 PM – Sunday, September 9, 2018 4:59 PM

AEST (UTC +10): Monday, September 3, 2018 10:00 AM – Monday, September 10, 2018 9:59 AM

MapleStory will be having a whole week of Hot Days! All you have to do is log in to start receiving great items!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/de3b442e3e2fee914fde718ca6ee624ae2789874.png

Log in each day with a character Lv. 30 or above, and click the gift box icon on the left side of the screen to receive a Gift Box, and then double-click the box in your inventory to open it. The Gift Box can be obtained once in a 24-hour period every day, resetting at 5:00 PM PDT / 8:00 PM EDT / 2:00 AM CEST / 10:00 AM AEST.

Once you receive the gift box, you can open it anytime before 2:00 AM PDT / 5:00 AM EDT / 11:00 AM CEST / 7:00 PM AEST of the following day.

If you have more than 30 unclaimed gifts, you may not be able to see the Hot Week reward. Please clear any unclaimed gifts and login again to see the Hot Week reward.

All rewards are for both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds unless specifically noted below.

Monday, September 3
Pendant of the Spirit: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
Tuesday, September 4
Special Medal of Honor (x3): Untradeable.
Wednesday, September 5
Hyper Teleport Rock Coupon: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
Thursday, September 6
Mysterious Meso Pouch
Friday, September 7
2x EXP Coupon (30 min) (x3): Untradeable, 7-day duration.
Saturday, September 8
Nodestone: Untradeable.
Sunday, September 9
2,000 Maple Reward Points: Untradeable, 7-day duration.
Plus select one additional reward from the items given Monday through Saturday!
If you obtain and open each Gift Box every day from Monday to Saturday, then on Sunday—in addition to Sunday's reward—you can have another gift! You can select one from all of the items that were given out from Monday to Saturday. You are not required to have received each day’s Gift Box on the same character in order to be eligible for the extra gift, but it does have to be with characters in the same world (multiple worlds in World Alliances don't count).

This event is available to players Lv. 30 and above (Zero characters must have completed up to Chapter 2). You can receive one gift box per account per day.

notes.title: MapleStory X Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card Events
notes.content:
PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, August 29, 2018 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, September 25, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Wednesday, August 29, 2018 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, September 25, 2018 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, August 29, 2018 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, September 26, 2018 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Thursday, August 30, 2018 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, September 26, 2018 9:59 AM

Characters from Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card are coming to Maple World in this limited-time crossover event! Spend time with Sakura Kinomoto and her friends as you take part in fun events.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c2507abac22866b1c8efa7acadb75f82e4c87d1a.jpg

Maple Monsters
Sakura Kinomoto and her friends Kero-chan, Tomoyo Daidouji, and Syaoran Li are visiting Maple World, but are worried that it’s full of scary monsters! Many monsters are actually cute, and Sakura might enjoy meeting them. Players Lv. 33 and above can begin by accepting the quest ‘[Cardcaptor Sakura] Maple World's 'Cutest' Monsters’ from the event notifier on the left side of the screen.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/ab2bee02ba9559dca7fca93faea5011fb1b68178.jpg

Follow Sakura’s hints to find some nice monsters. Weaken a monster to lower its HP, and then use a Capture Card to try to collect it and bring it back to show Sakura. You can complete this event once per character.

Each time you return a captured monster, you’ll receive the buff Sakura-chan's Support, which grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7 for 30 minutes. Bring her the last captured monster to receive a special title:

Sakura-chan's Friend: Title. Untradeable. Grants INT +10.

Complete the quest to receive another title from Sakura:

MapleStory X Cardcaptor Sakura: Title. Untradeable. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +8, MaxHP/MaxMP +50.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/44b49abd3db1ae3d8497f7b6d4f6d5c0056eb33f.jpg

Hungry Kero-chan
Kero-chan has heard that Maple World is filled with delicious food, and is anxious to try some! Players Lv. 33 and above can begin by accepting the quest ‘[Cardcaptor Sakura] Maple World Delicacies’ from the event notifier on the left side of the screen.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/737a1495f9cc8e85f739daa316eec55d1e1ad269.jpg

Kero-chan has an idea of some of the foods he wants to try! Collect the treats from monsters within your level range (20 levels below and 20 levels above), or by visiting NPC shops, and give them to Kero-chan. You can complete this quest 5 times per day.

You’ll be rewarded with Kero-chan’s Reward Box, which gives you one random item when opened:

Trait items
Kero-chan's Support: Buff. 7-day duration. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7 for 30 minutes
Kero-chan's Friend: Title. Untradeable. Grants STR +10.
Konyanyachiwa: Title. Untradeable. Grants MaxHP/MaxMP +100.
Dozing Together Chair
Desserts with Kero-chan Chair

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/8098eb36b0b7393f46463875e2dad3765d62d121.jpg

Commemorative Photograph
Tomoyo wants to take a special photo with Sakura and her friends to remember their fun time in Maple World! Tomoyo has an idea for a spot to use as a backdrop. Players Lv. 33 and above can begin by accepting the quest ‘[Cardcaptor Sakura] Places in Maple World’ from the event notifier on the left side of the screen.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/5322c09555a2a8c82fbb0dc6d260c54634415f98.jpg

Follow Tomoyo’s hints using a Walkie-Talkie to find each map. Double-click Tomoyo’s Video Camera to capture an image of each map. You can complete this event once per character.

Bring the images back to Tomoyo, and she’ll give you various rewards:

Tomoyo-chan's Support: Buff. 7-day duration. Grants STR/DEX/INT/LUK +7 for 30 minutes
Tomoyo-chan's Friend: Title. Untradeable. Grants DEX +10.
Sakura's Hair Ornament

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/3a77dbd6151819247b1bcda334c5ad3dc1c080fd.jpg

Time to Return
Vacations are fun, but Syaoran is already thinking about how to head home. He was ambushed by monsters and dropped his cards! Now he needs your help. Players Lv. 33 and above can begin by accepting the quest ‘[Cardcaptor Sakura] Finding the Lost’ from the event notifier on the left side of the screen.

notes.title: v.198 – MapleStory X Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card Update Preview
notes.content:
Characters from Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card are coming to MapleStory in this limited-time crossover event! We’re also preparing some game improvements and bug fixes, and adding several fun events! Show off your mind with the return of the Divine Intelligence event, and grow a bigger bug with the Bug Brawl event. All this and more is coming your way in MapleStory X Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card!

MAPLESTORY X CARDCAPTOR SAKURA: CLEAR CARD
Enjoy themed events from Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card and collect some fun rewards! Sakura Kinomoto and her friends Kero-chan, Tomoyo Daidouji, and Syaoran Li are visiting Maple World. Capture monsters to show them that Maple World’s monsters are cute! Bring Kero-chan some delicious food, take a commemorative photograph for Tomoyo, and help Syaoran find a way home. Complete the quests to receive buffs, titles, and special chairs! Special Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card themed items will also be available in the Cash Shop! Purchase a special surprise style box and get equips to look like Sakura, Syaoran, or Kero-chan, as well as fun hats and capes! Look for chairs, a Cerberus mount, and more inside the special random box. You can also update your character’s look with new hairstyles designed to look just like one of the characters from Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card!

Make sure to visit the website to register for a free gift pack when the update goes live!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/350a4d7e541f73a038a5ce24c06db1ff9b0ec79e.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c2507abac22866b1c8efa7acadb75f82e4c87d1a.jpg

ⓒCLAMP, ST/KODANSHA, NEP, NHK

DIVINE INTELLIGENCE
Show off your mind with the return of the Divine Intelligence event! This mini-game will test you on Maple knowledge and reward you with points depending on how much you know. The event will be updated with new questions, and you must quickly move to the area with the correct answer to stay in the game. Make your way through all 10 stages and earn points to redeem on new rewards including masks and a fancy chair! If you’re knocked out of the game, it’s ok because you can still vote for your favorite contestant still standing, and earn a fraction of their points.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/4387191174f04ed3071b660a08a80b24871d33db.jpg

BUG BRAWL
Embrace your inner entomologist in this new event! Maple World is crawling with critters, and it’s up to you to catch and grow the most powerful bugs you can. Everyone will start with one beginner bug. Study its feeding and growth requirements, then hunt monsters within your level range to collect more bugs! Monsters will drop smaller bugs that can be used as food, but also larger bugs that can weaken your own special creature. When it’s ready, you will be able to transform your critter into a larger, more powerful insect. Advance through the evolutionary chain until you have created the ultimate bug! You’ll gain stat buffs depending on what bug you have, as well as earn EXP from consuming smaller bugs.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/1553aa78c8f5731d78f682884f24f9f8fd4205aa.jpg

MORE EVENTS
In Tomorrow's Another Day, you will receive a special gift box with a catch—the gift box can’t be opened until the following day. You have the option to open the gift box and accept its rewards now, or upgrade the box to a better one! The items from each box only last 48 hours, so you need to keep coming back to claim more gift boxes! The items inside get better as you upgrade to fancier gift boxes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/c6d10a485d8cb5f52fd6d6e71a426a80c3f9fc03.jpg

That’s not all—Sengoku High is returning to Maple World! Step into this premium mini-dungeon and test your wits and skills as you battle against Oda Nobunaga’s elite students. Prepare to take down Mori Ranmaru, as you fight your way through all the classes. Earn Oda Coins to exchange for totems, medals, equips, and more!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/5cf5c57c7b84d855d0e7cf7a18c5c79e98e216d0.jpg

notes.title: Cash Inventory Transfer Event
notes.content:
Thursday, August 16 to Wednesday, August 29

This event will begin after the maintenance on August 16.
This event will end after the maintenance on August 29.
Do you have a cash item you’ve wanted to move to another character on your account? Now you can!

For a limited time, you will be able to transfer most cash items between your characters within the same world. Take this opportunity to share a Hyper Teleport Rock, move cash cover items between characters, move a beloved pet to a new character, and more!

This event is available in both Reboot and non-Reboot worlds. You can only transfer cash items between characters in the same world. This does not include different worlds in the same world alliance. For example, you can transfer items between two characters on Mardia, but you cannot transfer an item from a character on Mardia to a character on Kradia.

Trading cash items between your characters is easy! All you need to do is follow these simple steps:

1. Enter the Cash Shop.
2. Pick an eligible item you would like to transfer to a different character, and move it into your Cash Inventory.
3. Right-click the item.
4. Click the ‘TRANSFER’ button.
5. Select the recipient of the item from the drop down.
6. Click the ‘OK’ button.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/3c0b5a311ef300da61c0d3336329fecde77229a3.png

The selected item will now appear in the other character’s Cash Inventory the next time you login to that character. All jobs are able to transfer cash items between each other, except Explorers since they already share their Cash Inventory.

There are a few items that are not able to be transferred:

EXP Coupons
Potion Pot
Friendship and Couple items

Log in each day with a character Lv. 30 or above, and click the gift box icon on the left side of the screen to receive a Gift Box, and then double-click the box in your inventory to open it. notes.title: Lab Server, Here for a Limited Time!
notes.content:
PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, August 8, 2018 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, August 28, 2018 4:59 PM
EDT (UTC -4): Wednesday, August 8, 2018 (after maintenance) – Tuesday, August 28, 2018 7:59 PM
CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, August 8, 2018 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, August 29, 2018 1:59 AM
AEST (UTC +10): Thursday, August 9, 2018 (after maintenance) – Wednesday, August 29, 2018 9:59 AM

For a limited-time, you can play in Lab world where you can experience different concepts and try out new systems! This is a hardcore game style where your character's level and stats reset after death.

To begin, select “Lab” as your world and create a character! You can create one (only one!) Explorer-class character, who will begin at Lv. 10 in Henesys. Speak with Job Instructor Dr. Bebe to choose your first job. Note that no medal is given upon job advancement. Advancing is reward enough!

As you explore Lab world, you will run into powerful monsters. All monsters have twice as much HP and their stats are five times stronger than on regular worlds.

If your character dies, they revert to a Lv. 10 Beginner, and Ability Points, Skill Points, Hit Points, and Mana Points will be reset. The character will respawn back in Henesys. Dying isn’t all bad though, as you will have a chance to receive a special skill!

Please Stop Dying: Skill. Master Level 100. Monster Weapon DEF ignored when attacking (2+ skill level %), and Weapon ATT/Magic ATT increased (20 x skill level). This skill can be learned twice a day.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/76e13330ef328b02e053ee69a87bf3d497d00534.jpg

Potions have a 10-second cooldown applied to them, so you can’t escape death by spamming your potion button! However, the Enhancement Scroll count for all items is set high, at 255, so you’ll be able to enhance your items to their very best.

To help with all of this hunting and dying, we will also be running a 2x EXP & Drop event on Lab world for the entire duration! Power through your level-ups!

Note that gift boxes obtained on the Lab server will be deleted after the Lab server is closed, so think carefully about which items you want to claim! The Lab server selection button may also not appear upon first login. If this happens, select a NA server and go to the character select screen, then go back to the server menu. The button for Lab server should appear.

Quests and Missions

Complete some basic quests to gain easy rewards, including Lab Server Coins which can be redeemed for useful items from the coin shop. Some rewards will not be granted until after the Lab server ends. You can also send rewards earned in the Lab server to characters in other worlds; select which world you’d like the rewards to be sent to by accessing the quest ‘[Lab Server] Please select a server to receive your reward.’

Level-Up Rewards

As you level up, you'll receive a quest that will grant you a reward for hitting each milestone:

notes.content:
MapleStory is officially going mobile this week, and to celebrate we’re giving out special rewards to players who link up their PC accounts with MapleStory M! Take your character on the go and earn exclusive gifts for your PC account by participating in these daily mobile missions and events. These daily missions will run every day until we give further notice, so get out there and start racking up rewards!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/bf8495343d490fee9e7f96def8f232b7c83caebe.png

How to Link Your Account

Players who are Lv. 150 or above in MapleStory can link their account to MapleStory M by inputting a special UserKey. Here's how to obtain your UserKey:

Go to the Event Hall and speak to the Maple Administrator.
Select "Talk to a Maple Admin."
In your conversation, select "Check Maple M Link String" and she will provide the UserKey. 
The issued UserKey from MapleStory must match with the MapleStory M account exactly in order to be used.
Even if a player has several Nexon account IDs, the rewards will only be given once to the account that registered the UserKey.
Rewards can't be received while MapleStory is undergoing maintenance.

Once you've inputted your UserKey into MapleStory M, you will start receiving Daily Missions. When you complete a Daily Mission, you will receive Reward Points in the original MapleStory. Each reward can be earned once per day, and once per MapleStory account, with the timer resetting at 5:00 PM PDT / 8:00 PM EDT / 2:00 AM CEST / 10:00 AM AEST (the mobile version will display how much time players have to earn a daily reward).

Discovery Arena

The time has come to show off your battle skills in our special Discovery Arena event! Characters Lv. 33 and up will be qualified to participate in a special 5v5, PvE arena match, so get in there and start earning Arena Points!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/d38ecb6f10754c27ece87cd6495b63b15e9ff9bf.png

You can register for a battle by going to the Discovery Arena. To get there, complete the "[Discovery] Discovery Arena" quest from the star event notifier on the left side of the screen, then open the Discovery UI and move to the Discovery Arena map. Once in the waiting area, speak with the NPC Cynapse. From there, you can participate in battles, register your combat power with your current power, learn about the battle details, and view the rankings. 

Once you select "Matching," you'll be matched up with 4 other characters from your account based on your battle rank (you can register characters while participating in the battle). You can view limited information about your teammates' stats, and decide whether to battle or request a rematch. Winning will earn you Arena Points, which will increase your overall battle rank (battle ranks reset every week). 

Once the battle starts, your team will be placed in a stronghold with walls and turrets to help you during the fight. Walls have high HP and will block your opponents path, while turrets will attack your opponent and alert you to their position. There are two types of turrets:

Bombarding Turrets: Detects players' positions and launches vertical attacks that can reach anywhere on the map
Laser Turrets: Placed in a fixed location and launches horizontal attacks at specific areas to the left and right of the turret.

If you can defeat all the enemies on the other team, you win the match! You'll receive Ark Points as well as Arena Points as a reward, and your battle rank will go up. If your character is killed, you leave the match, or the client is closed, then you lose the match. Your battle rank will go down, but stronghold enhancements will remain the same. 

After the event ends, the rankings will be finalized and you’ll receive the following rewards based on your final ranking:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952675/e8f75706a581f33d195dcaf45606afe90212e668.png
